ग: ग The third consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, the letter. G.

ग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes, used chiefly in composition: as अधगः a traveller, who goes a road; अपगा what goes down, (a river, &c.) m. (-गः) 1 A name of the deity GAṆEŚA. 2 A Gandharba or celestial musician. f. (गा) A song. n. (-गं) Song, singing. E. गम to go or गै to sing, affix ड, fem. affix टाप्.
गगण: गगण n. (-णं) Sky, atmosphere, heaven. E. गम to go, Uṇādi affix, युच्, and the radical final changed to ग; the word and its derivatives are also sometimes read गगन.
गगणध्वज: गगणध्वज m. (-जः) 1 A cloud. 2 The sun. E. गगण the sky, and ध्वज a standard or symbol.
गगणाध्वग: गगणाध्वग m. (-गः) 1 The sun. 2 A planet. 3 A heavenly spirit. E. गगण the sky, अध्वन् a road, and ग who goes.
गगणपुष्प: गगणपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A flower in the sky, i. e. an impossibility. E. गगण and पुष्प a flower; also गगणकुसुम, &c.
गगणविहारिन्: गगणविहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Sporting in heaven. m. (-री) 1 The sun. 2 A heavenly luminary. 3 A divinity or celestial being. E. गगण, and विहारिन् who sports.
गगणसद्: गगणसद् mf. (-सत् or सद्) Going in the air. m. (-सद्) A celestial being. E. गगण, and षद to go, क्विप् aff.
गगणस्थ: गगणस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Situated in the sky. E. गगण, and स्थ what stays in; also गगणस्थित, &c.
गगणस्पर्शन: गगणस्पर्शन m. (-नः) Air, wind. E. गगण, and स्पर्शन who touches.
गगणाग्र: गगणाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The highest heavens, the summit or highest part of heaven. E. गगण, and अग्र end.
गगणेचर: गगणेचर m. (-रः) 1 A planet. 2 An asterism. 3 A heavenly spirit. E. गगणे in the sky, चर who goes.
गगणोल्मुक: गगणोल्मुक m. (-कः) The planet Mars. E. गगण the sky, and उल्मका, a torch or coal.
गग्घ: गग्घ r. 1st cl. (गग्घति) To laugh, to laugh at or deride: see घग्घ.
गङ्गा: गङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) The river Ganges, or its personification as a goddess. E. गम to go, Uṇādi affix गन्, or गां the accusative of गो the earth, and ग who goes, form irr.
गङ्गाका: गङ्गाका f. (-का) The river Ganges. E. कन् added to the preceding; also read गङ्गका.
गङ्गाक्षेत्र: गङ्गाक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) The river Ganges, and two Kos on either of its banks. E. गङ्गा, and क्षेत्र holy place; all dying within such limits going to heaven, whatever their crimes.
गङ्गाचिल्ली: गङ्गाचिल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The black headed gull, (Larus ridibundus.) E. गङ्गा the Ganges, and चिल्ली a kite, considered by the Hindus as a species of that bird; the Gangetic kite.
गङ्गाज: गङ्गाज m. (-जः) 1 A name of BHĪṢMA. 2 A name of the deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. गङ्गा the river goddess, and ज born; the son of GAṄGĀ.
गङ्गाजल: गङ्गाजल n. (-लं) The water of the Gaṅgā. E. गङ्गा, and जल water.
गङ्गाटेय: गङ्गाटेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Going in or to the Ganges. m. (-यः) A shrimp or prawn; also गलाविल. E. गङ्गा the river, and अट् to go, अच् affix, गङ्गाट, and ढक् added.
गङ्गाद्वार: गङ्गाद्वार n. (-रः) The place where the Gaṅgā enters the plains; also Haridvār. E. गङ्गा, and द्वार gate.
गङ्गातीर: गङ्गातीर m. (-रं) The bank of the Gaṅgā. E. गङ्गा, and तीर a bank.
गङ्गाधर: गङ्गाधर m. (-रः) 1 An epithet of ŚIVA. 2 The ocean. E. गङ्गा the Ganges, and धर who possesses or receives; according to the legend, the Ganges in its descent first alighted on the head of ŚIVA, and continued for some period entangled in his hair.
गङ्गापार: गङ्गापार n. (-रं) The bank of the Ganges. E. गङ्गा and पार the bank.
गङ्गापुत्र: गङ्गापुत्र m. (-त्रः) 1 BHĪṢMA. 2 A man of a mixed and vile caste, employed to remove dead bodies. 3 A Brahman who conducts the ceremonies of pilgrimage at some places on the Ganges, especially at Benares, E. गङ्गा, and पुत्र a son.
गङ्गामध्य: गङ्गामध्य n. (-ध्यं) The bed or stream of the Ganges. E. गङ्गा, and मध्य centre.
गङ्गाम्बु: गङ्गाम्बु n. (-म्बु) 1 Pure rain water, such as falls in Aśvin. 2 Ganges water. E. गङ्गा, and अम्बु water.
गङ्गायात्रा: गङ्गायात्रा f. (-त्रा) 1 Pilgrimage to the Gaṅgā. 2 Carrying a sick person to the river side to die there. E. गङ्गा, and यात्रा going.
गङ्गासुत: गङ्गासुत m. (-तः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A name of the hero BHĪṢMA: see गङ्गाज. E. गङ्गा, and सुत a son; the son of GAṄGĀ.
गङ्गिका: गङ्गिका f. (-का) The Ganges. E. गङ्गा, and कन् affix fem. form; also गङ्गका, and गङ्गाका.
गङ्गीभूत: गङ्गीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become as the Ganges, as sacred, &c. E. मङ्गा, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
गच्छ: गच्छ m. (-च्छः) A tree. E. गम to go, and स Uṇādi affix, what goes or grows; also अगच्छ.
गच्छत्: गच्छत् mfn. (-च्छन्-च्छन्ती-च्छत्) Going. E. गम to go, शतृ aff.
गज: गज r. 1st cl. (गजति) To be drunk, to be confused or inebriated: r. 1st and 10th cls. (गजति गजयति) also (इ) गजि r. 1st cl. (गञ्जति) To sound.

गज m. (-जः) 1 An elephant. 2 A measure of length, the Gaz, a yard, a measure of two cubits. 3 A mound of earth sloping on both sides, on which a house may be erected. 4 A small hole in the ground for a fire, over which to prepare medicines. E. गज to sound, to roar, affix अच्
गजकन्द: गजकन्द m. (-न्दः) A large esculent root, a sort of arum. E. गज, and कन्द root.
गजकूर्माशिन्: गजकूर्म्माशिन् m. (-शी) A name of GARUḌA the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. गज an elephant, कूर्म्म a tortoise, and अशिन् who eats; alluding to a legend of his swallowing both animals whilst engaged in a contest with each other.
गजकूर्म्माशिन्: गजकूर्म्माशिन् m. (-शी) A name of GARUḌA the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. गज an elephant, कूर्म्म a tortoise, and अशिन् who eats; alluding to a legend of his swallowing both animals whilst engaged in a contest with each other.
गजचिर्भट: गजचिर्भट mf. (-टः-टा) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.)
गजच्छाया: गजच्छाया f. (-या) A portion of time proper for a Śrāddha. E. गज, and छाया shadow.
गजढक्का: गजढक्का f. (-क्का) A kettle drum carried on an elephant. E. गज an elephant, and ढक्का a large drum.
गजता: गजता f. (-ता) A multitude of elephants. E. गज an elephant, तल् aff.
गजदघ्न: गजदघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) As high or tall as an elephant. E. गज, and दघ्नच् aff.
गजदन्त: गजदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 Ivory, the elephant's tooth. 3 A bracket or pin projecting from the wall. E. गज a elephant, and दन्त a tooth; GAṆEŚA is represented with an elephant's head.
गजदान: गजदान n. (-नं) The liquor exuding from an elephant's temples. E. गज, and दान the same.
गजद्वयस: गजद्वयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) As high as an elephant. E. गज, and द्वयसच् aff.
गजपति: गजपति m. (-तिः) 1 A large state elephant. 2 A king. E. गज, and पति a master.
गजपिप्पली: गजपिप्पली f. (-ली) A plant bearing a seed which resembles pepper, (Pothos officinalis.) E. गज an elephant, and पिप्पली long pepper; considered to be a large species of pepper: see similar names, as करिपिप्पली, इभकणा, &c.
गजपुङ्गव: गजपुङ्गव m. (-वः) A large and excellent elephant. E. गज, and पुङ्गव implying eminence.
गजपुट: गजपुट m. (-टः) A small hollow for a fire, over which to prepare medical decoctions, extracts, &c. E. गज, and पुट a hollow.
गजप्रिया: गजप्रिया f. (-या) The gum olibanum tree, (Boswellia serrata). E. गज an elephant, and प्रिय beloved; also वल्लकी.
गजबन्धनी: गजबन्धनी f. (-नी) A post to which an elephant is bound. E. गज, and बन्धन a binding.
गजभक्षक: गजभक्षक m. (-कः) The sacred fig tree. E. गज, and भक्षक eater; the young branches of the Pipal being the elephant's favourite food.
गजभक्षा: गजभक्षा f. (-क्षा) The gum olibanum tree: see गजप्रिय. E. गज an elephant, and भक्षा food; also गजभक्ष्या.
गजमण्डलिका: गजमण्डलिका f. (-का) A ring or circle of elephants surrounding a car, &c. E. गज, मण्डल a circle, कन् affix fem. form.
गजमाचल: गजमाचल m. (-लः) A lion. E. गज an elephant, मा fortune, and चल what goes; the destroyer of the elephant.
गजमात्र: गजमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) As tall as an elephant. E. गज, and मात्रच् aff.
गजमुक्ता: गजमुक्ता f. (-क्ता) A pearl, supposed to be found in the head of an elephant. E. गज, and मुक्ता a pearl.
गजमोटन: गजमोटन m. (-नः) A lion. E. गज an elephant, मुट to run away, in the causal form, affix ल्युट्; or with मुच to go, गजमोचन as it is sometimes read.
गजयूथ: गजयूथ m. (-थः) A herd of elephants. E. गज, and यूथ a herd.
गजवदन: गजवदन m. (-नः) A name of GAṆEŚA, who is represented always with the head of an elephant. E. गज, and वदन a face.
गजव्रज: गजव्रज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Who walks like an elephant. n. (-जं) 1 A troop of elephants. 2 The pace of an elephant. E. गज, and व्रज a number or going, who goes, &c.
गजसाह्वय: गजसाह्वय n. (-यं) A famous city, Hastinapur the capital of the KURUS. E. गज, स for सम् with, and आह्वय an appellation; named from its elephants; also गजाह्व, &c.
गजाग्रणी: गजाग्रणी m. (-णीः) The elephant of INDRA. E. गज, and अग्रणी preeminent.
गजाजीव: गजाजीव m. (-वः) An elephant keeper or driver. E. गज, and आजीव who lives; who gets his livelihood by elephants.
गजानन: गजानन m. (-नः) The deity GAṆEŚA. E. गज an elephant, and आनन a face; see गजवदन.
गजारि: गजारि m. (-रिः) 1 A lion. 2 A particular tree. E. गज, and अरि a foe.
गजारूढ: गजारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted or riding on an elephant. E. गज, and आरूढ mounted.
गजाशन: गजाशन m. (-नः) The religious fig tree. f. (-ना) 1 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) 2 The gum olibanum tree. 3 The root of a lotus. E. गज, and अशन food; the food of elephants.
गजास्य: गजास्य m. (-स्यः) GAṆEŚA: see गजानन. E. गज an elephant, and आस्य a face.
गजाह्व: गजाह्व n. (-ह्वं) The city Hastinapur. f. (-ह्वा) A plant: see गजपिप्पली. E. गज, and आह्वा a name: see गजसाह्वय.
गजाह्वय: गजाह्वय n. (-य) Hastinapur, the ancient Dehli: see the preceding.
गजेन्द्र: गजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A large and excellent elephant. 2 INDRA'S elephant. E. गज, and इन्द्र chief.
गजोषणा: गजोषणा f. (-णा) A sort of pepper: see गजपिप्पली. E. गज, and उषणा pepper.
गञ्ज: गञ्ज mfn. subst. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा-ञ्जं) A mine, a jewel mine. mn. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जं) 1 A cow-house or station of cowherds. 2 A treasury, a jewel room, the place where plate, &c. is preserved. 3 A mart, a place where grain, &c. is stored for sale. m. (-ञ्जः) Disrespect, contempt. f. (-ञ्जा) 1 A tavern. 2 A drinking vessel. 3 A hut, a hovel, the abode of low people. 4 The Gunja or Ratti, (Abrus precatorius:) see गुञ्जा. E. गजि to sound, अच् affix; fem. affix टाप्.
गञ्जिका: गञ्जिका f. (-का) A tavern. E. कन् added to the preceding.
गड: गड r. 1st cl. (गडति) To distil or drop, to run as a liquid; also, गल. (इ) गडि r. 1st cl. (गण्डति) To affect the cheek, to be rough as the cheek, (obsolete.)

गड m. (-ड) 1 A kind of fish, the young of the Ophiocephalus lata, HAM. 2 Another species, (Cyprinus garra. HAM.) see गल. 3 An impediment, an obstacle. 4 A screen, a covering, a fence. 5 A moat, a ditch. 6 A country, part of Malva, Gerha or Gera Mendela. E. गड to drop, affix अच्.
गडक: गडक m. (-कः) A kind of fish: see the last. E. गड to drop, affix क्वुन्
गडयन्त: गडयन्त m. (-न्तः) A cloud. E. गड to drop (water), Uṇādi affix झच् and अय substituted for the penultimate.
गडलवण: गडलवण n. (-णं) Rock or fossile salt, especially that found in the district of Sāmbher in the province of Ajmere. E. गड a country, and लवण salt.
गडि: गडि m. (-डिः) 1 A steer. 2 A lazy ox. E. गड to drop, इन् aff.
गडु: गडु mfn. (-डुः-डुः-डु) Crooked, humpbacked, &c. m. (-डुः) 1 A hump on the back. 2 Goitre or Bronchocele. 3 A humpbacked man. 4 A javelin, a spear. 5 An earth-worm. 6 A water pot. E. गड to drop, Uṇādi affix उ.
गडुक: गडुक n. (-कं) 1 A water pot. 2 A finger ring. E. कन् added to the last.
गडुकण्ठ: गडुकण्ठ mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठी-ण्ठं) Having a goitre. E. गडु, and कण्ठ the throat.
गडुर: गडुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Crooked, bent, humpbacked. E. गडु a hump, and र substituted for ल: see the next.
गडुल: गडुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Crooked, humpbacked. E. गडु hump, and लच् affix; also गडुर.
गडेर: गडेर m. (-रः) A cloud. E. गड to drop (water), and एरक् Uṇādi aff.
गडोत्थ: गडोत्थ n. (-त्थं) Fossile salt. E. गड the country, and उत्थ produced.
गडोल: गडोल m. (-लः) 1 A mouthful. 2 Raw sugar. E. गड to drop, ओलच् Uṇādi affix; also गण्डोल.
गड्डरिका: गड्डरिका f. (-का) 1 A sudden rush of water of which the source is unknown. 2 A single ewe preceding a flock of sheep.
गड्डुक: गड्डुक m. (-कः) A golden vase. E. गड to sprinkle, डुक Uṇādi affix; also गड्डूक and occasionally गडुक.
गड्डूक: गड्डूक m. (-कः) A golden water vessel: see the preceding.
गण: गण r. 10th cl. (गणयति) To count, to reckon up by number, to calculate.

गण m. (-णः) 1 A flock, a multitude, a troop, a tribe or class, &c. 2 A body of troops equal to three Gulmas, or twenty-seven chariots and as many elephants, eighty-one horses, and 135 foot. 3 Troops of inferior deities considered as ŚIVA'S attendants, and under the especial superintendence of GAṆEŚA. 4 A name of GAṆEŚA. 5 A number, (in arithmetic.) 6 A kind of perfume, commonly Cor. 7 A sect in philosophy or religion. 8 A conjugation, a class of radicals. 9 Series of asterisms which are classed under three heads, human, infernal, and divine. E. गण to count or reckon, affix अच्.
गणक: गणक m. (-कः) 1 An astrologer, a calculator of nativities, &c. 2 An arithmetician. f. (-की) The wife of an astrologer. E. गण to calculate, affix क्वुन्, fem. affix ङीष्.
गणकार: गणकार m. (-रः) 1 A name of BHĪMASENA. 2 A classifier, one who arranges into classes. E. गण a troop, and कार who forms.
गणचक्रक: गणचक्रक n. (-कं) A dinner in common by a party of virtuous men. E. गण a number, चक्र a wheel or circle, and कन् aff.
गणता: गणता f. (-ता) 1 Classification. 2 Multitude, assemblage. 3 Following a party or faction. 4 Arithmetic. E. गण a class, तल् affix; also with त्व, गणत्वं.
गणदीक्षा: गणदीक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Initiation of a particular kind in which GAṆEŚA is especially worshipped. 2 Initiation of a number or class. 3 Performance of religious rites for a number of persons. E. गण, and दीक्षा a religious rite.
गणदीक्षिन्: गणदीक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) 1 A priest who officiates for various castes and people. 2 One who has been initiated into the worship of GAṆEŚA. E. गण, दीक्षा a rite, and इनि aff.
गणदेवता: गणदेवता f. (-ता) A deity of a class, as an Āditya, a Vasu, a Rudra, &c. E. गण, and देवता a divinity.
गणद्रव्य: गणद्रव्य n. (-व्यं) 1 Public property, common stock. 2 A variety of articles. E. गण a class, and द्रव्य thing.
गणधर: गणधर m. (-रः) 1 The head of a class or number, the teacher of a school. 2 A title of the first disciples of the Jina Mahāvīra. E. गण a class, and धर who holds.
गणन: गणन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Counting, enumerating. 2 Arithmetic. E. गण to count, युच् aff.
गणनाथ: गणनाथ m. (-थः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. गण, and नाथ lord.
गणनायक: गणनायक m. (-कः) A name of GAṆEŚA. f. (-यिका) A name of DURGĀ. E. गण, and नायक a leader: see गणेश.
गणनीय: गणनीय mfn. (-य-यी-यं) 1 Numerable, to be counted or reckoned. 2 To be classed. E. गण to count, and अनीयर् aff.
गणपति: गणपति m. (-तिः) GAṆEŚA. E. गण, and पति lord: see गणेश.
गणपर्वत: गणपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The fabulous mountain Kailāsa. E. गण ŚIVA'S attendant demigods, and पर्ब्वत a mountain; this mountain being the residence of the Kinnaras, Yakṣas, and other subordinate deities.
गणपर्व्वत: गणपर्व्वत m. (-तः) The fabulous mountain Kailāsa. E. गण ŚIVA'S attendant demigods, and पर्ब्वत a mountain; this mountain being the residence of the Kinnaras, Yakṣas, and other subordinate deities.
गणपीठक: गणपीठक n. (-कं) The breast or bosom. E. गण the aggregate, (of qualities,) and पीठक a seat.
गणरात्र: गणरात्र n. (-त्रं) A multitude of nights. E. गण, and रात्र night.
गणरूप: गणरूप m. (-पः) Swallow wort, (Calotropis gigantea;) also अर्क. E. गण a number, and रूप form, multiform.
गणरूपिन्: गणरूपिन् m. (-पी) Swallow wort, the white sort: see the preceding.
गणवतीसुत: गणवतीसुत m. (-तः) The name of a sage and physician; also called DHANVANTARI or KĀŚIRĀJA. E. गणवती a proper name, and सुत a son, the son of GAṆAVATĪ.
गणहासक: गणहासक m. (-कः) Cor, a species of perfume. E. गण many, and हासक what causes to smile, what delights.
गणाग्रणी: गणाग्रणी m. (-णीः) A name of GAṆEŚA. E. गण the troops of deities, and अग्रणी principal.
गणाचल: गणाचल m. (-लः) The mountain Kailāsa. E. गण, and अचल a mountain, the residence of the GAṆAS or troops of demigods.
गणाधिप: गणाधिप m. (-पः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 A title of ŚIVA. 3 The chief of a troop of soldiers, of a class of disciples, of a body of men or animals, &c. E. गण, and अधिप master; also गणाधिपति, and other similar epithets: see गणेश.
गणान्न: गणान्न n. (-न्नं) A mess, food prepared for a number of persons in common. E. गण, and अन्न food.
गणाभ्यन्तर: गणाभ्यन्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One of a troop or number. m. (-रः) A member of a religious convent or association. E. गण, and अभ्यन्तर included.
गणि: गणि f. (-णिः) Counting, enumerating. E. गण to count, इञ् aff.
गणिका: गणिका f. (-का) 1 A courtezan, a harlot. 2 A sort of jasmin, (J. auriculatum.) 3 A tree, commonly Ganiyari, (Premna spinosa.) 4 A female elephant. 5 Counting, enumerating. E. गण to reckon, &c. ण्वुल् aff.
गणिकारिका: गणिकारिका f. (-का) The name of a small tree with a very fetid leaf, commonly called Ganiyāri, the wood of which is used in attrition, for the purpose of producing flame, (Premna spinosa.) E. कन् added to गणिकारी.
गणिकारी: गणिकारी f. (-री) The name of a tree: see the preceding.
गणित: गणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Numbered, counted, reckoned, calculated. n. (-तं) 1 The science of computation, comprising arithmetic, algebra, and geometry, distinguished as पाटीगणितं, वीजगणितं and रेखागणितं. 2 Calculating, numbering. E. गण to count, affix क्त.
गणितव्य: गणितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be counted or numbered. 2 To be calculated. E. गण, and तव्य aff.
गणिपिटका: गणिपिटका f. (-का) A division of science peculiar to the Jainas.
गणीभूत: गणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Included in any class or troop. 2 Calculated. E. गण, and भूत become, with च्चि augment.
गणेय: गणेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Numberable, calculable, what may be reckoned or counted. E. गण to count, and यत् affix, form irr. see गण्य.
गणेरु: गणेरु m. (-रुः) A plant, (Pterospermum acerifolium, &c.) see कर्णिकार f. (-रुः) 1 A harlot, a whore. 2 A female elephant. E. गण a number, ईर to go, &c. affix उ.
गणेरुका: गणेरुका f. (-का) A bawd, a procuress. E. कन् added to the preceding.
गणेश: गणेश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 GAṆEŚA the son of ŚIVA and PĀRVATĪ; he is the deity of wisdom, and remover of obstacles, whence in the commencement of all undertakings, the opening of all compositions, &c. he receives the reverential homage of the Hindus. He is represented as a short fat man, with the head of an elephant; and the present appellation, with other similar compounds, alludes to his office as chief of the various classes of subordinate gods, who are regarded as ŚIVA'S attendants. E. गण a troop or class (of deities attendant upon ŚIVA), and ईश lord or master.
गणेशकुसुम: गणेशकुसुम m. (-मः) A shrub, Oleander with red flowers. E. गणेश, and कुसुम a flower.
गणेशपूजा: गणेशपूजा f. (-जा) Worship of GAṆEŚA. E. गणेश, and पृजा worship.
गणेशभूषण: गणेशभूषण n. (-णं) Red lead. E. गणेश, and भूषण ornament.
गणोत्साह: गणोत्साह m. (-हः) A rhinoceros. E. गण a herd, and उत्साह toil.
गण्ड: गण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A cheek, the whole side of the face including the temple. 2 An elephant's temple or cheek. 3 A boil, a pimple. 4 A mark, a spot. 5 A bubble. 6 A knot. 7 A rhinoceros: (see गण्डक.) 8 Part of a horse's trappings, a stud or button fixed as an ornament upon the harness. 9 A hero. 10 The abrupt interchange of question and answer, as one of the characteristics of the dramatic composition called Vīthi. 11 The tenth Yoga, or one of the twenty-seven portions of a circle on the plane of the ecliptic: see योग. 12 An astronomical period. E. गडि to affect the cheek, अच् affix, or गम to go, ड Uṇādi aff.
गण्डक: गण्डक m. (-कः) 1 A rhinoceros. 2 A mode of reckoning by fours. 3 An obstacle or impediment. 4 Separation, disjunction. 5 Astrological science or a part of it. f. (-की) The name of a river in the north of India, the Gandaki. f. (-का) A lump, a ball. E. गडि to affect the cheek, &c. ण्वुल् affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
गण्डकारी: गण्डकारी f. (-री) A sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. गण्ड a boil, and कारी what occasions.
गण्डकाली: गण्डकाली f. (-ली) See the preceding. E. गण्ड a knot, and काली black; black with many joints and knots.
गण्डकुसुम: गण्डकुसुम n. (-मं) The juice that exudes from the elephant's temples in time of rut. E. गण्ड an elephant's temples, and कुसुम a flower, from its supposed fragrance.
गण्डकूप: गण्डकूप m. (-पः) The peak or summit of a mountain.
गण्डगात्र: गण्डगात्र n. (-त्रं) A fruit, custard apple, (Annona squamosa.) E. गण्ड a boil, and गात्र a body; the inside being compared to purulent pustules.
गण्डफलक: गण्डफलक n. (-कं) The cheek. E. गण्ड, and फलक a layer.
गण्डमाला: गण्डमाला f. (-ला) Inflammation of the glands of the neck, &c. E. गण्ड a boil, and माला a necklace.
गण्डमालिन्: गण्डमालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Having the glands of the neck inflamed. E. इनि added to the last.
गण्डशैल: गण्डशैल m. (-लः) 1 A rock or rocky fragment fallen from a height, thrown down by an earthquake, a storm, &c. 2 The forehead. E. गण्ड a cheek, and शैल a rock, the cheek of the mountain, or in the second instance, vice-versa, the mountain as it were of the cheek or face.
गण्डस्थल: गण्डस्थल nf. (-लः-ली) The cheek. E. गण्ड, and स्थल place.
गण्डाङ्ग: गण्डाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A rhinoceros. E. गण्ड a stud, and अङ्ग a body: from the studded appearance of his hide.
गण्डाली: गण्डाली f. (-ली) A bent grass with white blossoms, a white sort of Dūrvā, (Agrostis linearis.) E. गण्ड a boil, अल to be adequate to or fit for, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
गण्डि: गण्डि m. (-ण्डिः) 1 Goitre or Bronchocele. 2 The trunk of a tree. E. गडि to affect the cheek, &c. Uṇādi affix इन्.
गण्डीर: गण्डीर m. (-रः) 1 A kind of potherb, described as growing in watery ground, and according to some, a species of cucumber. 2 A hero, a champion. f. (-री) A milky plant, (Euphorbia.) E. गडि to affect a part, &c. इरन् aff.
गण्डु: गण्डु mf. (-ण्डुः) A pillow. f. (-ण्डूः) A knot or joint. E. गडि to support the cheek, Uṇādi affix उ.
गण्डूपद: गण्डूपद m. (-दः) An earth-worm. f. (-दी) A small or female worm. E. गण्डू a knot, and पद a foot.
गण्डूपदभव: गण्डूपदभव m. (-वः) Lead. E. गण्डूपद a worm, and भव produced.
गण्डूष: गण्डूष mf. (-षः-षा) 1 A mouthful. 2 A handful. 3 A handful of water, water, &c. held in the hollowed palm of the hand for rincing the mouth, &c. 4 Filling the mouth, rincing it, &c. 5 The tip of an elephant's trunk. E. गड to drop, ऊषण् Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted.
गण्डोल: गण्डोल m. (-लः) 1 Raw sugar. 2 A mouthful. E. गड to drop, or गडि to affect the cheek, ओलच् affix; also गडोल. E. गल to court, यत् aff.
गण्य: गण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) To be counted or calculated. E. गण to count, affix of the future participle यत्; also irregularly गणेय.
गत: गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Gone. 2 Known, understood. 3 Obtained, gained. 4 Lost. n. (-तं) Going, motion. 2 Any thing past or done, an event. E. गम to go, in the participle past.
गतकाल: गतकाल n. (-लं) Time past. E. गत, and काल time.
गतक्लम: गतक्लम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Rested, refreshed. E. गत, and क्लम fatigue.
गतचेतन: गतचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Senseless, swooned. E. गत, and चेतना consciousness.
गतज्वर: गतज्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Well, recovered, free from fever or sickness. E. गत, and ज्वर fever.
गततोयद: गततोयद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Cloudless, cleared up, fair. E. गत, and तोयद a cloud.
गतप्रत्यागत: गतप्रत्यागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Returned, come back again after having gone away. E. गत, and प्रत्य, गत come back.
गतदिन: गतदिन n. (-नं) Yesterday. E. गत, and दिन day; also गतदिवसं.
गतधृति: गतधृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Agitated, discomposed, unsteady. E. गत, and धृति firmness.
गतनासिक: गतनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Noseless. E. गत gone, lost, and नासिका the nose.
गतमाय: गतमाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Reformed, without deceit. 2 Cruel without compassion. E. गत, and माया deceit.
गतलक्ष्मीक: गतलक्ष्मीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfortunate, suffering losses; so गतदीक.
गतवत्: गतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Going, passing. 2 Obtaining. 3 Falling into. 4 Feeling, entertaining. E. गम, and क्तवतु aff.
गतवित्त: गतवित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Beggared, impoverished. E. गत, and वित्त wealth.
गतविभव: गतविभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Poor, indigent. E. गत, and विभव wealth.
गतव्यथ: गतव्यथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Free from pain. 2 Unanxious. E. गत, and व्यथ pain.
गतशैशव: गतशैशव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Grown up, above eight years of age. गत, and शैशव infancy.
गतसङ्कल्प: गतसङ्कल्प mfn. (-ल्पः-ल्पा-ल्पं) Bereft of sense, foolish. E. गत, and सङ्कल्प purpose.
गतसङ्ग: गतसङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं) 1 Detached from, dissevered. 2 Adverse or indifferent to. E. गत, and सङ्ग union.
गतसत्व: गतसत्व mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं) 1 Base. 2 Lifeless, dead, &c. E. गत, and सत्व being.
गतसन्नक: गतसन्नक m. (-कः) An elephant out of rut.
गताक्ष: गताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Blind, sightless. E. गत gone, and अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.
गतागत: गतागत n. (-तं) 1 The flight of a bird backward and forward. 2 Going and coming, reiterated motion in general. E. गत going, आगत coming.
गतानुगतिक: गतानुगतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Following, imitating, imitative, doing as others do. E. गत, and अनुगतिक who goes after.
गतायुस्: गतायुस् mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) 1 Very old, infirm, decrepid, decayed. 2 Dead. E. गत, and आयुस् life.
गतार्तवा: गतार्त्तवा f. (-वा) 1 A woman past child bearing. 2 A barren woman. E. गत, and आर्त्तवा a woman menstruating.
गतार्त्तवा: गतार्त्तवा f. (-वा) 1 A woman past child bearing. 2 A barren woman. E. गत, and आर्त्तवा a woman menstruating.
गतार्थ: गतार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Unmeaning, nonsensical. 2 Poor. 3 Void of an object. E. गत, and अर्थ sense, &c.
गतासु: गतासु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) Dead, expired. E. गत, and असु breath.
गति: गति f. (-तिः) 1 Going, moving, motion in general. 2 March, procession. 3 A road, a way, a path. 4 A period of life, as age, youth, &c. 5 An expedient, a means of success. 6 Knowledge, wisdom. 7 A sinus, a fistular sore. 8 Worldly vanity or wickedness. 9 Course of events, fate, fortune. 10 Resource, refuge, asylum. 11 The diurnal motion of a planet in its orbit. 12 State, mode of existence. E. गम to go, affix क्तिन.
गतिक: गतिक n. (-कं) 1 Going, motion. 2 Refuge, asylum. 3 Course. 4 Condition. E. कन् added to the preceding.
गतिला: गतिला f. (-ला) 1 The name of a river, the Gatilā. 2 Mutual separation. E. गप्त to go, इल Uṇādi affix, and त substituted for the radical final.
गत्वर: गत्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going, moving, locomotive. E. गम to go, affix क्वरप्.
गत्वा: गत्वा ind. Having gone, gone to or attained, &c. E. गम to go, क्त्वा aff.
गत्यून: गत्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Impassable, difficult of access. 2 Desert. 3 Helpless. E. गति, and ऊन् defective.
गद: गद r. 10 cl. (गदति) 1 To speak articulately. 2 To be sick, r. 10th cl. (गदयति) To thunder.
गद m. (-दः) 1 Disease, sickness. 2 Speech, speaking. 2 GADA the younger brother of KṚṢṆA. f. (-दा) 1 A mace, a club. 2 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. गद to speak, &c. अच् aff.
गदयित्नु: गदयित्नु mfn. (-त्नुः-त्नुः-त्नु) 1 Loquacious, talkative, talking much or idly. 2 Libidinous, lustful, desirous. m. (-त्नुः) A name of KANDARPA, the deity of love. E. गद to speak, Uṇādi affix इत्नुच्, and अय inserted.
गदाख्य: गदाख्य n. (-ख्यं) A kind of Costus, (C. speciosus:) see कुष्ठ.
गदागद: गदागद m. (always dual -दौ) The two physicians of Svarga, the sons of AŚVINĪ by SŪRYA. E. गद disease in general, and अगद health.
गदाग्रज: गदाग्रज m. (-जः) A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. गद, and अग्रज an elder brother.
गदाधर: गदाधर m. (-रः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. गदा a club, and धर who holds; KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU is represented holding a mace in one of his hands.
गदाभृत्: गदाभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 A name of KṚṢṆA. 2 A mace or club bearer. 3 One who fights with a mace. E. गदा a club, and भृत् who nourishes: see the preceding.
गदाम्बर: गदाम्बर m. (-रः) A cloud. E. गद sound, अम्बर the sky.
गदाराति: गदाराति m. (-तिः) A drug, a medicament. E. गद, and अराति an enemy.
गदाहू: गदाहू n. (-ह्वं) A kind of grass, (Costus speciosus:) see कुष्ठ. E. गद disease, and आह्वा a name; named by many of the same terms as disease: see व्याधि, &c.; also गदाख्य, गदाह्वय, &c.
गदित: गदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said. E. गद to speak, क्त aff.
गदितवत्: गदितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Saying, speaking, having spoken. E. गद, and क्तततु aff.
गदिन्: गदिन् m. (-दी) 1 A name of VIṢṆU. 2 A mace bearer. 3 One armed with a club. 4 A sick man. E. गदा a mace, and इनि poss. aff.
गद्गद: गद्गद m. (-दः) Indistinct or convulsive utterance, as sobbing, &c. E. गद to speak, क्विप् affix, root repeated with अच्.
गद्गदध्वनि: गद्गदध्वनि m. (-निः) Low inarticulate expression of joy or grief. E. गद्गद inarticulate utterance, and ध्वनि sound.
गद्गदपद: गद्गदपद n. (-दं) Inarticulate speech. गद्गद, and पद a word.
गद्गदवाच्: गद्गदवाच् f. (-बाक्) Inarticulate or convulsive speech, interrupted by sobbing, &c. E. गद्गद, and वाच् speech.
गद्य: गद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be spoken or uttered. n. (-द्यं) Prose. E. गद to speak, affix यत्.
गद्यानक: गद्यानक n. (-कं) A weight either of sixty-four or forty-eight Rattis; also read गद्यालक.
गन्तव्य: गन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be gone, to be gone to or attained. E. गम, and तव्य aff.
गन्तु: गन्तु m. (-न्तुः) A traveller, a way-farer. E. गम to go, Uṇādi affix तुन्.
गन्तृ: गन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Who or what goes or moves. E. गम to go, तृच् aff.
गन्त्री: गन्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A cart or car drawn by oxen. E. गम to go, ष्ट्रन् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
गन्त्रीरथ: गन्त्रीरथ m. (-थः) A cart. E. गन्त्री a carriage drawn by oxen, and रथ a vehicle.
गन्ध: गन्ध r. 10th cl. (गन्धयते) 1 To injure, to hurt or kill. 2 To move, to go. 3 To ask or beg.

गन्ध m. (-न्धः) 1 Smell, odour. 2 A perfume, a fragrance or fragrant substance. 3 A diffusive fragrance. 4 Sulphur. 5 Connexion, relationship. 6 A neighbour. 7 A plant, (Morunga hyperanthera, &c.) 8 Pride, arrogance. 9 Small, diminutive, a little, a small quantity, &c. 10 Pounded Sandal. f. (-न्धा) The bud of the Champaca flower, (Michelia Champaca.) n. (-न्धं) Aloe-wood. E. गन्ध to hurt, to move, &c. affix अच्.
गन्धक: गन्धक m. (-कः) 1 Sulphur. 2 The morunga tree, (M. hyperanthera, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन. E. कन् added to the preceding.
गन्धकारिका: गन्धकारिका f. (-का) A female artisan, living in the house of another woman. E. गन्ध perfume, and कारिका who makes.
गन्धकालिका: गन्धकालिका f. (-का) The mother of VYĀSA. E. कन् added to the next.
गन्धकाली: गन्धकाली f. (-ली) The mother of the poet VYĀSA. E. गन्ध perfume, कल to make, affixes अण् and ङीप् having a strong scent.
गन्धकाष्ठ: गन्धकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A fragrant wood, as Sandal, aloewood, &c. E. गन्ध smell, and काष्ठ timber.
गन्धकुटी: गन्धकुटी f. (-टी) A kind of perfume, commonly Mura. E. गन्ध smell, &c. कुटी abode.
गन्धखेड: गन्धखेड n. (-डः) A fragrant grass. E. गन्ध, and खेड grass; also with कन् added गन्धखेडकं: see गन्धतृण.
गन्धगज: गन्धगज m. (-जः) An elephant of the best kind. E. गन्ध odour, गज an elephant.
गन्धगुण: गन्धगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Having the property of odour. E. गन्ध and गुण quality.
गन्धघ्राण: गन्धघ्राण n. (-णं) Smelling any odour. E. गन्ध, and घ्राण smelling.
गन्धचेलिका: गन्धचेलिका f. (-का) Musk. E. गन्ध fragrance, चेलि clothes, affix कन्; being used for scenting clothes.
गन्धजात: गन्धजात n. (-तं) The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. गन्ध smell, and जात produced; fragrant.
गन्धज्ञा: गन्धज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) The nose. E. गन्ध scent, and ज्ञा who knows.
गन्धतूर्य: गन्धतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A musical instrument, one of a loud sound used in battle: (a drum or trumpet.) E. गन्ध pride, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
गन्धतूर्य्य: गन्धतूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) A musical instrument, one of a loud sound used in battle: (a drum or trumpet.) E. गन्ध pride, and तूर्य्य a musical instrument.
गन्धतृण: गन्धतृण n. (-णं) A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) E. गन्ध, and तृण grass.
गन्धत्वच्: गन्धत्वच् f. (-त्वक्) A sort of perfume, commonly Elavāluka. E. गन्ध and त्वच् skin, rind.
गन्धद्विप: गन्धद्विप m. (-पः) An elephant of the best class, supposed to emit a particular smell at all times. E. गन्ध, and द्विप an elephant.
गन्धधूलि: गन्धधूलि f. (-लिः) Musk, the fragrant secretion of the musk-deer. E. गन्ध fragrant, and धूलि dust.
गन्धन: गन्धन n. (-नं) 1 Continued effort, perseverance. 2 Injury, hurting, killing. 3 Intimation, information. 4 Manifestation. E. गन्ध to hurt, to move, &c. affix ल्युट्.
गन्धनकुल: गन्धनकुल m. (-लः) The musk-rat of Bengal, (Sorex moschata.) E. गन्ध scented, and नकुल an ichneumon.
गन्धनाकुली: गन्धनाकुली f. (-ली) A plant, possibly the serpent Ophioxylon: see रास्ना. E. गन्ध smelling, and नाकुली the same plant.
गन्धनामन्: गन्धनामन् m. (-मा) A fragrant kind of basil. E. गन्ध fragrance, and नामन् a name.
गन्धनाली: गन्धनाली f. (-ली) The nose. E. गन्ध scent, and नाली a tubular canal.
गन्धनिलया: गन्धनिलया f. (-या) Double jasmin, (J. Zambac floribus multiplicatis.) E. गन्ध smell, and निलय a house.
गन्धपत्र: गन्धपत्र m. (-त्रः) A white sort of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum:) see श्वेतपर्णास. f. (-त्री) 1 A sort of zedoary, (-त्रा) Ajwaen, (Ligusticam ajwaen.) 2 Another plant, (Physalis flexuosa.) E. गन्ध, and पत्र a leaf.
गन्धपलाशिका: गन्धपलाशिका f. (-का) Turmeric. E. गन्ध small, पलाश a leaf.
गन्धपलाशी: गन्धपलाशी f. (-शी) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) E. गन्ध, and पलाश a leaf.
गन्धपाषाण: गन्धपाषाण m. (-णः) Sulphur. E. गन्ध smelling, and पाषाण a stone.
गन्धपिशात्रिका: गन्धपिशात्रिका f. (-का) The smell of incense, diffusive incense. E. गम्म smell, पिशाचिका female demon; imp-like, from its dark colour or cloudy nature; or attracting demons by its fragrance.
गन्धपीता: गन्धपीता f. (-ता) A species of zedoary. E. गन्ध, and पीत yellow.
गन्धपुष्प: गन्धपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A kind of cane, (Calamus roatang.) 2 Another plant, (Alangium hexapetalum:) see अङ्कोट. 3 Sebesten, (Cordia myxa.) f. (-ष्पा) 1 The indigo plant. 2 Ganiyāri, (Premna spinosa, &c.) see गणिकारी. n. (-ष्पं) Flowers and Sandal presented together at seasons of worship. E. गन्ध smell, and पुष्प flower; having odoriferous flowers.
गन्धफल: गन्धफल m. (-लः) 1 Elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. 2 The Bel, (Ægle crataeva.) f. (-ला or -ली) 1 A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु. 2 The gum olibanum tree. f. (-ली) The blossom of the Champaca: see चम्पक. E. गन्ध smell, and फल a fruit.
गन्धबन्धु: गन्धबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The mango tree. E. गन्ध a smell, and बन्धु a friend.
गन्धभद्रा: गन्धभद्रा f. (-द्रा) A creeper commonly Gandhabhādali or Ghandali, (Poederia fetida?) E. गन्ध smell, and भद्र auspicious.
गन्धभाण्ड: गन्धभाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A tree, (Hibiscus populneoides:) see गर्द्धभाण्ड.
गन्धमांसी: गन्धमांसी f. (-सी) A kind of Indian spikenard: see जटामांसी.
गन्धमातृ: गन्धमातृ f. (-ता) The earth. E. गन्ध scent, and मातृ the mother; the property of fragrance residing in the earth or earthy atoms.
गन्धमादन: गन्धमादन mn. (-नः-नं) The name of a particular mountain, forming the division between Ilāvṛtta and Bhadrāśva or to the east of Meru. m. (-नः) 1 A large black bee. 2 Sulphur. 3 The name of one of the monkey chiefs. f. (-नी) Spirituous liquor; also in some books read गन्धमादिनी. E. गन्ध smell, मद to inebriate in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.
गन्धमादिन्: गन्धमादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Strong scented, of intoxicating odour. f. (-नी) 1 Lac. 2 A sort of perfume. 3 Wine or spirituous liquor. E. गन्ध, and मादिन् what intoxicates.
गन्धमार्जार: गन्धमार्जार m. (-रः) The civet-cat. E. गन्ध smell, and मार्जार a cat.
गन्धमालिनी: गन्धमालिनी f. (-नी) Murā, a perfume so called. E. गन्ध smell, माला a necklace, affixes इनि and ङीप्.
गन्धमुण्ड: गन्धमुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A creeper, (Hibiscus populneoides;) also गन्थभाण्ड.
गन्धमूल: गन्धमूल m. (-लः) A plant with a fragrant and tuberous root, one of the Scitaminea, (Alpinia galanga:) see कुलञ्जन. f. (-ला or -ली) 1 A species of Curcuma, (C. reclinata, Rox.) 2 The olibanum tree. E. गन्ध smell, and मूल a root, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्; also with कन् affix गन्धमूलक.
गन्धमूलक: गन्धमूलक m. (-कः) A sort of Curcuma; also गन्धमूली: see the preceding.
गन्धमूषिक: गन्धमूषिक mf. (-कः-का) The musk-rat or shrew, (Sorex moschata;) also in the fem. गन्धमृषी.
गन्धमृग: गन्धमृग m. (-गः) The civet-cat. E. गन्ध smell, and मृग a deer; the name also may be applied to the musk-deer.
गन्धमोदन: गन्धमोदन n. (-नं) Sulphur. E. गन्ध, and मोदन pleasing.
गन्धमैथुन: गन्धमैथुन m. (-नः) A bull. E. गन्ध smell, and मैथुन copulation.
गन्धमोहिनी: गन्धमोहिनी f. (-नी) The Champaca flower. E. गन्ध smell, and मोहिनी delighting.
गन्धरस: गन्धरस m. (-सः) Myrrh. E. गन्ध smell, and रस essence; also रसगन्ध.
गन्धराज: गन्धराज n. (-जं) 1 Sandal. 2 Any sweet smelling flower. f. (-जी) 1 A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi: see नखी. E. गन्ध smell, and राज what excels, from राज to shine, affix अच्; fem. affix ङीष्.
गन्धर्ब्ब: गन्धर्ब्ब m. (-र्ब्बः) 1 A Gandharba or celestial musician; these demigods inhabit INDRA'S heaven, and form the orchestra at all the banquets of the principal deities. 2 A horse. 3 A kind of deer; according to some authorities, the musk-deer. 4 The soul after death, and previous to its being born again, corresponding, in some respects, to the western notion of ghosts. 5 A singer in general. 6 The Koïl or black cuckoo. 7 The sun. 8 A sage, a pious man. E. गन्ध smell, injury, &c. अर्ब्ब to go, affix अच्, the अ final of गन्ध is rejected; the root is also sometimes written with the dental letter अर्व्व, when the compound will be गन्धर्व्व; the best authorities however write it with the final labial letter ब as above.
गन्धर्ब्बविद्या: गन्धर्ब्बविद्या f. (-द्या) Music, dancing, &c. E. गन्धर्ब्ब, and विद्या science.
गन्धर्ब्बविवाह: गन्धर्ब्बविवाह m. (-हः) Marriage by mutual consent, without any ceremonies, allowable between persons of the second class. E. गन्धर्ब्ब, and विवाह marriage.
गन्धर्ब्बवेद: गन्धर्ब्बवेद m. (-दः) The science of music considered as a branch of the Sāma Veda. E. गन्धर्ब्ब, and वेद a Veda.
गन्धर्ब्बहस्त: गन्धर्ब्बहस्त m. (-स्तः) The castor-oil tree, (Palma christi or Ricinus communis.) E. गन्धर्ब्ब a deer, and हस्त hand or foot; the leaves being compared to the foot of the deer; also with कन् added गन्धर्ब्बहस्तक.
गन्धलोलुपा: गन्धलोलुपा f. (-पा) A fly or gnat. E. गन्ध smell, &c. लोलुप unsteady.
गन्धवणिज्: गन्धवणिज् m. (-णिक्) A perfumer, a dealer in perfumes. E. गन्ध, and वणिज a dealer.
गन्धवत्: गन्धवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Scented, smelling, odoriferous. f. (-ती) 1 The earth. 2 The name of a city. 3 Wine or vinous liquor. 4 A kind of perfume: see मुरा. 5 The mother of VYĀSA. 6 A wild species of Ajväen: see यमानी. E. गन्ध smell, मतुप् poss. affix fem. ङीप्.
गन्धवल्कल: गन्धवल्कल n. (-लं) 1 Cassia bark. 2 Sarsaparilla. E. गन्ध, and वल्कल bark.
गन्धवल्लरी: गन्धवल्लरी f. (-री) A plant; also सहदेवी. E. गन्ध smell, and वल्लर a pedicle, or with वल्ली the same, गन्धवल्ली.
गन्धवह: गन्धवह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Smelling, fragrant, &c. m. (-हः) The wind. f. (-हा) The nose. E. गन्ध smell, and वह what conveys, from वह to bear, &c., and अच् aff.
गन्धवाह: गन्धवाह m. (-हः) 1 The wind. 2 A deer, the musk-deer. f. (-हा) The nose. E. गन्ध smell, वह to convey, and अण् aff.
गन्धवृक्ष: गन्धवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. गन्ध perfume, and वृक्ष a tree, yielding a fragrant resin.
गन्धव्याकुल: गन्धव्याकुल n. (-लं) A perfume, a fragrant berry: see कक्कोल. E. गन्ध smell, and व्याकुल disturbed.
गन्धशटी: गन्धशटी f. (-टी) A sort of Curcuma: see शटी. E. गन्ध smell, and शटी the same plant.
गन्धशालि: गन्धशालि m. (-लिः) A sweet smelling kind of rice. E. गन्ध, and शालि rice.
गन्धशुण्डिनी: गन्धशुण्डिनी f. (-नी) The musk-rat or shrew. E. गन्ध, and शुण्डिनी a rat; also गन्धाशुण्डिनी.
गन्धशेखर: गन्धशेखर m. (-रः) Musk. E. गन्ध, and शेखर chief, a principal perfume.
गन्धसार: गन्धसार m. (-रः) Sandal. E. गन्ध, and सार essence, the essence of perfume.
गन्धसूयी: गन्धसूयी f. (-यी) The musk shrew or small musk-rat. E. गन्ध smell, and सू to produce, affixes युक् and ङीप्; also sometimes read गन्धसुखी, from गन्ध and सुख pleasure.
गन्धसोम: गन्धसोम n. (-मं) The white esculent water lily. E. गन्ध smell, and सोम the moon; opening its petals at night.
गन्धहारिका: गन्धहारिका f. (-का) A female artisan working in another person's house.
गन्धाखु: गन्धाखु m. (-खुः) A musk-rat. E. गन्ध smell, and आखु a rat: see गन्धसूयी, &c.
गन्धाजीव: गन्धाजीव m. (-वः) A vender of perfumes. E. गन्ध, and आजीव who gets a livelihood.
गन्धाढ्य: गन्धाढ्य m. (-ढ्यः) The orange tree. f. (-ढ्या) A plant: see गन्धाली. E. गन्ध, and आढ्य wealth, rich in odour.
गन्धापकर्षण: गन्धापकर्षण n. (-णं) Removing any smell. E. गन्ध, and अपकर्षण taking away.
गन्धाला: गन्धाला f. (-ला) A plant, commonly Jiyati, (Celtis orientalis.)
गन्धाली: गन्धाली f. (-ली) 1 Gandhali or Gandbhadalīya, a plant, (Paederia fetida.) 2 A wasp: see गन्धोली. E. गन्ध smell, and आली a line, a quantity.
गन्धाश्मन्: गन्धाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) Sulphur. E. गन्ध smell, and अश्मन् a stone.
गन्धाष्टक: गन्धाष्टक n. (-कं) A class of eight fragrant articles used in worship, &c. as a Sandal, agallochum, camphor, saffron, valerian, and some fragrant grasses. E. गन्ध, and अष्टक eight collectively.
गन्धिक: गन्धिक m. (-कः) Sulphur. E. गन्ध smell, and ठक् affix; also गन्धक.
गन्धिन्: गन्धिन् mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि) Smelling, odoriferous. m. (-न्धी) 1 A bug; also the flying bug. 2 A tree, (Xanthophyllum virens.) f. (-नी) A kind of perfume: see Mura. E. गन्ध smelling, इनि poss. aff.
गन्धोतु: गन्धोतु m. (-तुः) The civet-cat. E. गन्ध smell, and ओतु a cat; also गन्धौतु.
गन्धोत्तमा: गन्धोत्तमा f. (-मा) Spirituous or vinous liquor. E. गन्ध odour, and उत्तम excellent.
गन्धोपजीविन्: गन्धोपजीविन् m. (-वी) A perfumer. E. गन्ध, and उपजीविन् who lives by.
गन्धोलि: गन्धोलि f. (-लिः or -ली) A kind of cucumber, (C. reclinata, Rox.) (-ली) 1 A wasp. 2 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गन्ध to smell or injure, ओलच affix, इन् or ङीष् fem. aff.
गभलि: गभलि mf. (-स्तिः) A ray of light, a sun or moon-beam. m. (-स्तिः) The sun. f. (-स्तिः) A name of SVĀHĀ the wife of AGNI. E. ग for गो the heaven, भस to shine, and क्तिच् aff.
गभस्तिमत्: गभस्तिमत् m. (-मान्) The sun. n. (-मत्) One of the seven divisions of Pātāla or regions below the earth. E. गभस्ति a ray of light, and मतुप् poss. aff.
गभस्तिहस्त: गभस्तिहस्त m. (-स्तः) The sun. E. गभस्ति a ray, and हस्त a hand; wielding the sun-beams.
गभीर: गभीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Deep. 2 Thick, impervious, (as a forest.) 3 Profound, sagacious. 4 Deep in sound, hollow-toned. E. गम to go, भ substituted for the final, ईरन् Uṇādi affix; also with नुम् inserted गम्भीर.
गभीरध्वनि: गभीरध्वनि m. (-निः) 1 Deep sound. 2 A low note or tone. E. गभीर, and ध्वनि sound; also गभीरनाद, गभीरशब्द, &c.
गभीरिका: गभीरिका f. (-का) 1 A large drum. 2 A gong. E. गभीर deep, (as sound,) कन् affix, and the fem. form.
गभोलिक: गभोलिक m. (-कः) A small round pillow.
गम: गम (औ, ऌ) औगसॢ r. 1st cl. (गच्छति) 1 To go, to move or approach. 2 To arrive at, to accomplish or attain. With अनु prefixed, To follow, to imitate. With आङ् (आगच्छति) 1 To come, to arrive. 2 To go to or unto. 3 (आगमयते) To wait, to delay. With अधि, 1 To obtain, to gain or acquire. 2 To go over, as a book or set of rules, to peruse, to learn. 3 To pass over, to omit. With अप, To go back or away, to separate. With अव, To know, to understand. With उत्, 1 To approach, to go near to. 2 To go up, to rise. With उप, 1 To produce. 2 To go near. 3 To consent to. With उप and आङ्, To approach. With दुर्, To go with difficulty. With नि, To acquire knowledge. With निर्, To go forth or out. With परि and उत्, To rise as from a seat, &c. With परि, 1 To surround. 2 To go away. With प्रति and आङ्, To return or arrive at. With वि, To go against as an enemy. With सम्, (संगच्छते) 1 To go with, to accompany. 2 To meet, to encounter. (संगच्छति) To go to, (in a transitive sense.) With सम and आङ् To meet, to unite. With सम and उप, To submit to, to yield. With सु, 1 To go easily or well. 2 To arrive at.

गम m. (-मः) 1 Going, moving. 2 March, especially the march of an assailant. 3 A road. 4 A game played with dice and men, as backgammon, &c. 5 Acting inconsiderately, looking at any thing hastily and superficially. 6 Reading lightly, hasty or careless perusal, running over a book, &c. E. गम to go, घञ् aff.
गमकारित्व: गमकारित्व n. (-त्वं) Rashness, inconsiderateness. E. गम as above, कारिन् who does or acts, and त्व abstract aff.
गमथ: गमथ m. (-थः) 1 A road. 2 A traveller. E. गम to go, अथ Uṇādi aff.
गमन: गमन n. (-नं) 1 Going in general. 2 March in general, or the march of an assailant. 3 Cohabitation. 4 Obtaining, attaining. E. गम to go or move, affix ल्युट्.
गमनार्ह: गमनार्ह m. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं) To be sought, fit, suitable, desirable. E. गमत, and अर्ह worthy.
गमनीय: गमनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 What may be gone to or reached, attainable, accessible. 2 What ought to be followed, to be practised or observed. E. गम, and अनीयर् aff.
गमयत्: गमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Causing or making to go. E. गम to go, causal form, शतृ aff.
गमागम: गमागम m. (-मः) Going and coming. E. गम, and आगम going.
गमित: गमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Caused to go, sent, brought, reduced, driven to, &c. E. गम to go, causal form, क्त aff.
गमिन्: गमिन् m. (-भी) A passenger. E. गम to go, इनि Uṇādi affix, otherwise with णिनि affix, गामिन्.
गम्ब: गम्ब r. 1st cl. (गम्बति) To go or move.
गम्भारी: गम्भारी f. (-री) The name of a tree, commonly called by the same name Gambhāri, (Gmelina arborea.) E. क water, भृ to nourish, affixes अण् and ङीष्, क is changed to ग and into the second case.
गम्भीर: गम्भीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Deep, (as water, but applied metaphorically to sound, intellect, &c. as in English.) 2 Dull, slow. m. (-रः) A Mantra or magical incantation written in prose in the Rig Veda. 2 A lotus. 3 The citron. f. (-रा) Hiccup, violent singultus. E. गम to go, ईरन् Uṇādi affix, म changed to भ, and नुम् inserted: see गभीर.
गम्भीरता: गम्भीरता f. (-ता) 1 Depth, (of water.) 2 Depth of thought, profoundness. 3 Depth of sound. E. गम्भीर, and तल् affix; also गम्भीरत्वं.
गम्भीरनाद: गम्भीरनाद m. (-दः) A deep or hollow sound, thundering, roaring, &c. E. गम्भीर, and नाद sound; also similar compounds, as गम्भीरध्वनि, गम्भीरशव्य; also with गभीर, गभीरनाद, &c.
गम्भीरवेदिन्: गम्भीरवेदिन् m. (-दी) A restive elephant. E. गम्भीर dull, and विद to know, affix णिनि.
गम्भीरार्थ: गम्भीरार्थ n. (-र्थं) Profound sense or meaning. E. गम्भीर, and अर्थ sense.
गम्य: गम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Attainable, accessible. 2 To be gone, to be gone to. 3 Perceptible. 4 Desirable, suitable, fit. E. गम to go, यत् aff.
गम्यता: गम्यता f. (-ता) 1 Accessibility. 2 Perceptibility. 3 Being capable of attainment. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, गन्यत्वं.
गम्यमान: गम्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) To be gone, to be traversed, to be gone to, &c. E. गम to go, passive v., शानच् aff.
गय: गय m. (-यः) 1 A species of ox, the Gayal or Bos Gavoeus. 2 The name of a royal or military saint. 3 The name of an Asura. 4 One of the monkey chiefs of the Rāmāyaṇa. f. (-या) Gaya, a city in Behār still so called, and a place of pilgrimage; the capital of the saint of the same name; it was made holy by the benediction of VIṢṆU, who granted its sanctity to the piety of Gaya the Rājarṣi; or according to another legend to Gaya the Asura, who was overwhelmed here by the deities with rocks; sacrifices should be offered once at least in the life of every Hindu to his progenitors at Gaya. E. गै to sing, डय aff.
गर: गर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 Poison. 2 An antidote. m. (-रः) Sickness, disease. n. (-रं) 1 Sprinkling, wetting. 2 The fifth of the eleven Karaṇas. f. (-रा) Swallowing. (-री) A species of grass, (Andropogon serratus); also गरागरी. E. गर to hurt, and अच् affix, or गृ to wet or sprinkle, or again गॄ to swallow, affix अप्.
गरघ्न: गरघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्ना-घ्नं) 1 Antidote, an antidote. 2 Sanative, healthy. m. (-घ्नः) A species of Basil. f. (-घ्नी) A fish (the young of the Ophiocephalus lata, HAM.) E. गर, and घ्न what destroys.
गरण: गरण n. (-णं) 1 Wetting, sprinkling. 2 Swallowing. E. गृ to wet, or गृ to swallow, affix ल्युट्.
गरद: गरद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 A poisoner, poisoning. 2 Unwholesome, occasioning sickness. n. (-दं) Poison. E. गर poison, and द who gives.
गरब्रत: गरब्रत m. (-तः) A peacock. E. गर sprinkling, (of rain,) and ब्रत religious observance.
गरभ: गरभ m. (-भः) The foetus or embryo: see गर्भ. E. गृ to drop, &c. अभच् aff.
गरल: गरल n. (-लं) 1 The venom of a snake or venom in general. 2 A bundle of grass, or hay. 3 Measure in general. E. गर poison, &c. and ल what gets or possesses.
गरलिन्: गरलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Venomous, poisonous. E. गरल, and इनि aff.
गरागरी: गरागरी f. (-री) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus:) see खरा and गरी; also अगरी.
गरात्मक: गरात्मक n. (-कं) The seed of the Śobhāñjana or Morunga. E. गर poison, and आत्मक nature.
गराधिका: गराधिका f. (-का) Lac, the animal red dye so called.
गरिमन्: गरिमन् m. (-मा) 1 Weight, heaviness. 2 Venerableness. E. गुरु and इमनिच् aff.
गरिष्ठ: गरिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Heaviest, excessively heavy. 2 Very venerable. E. गुरु heavy, इष्ठच् superlative affix, deriv. irr.
गरीयस्: गरीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) 1 Heaviest, very heavy. 2 Highly venerable. 3 Worst. E. see the last, affix ईयसुन्.
गरुड: गरुड m. (डः) The bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU; he is generally represented as a being something between a man and a bird, and considered as sovereign of the feathered race; he is the son of KAŚYAPA and VINATĀ, and younger brother of ARUṆA. E. गरुत् a wing, डी to fly, affix ड, and the त of the noun dropped, who flies like a bird, or गृ to moisten, and उडच् Uṇādi aff.
गरुडध्वज: गरुडध्वज m. (-जः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. गरुड, and ध्वज a symbol; whose symbol is GARUḌA.
गरुडरुत: गरुडरुत n. (-तं) A species of metre having four lines to the stanza, and sixteen syllables to each line.
गरुडाग्रज: गरुडाग्रज m. (-जः) ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun. E. गरुड, and अग्रज elder born; the elder brother of GARUḌA.
गरुडाङ्कित: गरुडाङ्कित n. (-तं) An emerald. E. गरुड GARUḌA, and अङ्किय marked.
गरुडाश्मन्: गरुडाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) An emerald. E. गरुड, and अश्मान् a stone: see the preceding.
गरुडोत्तीर्ण: गरुडोत्तीर्ण n. (-णं) The emerald. E. गरुत, and उत्तीर्ण passed over.
गरुत्: गरुत् m. (-रुत्) A wing. E. गृ to moisten, and उति Uṇādi aff.
गरुत्मत्: गरुत्मत् m. (-त्मान्) 1 The bird of VIṢṆU. 2 A bird in general. E. गरुत् a wing, and मतुप् poss. aff.
गरुद्योधिन्: गरुद्योधिन् m. (-धी) A quail. E. गरुत् a wing, and योधिन् who fights.
गर्ग: गर्ग m. (-र्ग) One of the ten principal Munis or saints, a son of BRAHMĀ. f. (गर्गी) Wife of GARGA. E. गृ to sprinkle, ग Uṇādi aff.
गर्गर: गर्गर m. (-रः) 1 A kind of fish, (Pimelodus gagora, HAM) f. (-री) 1 A churn. 2 A water vessel, a guglet. E. गर्ग an imitative sound, a guggling, and र what makes.
गर्गाट: गर्गाट m. (-टः) A kind of fish, (Pimelodus gagora, HAM.)
गर्गीय: गर्गीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) A descendant of GARGA. E. गर्ग, and छ aff.
गर्घ: गर्घ r. 1st cl. (गर्घति) To go or move.
गर्ज: गर्ज r. 10th cl. (गर्जयति) To sound. r. 1st cl. (गर्जति) To emit a deep or full sound, to sound as distant thunder, to roar as a lion, &c.
गर्ज n. (-र्जं) 1 The roaring of elephants. 2 The grumbling of clouds, &c. E. गर्ज to roar or growl, affix अच्.
गर्जक: गर्जक m. (-कः) A fish, commonly Gajar. E. गर्ज to grumble, affix वुन्.
गर्जन: गर्जन n. (-नं) 1 Sound, noise. 2 Passion, wrath. 3 Excessive indignation. 4 Reproach, menace. 5 War, battle, conflict. 6 The grumbling of clouds, &c. E. गर्ज to grumble or roar, affix ल्युट्.
गर्जनीय: गर्जनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be sounded or roared. E. गर्ज to sound, अनीयर् aff.
गर्जि: गर्जि m. (-र्जिः) The muttering of clouds or distant thunder. E. गर्ज to sound as thunder, कि aff.
गर्जित: गर्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sounded, roared, bellowed. m. (-तः) An elephant in rut. n. (-तं) The muttering of clouds or rolling of distant thunder. E. गर्ज to roar, &c. affix क्त.
गर्ज्य: गर्ज्य mfn. (-र्ज्यः-र्ज्या-र्ज्यं) To be roared or sounded. E. गर्ज to sound, ण्यत् aff.
गर्त: गर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A hole in general. 2 The hollow of the loins. 3 The name of a country; also त्रिगर्त्त, in the north-west of India. 4 A kind of disease. E. गृ to drop, Uṇādi affix तन्.
गर्त्त: गर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A hole in general. 2 The hollow of the loins. 3 The name of a country; also त्रिगर्त्त, in the north-west of India. 4 A kind of disease. E. गृ to drop, Uṇādi affix तन्.
गर्तिका: गर्त्तिका f. (-का) A weaver's workshop. E. गर्त्त a hole, affix ठन्, the weaver sits at his loom with his feet in a hollow or hole below. the level of the floor.
गर्त्तिका: गर्त्तिका f. (-का) A weaver's workshop. E. गर्त्त a hole, affix ठन्, the weaver sits at his loom with his feet in a hollow or hole below. the level of the floor.
गर्द: गर्द r. 1st and 10th cls. (गर्दति गर्दंयति) To sound, to roar.
गर्दभ: गर्द्दभ m. (-भः) 1 Smell, odour. 2 An ass. f. (-भी) 1 A she-ass. 2 An insect, a kind of beetle springing from cow dung. 3 A disease of the skin, eruption of round, red, and painful spots; also गर्दभिका. 4 A creeper, (Clitoria ternata.) n. (-भं) The white lotus. E. गर्द to sound, Uṇādi affix अभच्.
गर्द्दभ: गर्द्दभ m. (-भः) 1 Smell, odour. 2 An ass. f. (-भी) 1 A she-ass. 2 An insect, a kind of beetle springing from cow dung. 3 A disease of the skin, eruption of round, red, and painful spots; also गर्दभिका. 4 A creeper, (Clitoria ternata.) n. (-भं) The white lotus. E. गर्द to sound, Uṇādi affix अभच्.
गर्द्दभाजिन: गर्द्दभाजिन n. (-नं) The skin or hide of an ass. E. गर्द्दभ, and अजिन a skin.
गर्दभशाक: गर्द्दभशाक mf. (-कः-का) A plant, (Ovieda verticellata.) E. गर्द्दभ an ass, and शाक a vegetable.
गर्द्दभशाक: गर्द्दभशाक mf. (-कः-का) A plant, (Ovieda verticellata.) E. गर्द्दभ an ass, and शाक a vegetable.
गर्दभाण्ड: गर्द्दभाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of tree, commonly Pārspīpal, (Hibiscus populneoides) E. गर्द्दभ smell, अम to go, and ड aff.
गर्द्दभाण्ड: गर्द्दभाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of tree, commonly Pārspīpal, (Hibiscus populneoides) E. गर्द्दभ smell, अम to go, and ड aff.
गर्दभाह्वय: गर्द्दभाह्वय m. (-यः) The white lotus. E. गर्द्दभ smell, and आह्वय an appellation.
गर्द्दभाह्वय: गर्द्दभाह्वय m. (-यः) The white lotus. E. गर्द्दभ smell, and आह्वय an appellation.
गर्दभिका: गर्द्दभिका f. (-का) A cutaneous disease, a blotch, an eruption. E. कन् fem. form added to गर्द्धभ.
गर्द्दभिका: गर्द्दभिका f. (-का) A cutaneous disease, a blotch, an eruption. E. कन् fem. form added to गर्द्धभ.
गर्द्ध: गर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) 1 Eagerness, greediness. 2 The Pārspīpal: see गर्द्धभाण्ड. E. गृध to desire, to be greedy, affix घञ्.
गर्द्धन: गर्द्धन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Covetous, greedy. E. गृध to be greedy, affix युच्.
गर्द्धिन्: गर्द्धिन् mfn. (-र्द्धी-र्द्धिनी-र्द्धि) Greedy, covetous. E. गर्द्ध, and इनि aff.
गर्ध: गर्ध r. 10th cl. (गर्धयति) To desire or covet: see गृध.
गर्ब: गर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (गर्ब्बति) To move, to go or approach.
गर्ब्ब m. (-र्ब्बः) Pride, haughtiness. E. गर्ब्ब to be proud, अच् affix; also read गर्व्व.
गर्ब्ब: गर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (गर्ब्बति) To move, to go or approach.
गर्ब्ब m. (-र्ब्बः) Pride, haughtiness. E. गर्ब्ब to be proud, अच् affix; also read गर्व्व.
गर्ब्भ: गर्ब्भ m. (-र्ब्भः) A foetus, &c.: see the next. f. (-र्ब्भा) Interval of time, division of time or place.
गर्भ: गर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 A foetus or embryo. 2 A child. 3 The belly. 4 The inside, the middle. 5 Joining, union. 6 The rough coat of the fruit of the Jaka. 7 An inner apartment, a lying-in chamber. 8 Any interior chamber, the adytum of a temple, &c. 9 The bed of the Ganges, when the river is fullest; that is, on the fourteenth day of the dark half of the month Bhādra, or in the height of the rains; as high as the river flows at this period, so far extends the Garbha, after which the Tīra or proper bank begins, and extends for 150 cubits; this space is holy ground. 10 The calyx of the lotus. The interior or inner part of any thing. E. गृ to drop, or गॄ to swallow, Uṇādi affix भन्; also read गर्ब्भ.
गर्भक: गर्भक m. (-कः) A chaplet of flowers, &c. worn in the hair. n. (-कं) A period of a day and two nights. E. कन् added to the preceding.
गर्भकर: गर्भकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Impregnating, fecundatory, procreative, producing impregnation. m. (-रः) A plant, (Nagelia putranjiva.) E. गर्भ, and कर what makes.
गर्भकोश: गर्भकोश m. (-शः) The uterus. E. गर्भ, and कोश sheathe.
गर्भगृह: गर्भगृह n. (-हं) 1 An inner chamber. 2 A lying-in chamber. 3 The sanctuary or adytum of a temple. E. गर्भ, and गृह a house.
गर्भग्रहण: गर्भग्रहण n. (-णं) Conception, impregnation. E. गर्भ, and ग्रहण taking.
गर्भघातिन्: गर्भघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Producing abortion. E. गर्भ, and घातिन् what destroys.
गर्भचलन: गर्भचलन n. (-नं) Quickening, motion of the foetus in utero. E. गर्भ, and चलन moving.
गर्भच्युत: गर्भच्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bearing a child. 2 Miscarrying. E. गर्भ and च्युत falling.
गर्भच्युति: गर्भच्युति f. (-तिः) 1 Birth, delivery. 2 Miscarriage. E. गर्म, and च्युति falling.
गर्भण्ड: गर्भण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Enlargement of the navel. E. गर्भ the belly, and अण्ड an egg, the penultimate made short.
गर्भद: गर्भद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Impregnating, procreative. m. (-दः) A tree, (Nagelia putranjiva.) f. (-दा) A shrub so called. E. गर्भ a foetus, and द what gives, with reference to the supposed virtue of the plant; also गर्भदातृ (-ता-त्री-तृ).
गर्भद्रुह्: गर्भद्रुह् mfn. (-द्रुक् or द्रुट्) Causing abortion. E. गर्भ, and द्रुह what injures.
गर्भधारण: गर्भधारण n. (-णं) Impregnation, gestation. E. गर्भ, and धारण holding.
गर्भनाडी: गर्भनाडी f. (-डी) The umbilical cord. E. गर्भ, and नाडी a vessel.
गर्भपरिस्रव: गर्भपरिस्रव m. (-वः) Secundines. E. गर्भ, and परिस्रव what exudes.
गर्भपाकिन्: गर्भपाकिन् m. (-की) Rice ripening after two months.
गर्भपातक: गर्भपातक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Producing abortion. m. (-कः) A red kind of morunga. E. गर्भ the foetus, पत to fall, in the causal form, and वुञ् aff.
गर्भपातन: गर्भपातन n. (-नं) Producing abortion. f. (-नी) Any plant or drug supposed to have that effect. E. गर्भ, and पातन causing to fall.
गर्भपातिन्: गर्भपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Producing abortion. f. (-नी) A kind of potherb: see विशल्या. E. as in the last, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.
गर्भपोषण: गर्भपोषण n. (-णं) Gestation. E. गर्भ, and पोषण nourishing.
गर्भरूप: गर्भरूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) A child, an infant. E. गर्भ an embryo, and रूप form; also गर्भरूपकः.
गर्भवती: गर्भवती f. (-ती) A pregnant female. E. गर्भ a foetus, and मतुप् poss. aff.
गर्भशङ्कु: गर्भशङ्कु m. (-ङ्कः) A kind of vectis or instrument for extracting the dead foetus. E. गर्भ, and शङ्क, a probe.
गर्भशय्या: गर्भशय्या f. (-य्या) The uterus. E. गर्भ, and शय्या a bed.
गर्भस्थ: गर्भस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Situated in the womb. 2 Centrical, internal, within the centre of any thing. E. गर्भ, and स्थ what abides.
गर्भस्राव: गर्भस्राव m. (-वः) Abortion, miscarriage. E. गर्भ the embryo, and स्राव expulsion.
गर्भस्राविन्: गर्भस्राविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Producing or occasioning abortion. E. गर्भ, and स्राविन् what causes to issue.
गर्भागार: गर्भागार n. (-रं) 1 An inner and private room, the female apartments, the lying-in chamber. 2 The sanctuary of a temple, the chamber where the object of worship is placed. E. गर्भ the foetus, and आगार an abode, hence it is also applied to the womb: see गर्भाशय.
गर्भाधान: गर्भाधान n. (-नं) A ceremony performed prior to conception. E. गर्भ the embryo, and आधान taking, being supposed conducive to future impregnation.
गर्भाशय: गर्भाशय m. (-घः) The womb, the uterus. E. गर्भ the embryo, and आशय asylum or abode.
गर्भाष्टम: गर्भाष्टम m. (-मः) The eighth month of uterine gestation. 2 The eighth year reckoning from conception. E. गर्भ the foetus, and अष्टम eighth.
गर्भिणी: गर्भिणी f. (-णी) 1 A pregnant woman. 2 A plant, (Asclepias rosea.) E. गर्भ embryo, and इनि poss. affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
गर्भिण्यवेक्षण: गर्भिण्यवेक्षण n. (-णं) Midwifery, attendance and care of pregnant women and new born infants. E. गर्भिणी, and अवेक्षण care, looking to.
गर्भोपघातिनी: गर्भोपघातिनी f. (-नी) A cow (or female), miscarrying from going unseasonably. E. गर्भ the foetus, उप intensitive prefix, हन to destroy, affixes णिनि and ङीप्.
गर्मुटिका: गर्म्मुटिका f. (-का) A species of rice.
गर्म्मुटिका: गर्म्मुटिका f. (-का) A species of rice.
गर्मुत्: गर्म्मुत् f. (-म्मुत्) 1 A kind of grass. 2 Gold. 3 A reed. E. गॄ to swallow, &c. Uṇādi affix उति, and म inserted.
गर्म्मुत्: गर्म्मुत् f. (-म्मुत्) 1 A kind of grass. 2 Gold. 3 A reed. E. गॄ to swallow, &c. Uṇādi affix उति, and म inserted.
गर्व: गर्व्व r. 1st cl. (गर्व्वति) To be proud or haughty; also (ङ) गर्व्वङ् r. 10th cl. (गर्व्वयते) To grow proud.
गर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Pride, arrogance. E. गर्व्व to be proud, affix अच् or गॄ swallow, &c. and व Uṇādi affix; this word is sometimes written गर्ब्ब.
गर्व्व: गर्व्व r. 1st cl. (गर्व्वति) To be proud or haughty; also (ङ) गर्व्वङ् r. 10th cl. (गर्व्वयते) To grow proud.
गर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) Pride, arrogance. E. गर्व्व to be proud, affix अच् or गॄ swallow, &c. and व Uṇādi affix; this word is sometimes written गर्ब्ब.
गर्वर: गर्व्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty, arrogant. E. गॄ to reject, &c. Uṇādi affix स्वरच्.
गर्व्वर: गर्व्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty, arrogant. E. गॄ to reject, &c. Uṇādi affix स्वरच्.
गर्वाट: गर्व्वाट m. (-टः) A watchman, a doorkeeper, a sort of village constable, a headborough or beadle. E. गर्व्व pride, अट to go, and अच् aff.
गर्व्वाट: गर्व्वाट m. (-टः) A watchman, a doorkeeper, a sort of village constable, a headborough or beadle. E. गर्व्व pride, अट to go, and अच् aff.
गर्वित: गर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proud, haughty. 2 Conceited. E. गर्व्व pride, and इतच् aff.
गर्व्वित: गर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proud, haughty. 2 Conceited. E. गर्व्व pride, and इतच् aff.
गर्ह: गर्ह r. 1st and 10th cls. (गर्हति-ते गर्हयति) To blame, to censure, to despise or contemn.
गर्हण: गर्हण n. (-णं) Censuring, censure, blame, reproach. E. गर्ह to reprove, affix ल्युट्.
गर्हणीय: गर्हणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Censurable, contemptible, vile, bad. E. गह to abuse, अनीयर् aff.
गर्हा: गर्हा f. (-र्हा) Abuse, censure, reproach. E. गर्ह to revile, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
गर्हित: गर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Blamed, censured. 2 Contemned, despised. 3 Bad, vile. E. गर्ह to blame, क्त aff.
गर्ह्य: गर्ह्य mfn. (-र्ह्यः-र्ह्या-र्ह्यं) Low, vile, contemptible. E. गर्ह to abuse, affix यत्.
गर्ह्यवादिन्: गर्ह्यवादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Speaking ill, speaking vilely or inaccurately. E. गर्ह्य vile, and वादिन् who speaks.
गल: गल r. 1st cl. (गलति) 1 To eat. 2 To ooze; also (ङ्) गलङ् r. 10th cl. (गलयते) To drop, to ooze or distil. With अव prefixed, To fall, to fall down or off; With वि, 1 To go, to approach. 2 To bear or support.

गल m. (-लः) 1 The throat. 2 The resin of the Sal tree. 3 A reed, a large kind of the Saccharum cylindricum. 4 A rope. 5 A musical instrument. 6 A kind of fish, a small kind of cyprinus, a subgenus of that class, (Cyprinus garra, HAM.) E. गल to eat, to drop, &c. affix अच्, or गॄ to swallow, with अच्, गर, and र changed to ल.
गलक: गलक m. (-कः) A kind of fish. E. कन् added to the preceding.
गलकम्बल: गलकम्बल m. (-लः) A bull's dewlap. E. गल the neck, and कम्बल a soft substance as a blanket, &c.
गलगण्ड: गलगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Inflammation, enlargement of the glands of the neck. E. गल the throat, and गण्ड a swelling or boil.
गलग्रह: गलग्रह m. (-हः) 1 A sauce of fish ground up with salt, pepper, Ghee, &c. 2 A day on which a course of study is commenced, but immediately preceding a day on which study is prohibited. 3 The fourth lunation of the dark fortnight, the seventh, eighth, and ninth, the thirteenth and three days following. 4 Seizing any one by the throat, throttling, choking. E. गल the throat, and ग्रह what takes, &c.; also गलग्रहण.
गलत्: गलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) 1 Falling, dropping. 2 Oozing, trickling, flowing. 3 Melting. E. गल to flow, शतृ aff.
गलन: गलन n. (-नं) Melting, fusing. 2 Trickling, dropping, oozing. 3 Falling down or off. 4 Leaking. E. गल to drop, ल्युट् aff.
गलनीय: गलनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fusible, liquefiable, to be melted, &c. E. गल to melt, अनीयर् affix; also गलितव्य and गल्य.
गलन्तिका: गलन्तिका f. (-का) 1 A small pitcher. 2 A small water jar with a small hole in the bottom, from which the water drops upon a Liṅga or Tulasi plant, placed beneath. E. गड to drop, affix झच्, गडन्ति; कन् in the fem. form added, and ड changed to ल.
गलमेखला: गलमेखला f. (-ला) A thread worn round the neck, a necklace. E. गल the throat, and मेखला a girdle.
गलव्रत: गलव्रत m. (-तः) A peacock. E. गल the throat, व्रत holy observance; also the same as गरव्रत q. v. ल being substituted for र.
गलशुण्डिका: गलशुण्डिका f. (-का) The uvula or soft palate. E. गल the throat, and शुण्डिका the elephant's trunk, resembling it in being a pendulous, roundish, and fleshy substance.
गलस्तनी: गलस्तनी f. (-नी) A she goat. E. गल the throat, and लन the breast; some species of the Bengal goat have small fleshy processes, resembling nipples depending from the throat; also गलेस्तनी.
गलहस्त: गलहस्त m. (-स्तः) Throttling. E. गल, and हस्त the hand.
गलाङ्कुर: गलाङ्कुर m. (-रः) A disease of the throat, inflammation of the fauces, and enlargement of the tonsils. E. गल the throat, and अङ्कुर a new sprout.
गलाविल: गलाविल m. (-लः) A prawn or shrimp: see गङ्गाटेय. Some books read this गलानिल, and others गलानिक.
गलि: गलि m. (-लिः) A strong and lazy ox. E. गल to eat, and इन् affix; who is good for nothing but eating.
गलित: गलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Fallen, dropped. 2 Liquefied, melted. 3 Distilled, oozing, flowing. 4 Decayed, impaired. 5 Lost, deprived. 6 Untied, loosed. E. गल to drop, to ooze, affix क्त.
गलितकुष्ठ: गलितकुष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) Advanced and incurable leprosy, when the fingers and toes fall off. E. गलित, and कुष्ठ leprosy.
गलितदन्त: गलितदन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Toothless. E. गलित, and दन्त tooth.
गलितनख: गलितनख mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं) Having no nails. E. गलित, and नख the nail.
गलितनयन: गलितनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Blind. E. गलित, and नयन the eye.
गलेगण्ड: गलेगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of bird, (the Adjutant or Ardea argala.) E. गल the throat, in the seventh case, and गण्ड a boil; alluding to a pendulous fleshy purse hanging from the throat.
गलेस्तनी: गलेस्तनी f. (-नी) A she goat: see गलस्तनी.
गलू: गलू m. (-लूः) A sort of gem.
गल्भ: गल्भ r. 1st cl. (गल्भते) To be bold or confident.
गल्भ mfn. (-ल्भः-ल्भा-ल्भं) 1 Proud, haughty. 2 Confident, bold, audacious. E. गल्भ to be proud, &c. अच् affix, more commonly प्रगल्भ.
गल्या: गल्या f. (-ल्या) 1 A multitude of throats. 2 A quantity of a kind of grass, or ropes made of it. E. गल a throat, &c. य aff.
गल्ल: गल्ल m. (-ल्लः) The cheek. E. गल to eat, and ल affix; from ला to get or receive.
गल्लचातुरी: गल्लचातुरी f. (-री) A small round pillow to put underneath the cheek. E. गल्ल the cheek, and चातुर a pillow.
गल्वर्क: गल्वर्क m. (-र्कः) 1 A goblet, a vessel for drinking spirituous liquor. 2 Lapis lazuli. E. गल to drop, deriv. irr.
गल्ह: गल्ह r. 1st cl. (गल्हते) To blame, to censure or despise: see गर्ह.
गवय: गवय m. (-यः) 1 A species of ox, the Gayal, erroneously classed by Hindu writers amongst the kinds of deer, (Bos gavaeus.) 2 A monkey chief: the son of VAIVASVATA. f. (-यी) The female Gayal. E. गु to sound, and अय affix, form irregular; or गो a cow, and य from या to obtain, affix ड, resembling a cow.
गवराज: गवराज m. (-जः) A bull. E. गो a cow, affix अण्, गव relating to a cow, and राजन् king, chief; the more direct compound makes गोराज.
गवल: गवल m. (-लः) A wild buffalo. n. (-लं) Buffalo's horn. E. गु to sound, अलच् aff.
गवाक्ष: गवाक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 An air hole, a loop hole, a round window, a bull's eye, &c. 2 A monkey chief; one of the sons of VAIVASVATA. E. गो a ray of light, अक्ष to spread, affix घञ्, or गो an ox, and अक्ष an eye; ox-eyed. f. (-क्षी) A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.) 2 A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see अपराजिता. E. गो the earth, अक्ष to spread, affixes अण् and ङीप्.
गवाक्षजाल: गवाक्षजाल n. (-लं) A lattice, a jealousie, trellis-work. E. गवाक्ष, and जाल a net.
गवादन: गवादन n. (-नं) Pasture or meadow grass. f. (-नी) 1 A hay rack, a trough for holding grass out of which cattle feed. 2 A species of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus, or, according to some, C. coloquintida.) 3 A plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see the preceding. E. गो a cow, अदन food, fem. affix ङीप्.
गवालूक: गवालूक m. (-कः) The Gayal, (Bos gavaeus:) see गवय. E. गो a cow, लोक to see, with आङ् prefixed, deriv. irr; in appearance a cow.
गवाशन: गवाशन m. (-नः) An outcaste. E. गव, and अशन who eats, eating beef.
गवाह्निक: गवाह्निक n. (-कं) A day's feed for a cow. E. गो, and अह्निक daily.
गवीश्वर: गवीश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Owner of kine. E. गो a cow, ईश्वर a lord or master.
गवेडु: गवेडु m. (-डुः) A cloud. f. (-डुः) A kind of grain, (Coix barbata.) E. गो a cow or the earth, ण्ड to preserve, उ affix, or with कन् added गवेडुका; also गवेधु, &c.
गवेधु: गवेधु f. (-धुः) Coix barbata: see the preceding; also with कन् added गवेधुका.
गवेरुक: गवेरुक n. (-कं) Red chalk. E. गो light or colour, ईर to send, affix वुन्, and the penultimate changed to उ irregularly; also read गवेधुक.
गवेष: गवेष r. 10th cl. (गवेषयति) 1 To seek, to hunt for, to search or inquire. 2 To make an effort.
गवेषण: गवेषण nf. (-णं-णा) Research, inquiry after any thing, (physical or philosophical, &c.) E. गवेष to inquire, affix युच्.
गवेषित: गवेषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sought, inquired for. E. गवेष to search or hunt, affix क्त.
गवोद्घ: गवोद्घ m. (-द्घः) An excellent cow. E. गो a cow, and उद्घ implying excellence; the compound remains masculine.
गव्य: गव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 (Of or belonging to a cow, as milk, curds, &c.) 2 Proper or fit for cattle. nf. (-व्यं-व्या) A bowstring. f. (-व्या) 1 A multitude of cows. 2 A measure of two Kos: see गव्यूति. n. (-व्यं) A colouring substance, a yellow pigment or dye. E. गो a cow, &c. and यत् aff.
गव्यूत: गव्यूत nf. (-तं) 1 A Kos, a measure of length equal to 4000 cubits. 2 A measure of two Kos: see the next.
गव्यूति: गव्यूति mf. (-तिः) A measure of two Kos, a league measured by 2000 Dands or fathoms. E. गो the earth, यु to join, क्तिन् affix, deriv. irr.
गह: गह r. 10th cl. (गहयति) To be thick or impervious as a forest, &c.
गह m. (-हः) 1 A cave. 2 A forest. E. गह to be impervious, अच् aff.
गहन: गहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Impervious, inaccessible. n. (-नं) 1 A wood, a thicket. 2 A cave. 3 Pain, distress. E. गाह to tremble, &c. affix युच्, and the radical vowel made short; or गह to be thick, affix as before.
गहीय: गहीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to a cave or a thicket, deep, difficult of access, impervious. E. गह a thicket, छ aff.
गह्वर: गह्वर nf. (-रं-री) A cave, a cavern, a grotto, a recess in a rock or mountain, &c. n. (-रं) 1 A thicket, a wood. 2 Hypocrisy. 3 Weeping, crying, but not violently. m. (-रः) An arbour, a bower. E. गाह to be agitated, and ष्वरच् Uṇādi affix, the radical vowel made short.
गा: गा r. 1st cl. (ङ) गाङ् (गाते) To go, to go to or towards. r. 3rd cl. but restricted to the Vedas (जगाति) To praise.
गा f. (-गा) A verse or metrical composition. E. गै to sing, क and टाप् affix: see ग.
गाङ्ग: गाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Belonging or relating to the river Ganges. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A name of BHĪṢMA. E. गङ्गा the GAṄGĀ, अण् aff.
गाङ्गट: गाङ्गट m. (-टः) A prawn or shrimp. E. गाङ्ग relating to the Ganges, and अट what goes, form irr.; also गाङ्गाट or with कन् affix गाङ्गटक.
गाङ्गटेय: गाङ्गटेय m. (-यः) A shrimp or prawn. E. गङ्गा, अट to go, and ढक् affix; also गङ्गाटेय, and गाङ्काट, &c.
गाङ्गायनि: गाङ्गायनि f. (-निः) 1 A name of BHĪṢMA. 2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. गङ्गा the personified river, (as the wife of ŚANTANU, in the first instance, and mother of the hero; and in the second, as the receiver of KĀRTTIKEYA the son of ŚIVA, from AGNI, the god of fire,) and फिञ् patronymic aff.
गाङ्गेय: गाङ्गेय m. (-यः) 1 BHĪṢMA. 2 KĀRTTIKEYA: see the preceding. 3 The Hilsa or Illias fish, (Clupanodon ilisha, HAM.) n. (-यं) 1 Gold. 2 A grass: see कशेरु. 3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गङ्गा the Ganges, ढक् affix of descent, &c.
गाङ्गेरुकी: गाङ्गेरुकी f. (-की) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides, but it is variously described.) E. गाङ्ग Ganges water, ईर to go or grow, उकन् aff.
गाङ्गौघ: गाङ्गौघ n. (-घं) The current of the Ganges. E. गाङ्ग Gangetic, and ओघ heap.
गाढ: गाढ adv. n. (-ढं) adj. mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Excessive, much, very much, heavy, oppressive, &c. 2 Firm, strong. 3 Hard. 4 Close. E. गाह to agitate, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
गाढता: गाढता f. (-ता) 1 Firmness, hardness. 2 Excess. E. गाढ, and तल् affix; also with त्व, गाढत्वं.
गाढमुष्ठि: गाढमुष्ठि mfn. (-ष्ठिः-ष्ठिः-ष्ठि) Miserly, niggard, avaricious, closefisted. m. (-ष्ठिः) A scymitar, a large sacrificial knife. E. गाढ heavy or close, and मुष्ठि gripe.
गाणपत: गाणपत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Relating to GAṆEŚA, or the leader of a troop, &c. E. गणपति, and अण् aff.
गाणपत्य: गाणपत्य mfn. (-त्यः-ती-त्यं) Relating to GAṆAPATI or GAṆEŚA. m. (-त्यः) A worshipper of him. n. (-त्यं) 1 Worship of him. 2 Chieftainship, presidency. E. गणपति, and ष्यञ् aff.
गाणिक्य: गाणिक्य n. (-क्यं) An assembly of harlots. E. गणिका a whore, यञ् aff.
गाण्डिव: गाण्डिव mn. (-वः-वं) 1 The bow of ARJUNA. 2 Any bow; also गाण्डीव.
गाण्डीव: गाण्डीव mn. (-वः-वं) 1 The bow of ARJUNA. 2 Any bow. E. गाण्डि what affects the cheek, from गण्ड with इञ् affix, then व added, and इ final lengthened; or continuing short, गाण्डिव.
गाण्डीविन्: गाण्डीविन् m. (-बी) A name of ARJUNA. E. गाण्डीव ARJUNA'S bow, and इनि aff.
गातु: गातु mfn. (-तुः-तुः-तु) Angry, wrathful. m. (-तुः) 1 A Gandharba or celestial quirister. 2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo. 3 A large black bee. 4 A singer. E. गै to sing, Uṇādi affix तु.
गातृ: गातृ mf. (-ता-त्री) A male or female singer. E. गै to sing, तृच् aff.
गात्र: गात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The body. 2 The fore quarter of an elephant. 3 A limb, a member. E. गभ to go, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi affix, the radical final is rejected, and the vowel made long.
गात्रभङ्गा: गात्रभङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. गात्र the body, and भङ्गा what breaks or hurts.
गात्रमार्जनी: गात्रमार्जनी f. (-नी) A towel. E. गात्र, and मार्जनी a wiper.
गात्रसङ्कोचिन्: गात्रसङ्कोचिन् m. (-ची) The pole-cat, (Viverra putorius.) E. गात्र the body, and सङ्कोचिन् who draws up or contracts in order to spring upon prey.
गात्रसम्प्लव: गात्रसम्प्लव m. (-वः) A small bird, the diver. E. गात्र the body, and सम्प्लव who plunges, from सम् entirely, प्लुङ् to go, and अच् aff.
गात्रानुलेपनी: गात्रानुलेपनी f. (-नी) Fragrant unguents, &c. smeared upon the body, perfume for the person. E. गात्र the body, अनु upon, लिप to plaster or smear, and ल्युट् aff.
गात्रोत्सादन: गात्रोत्सादन n. (-नं) Cleaning the person with perfumes, &c. E. गात्र, and उत्सादन cleaning.
गाथक: गाथक m. (-कः) 1 A musician, a singer. 2 A chaunter of the Purāṇas or sacred poems. E. गै to sing, स्थकन् aff.
गाथा: गाथा f. (-था) 1 A verse, a stanza. 2 Metre, rhythm. 3 A song, a chaunt or verse to be chaunted or sung. 4 Prākṛta or any language not Sanscrit. 6 The same as the Arya Metre, in which the verse contains sixty syllabic instants, variously arranged. E. गै to sing, थन् Uṇādi aff.
गाथाकार: गाथाकार m. (-रः) A singer, a reciter. E. गाथा, कृ to make, अण् aff.
गाथिक: गाथिक m. (-कः) One who recites Gāthas, verses or hymns. E. गाथा, and ठक् aff.
गाध: गाध (ऋ) गाधृ r. 1st cl. (गधते) 1 To stand, to stay, to remain. 2 To seek, to search or inquire for. 3 To compile, string or heap together.
गाध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) Not very deep. m. (-धः) 1 Place, site. 2 Desire of gain, cupidity, covetousness. 3 Bottom, soundings. E. गाध to stand, &c. affix अच्.
गाधि: गाधि m. (-धिः) The name of a king, sovereign of Kanyakubja, father of VIŚVĀMITRA.
गाधिज: गाधिज m. (-जः) 1 A name of the celebrated saint VIŚVĀMITRA. E. गाधि as above, and ज born.
गाधिपुर: गाधिपुर n. (-रं) Kanyakubja the ancient Kanouj. E. गाधि a proper name, and पुर a city; the capital of GĀDHI.
गाधिभू: गाधिभू m. (-भूः) The saint VIŚVĀMITRA. E. गाधि, and भू born, the son of GĀDHI.
गाधेय: गाधेय m. (-यः) VIŚVĀMITRA. E. गाधि, and ढक् patronymick affix: see the preceding.
गान: गान n. (-नं) 1 Singing, song in general, or a song. 2 Sound. E. गै to sing, affix ल्युट्.
गानिनी: गानिनी f. (-नी) Orris root. E. गान song, इनि and ङीप् affixes; supposed to be of use in clearing the voice.
गानीय: गानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Musical. E. गान and छ aff.
गान्तु: गान्तु mfn. (-न्तुः-न्तुः-न्तु) A goer, a traveller, one who goes or moves. E. गम to go, Uṇādi affix तु, and the radical vowel made long.
गान्त्री: गान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A carriage drawn by oxen. E. गम to go, ष्ट्रन् affix, fem. do. ङीष्, and the pen. made long; also गन्त्रा.
गान्दिनी: गान्दिनी f. (-नी) 1 The river Ganges, or the goddess GAṄGĀ. 2 The mother of AKRŪRA. E. गो paradise, in the accusative case, द who gives, इनि, and ङीप् affs.
गान्दिनीसुत: गान्दिनीसुत m. (-तः) 1 A name of BHĪṢMA, &c. 2 AKRŪRA. E. गान्दिनी GAṄGĀ, and सुत a son: see गङ्गासुत.
गान्धर्ब्ब: गान्धर्ब्ब mfn. (-र्ब्बः-र्ब्बी-र्ब्बं-) Relating or belonging to a Gandharba. m. (-र्ब्बः) A heavenly quirister: see गन्धर्ब्ब. n. (-र्ब्बं) 1 Song, singing. 2 A form of marriage, that which requires only mutual and amorous agreement. E. गन्धर्ब्ब a Gandharba, and अण् aff.
गान्धार: गान्धार m. (-रः) 1 One of the seven primary notes of music. 2 Minium or red lead. 3 A country, (Kandahar, between the north of India and Persia.) n. (-रं) Gum myrrh. f. (-री) 1 The wife of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA, mother of DURYODHANA. 2 One of the tutelary female deities of the Jainas. 3 A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) 4 Prickly nightshade. E. गान्ध the aggregate of गन्ध smell, &c. ऋ to go, and अण् affix; the note being said to be produced by pure and fragrant breath, &c.
गान्धारेय: गान्धारेय m. (-यः) A name of DURYODHANA, the son of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. गान्धारी the name of the mother of this chief, and ढक् aff.
गान्धिक: गान्धिक m. (-कः) 1 A scribe, a clerk. 2 A vender of perfumes, a perfumer. 3 A kind of worm, having a strong fetid smell. E. गन्ध smell, and ठञ् aff.
गामुक: गामुक mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं) Going, locomotive. E. गम to go, उकञ् aff.
गाम्भीर्य: गाम्भीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Depth, (of water, sound, &c.) 2 The deep sound of the voice of a Jaina saint, like distant thunder or the muttering of clouds. E. गम्भीर deep, affix ष्यञ् or ज्य.
गाम्भीर्य्य: गाम्भीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Depth, (of water, sound, &c.) 2 The deep sound of the voice of a Jaina saint, like distant thunder or the muttering of clouds. E. गम्भीर deep, affix ष्यञ् or ज्य.
गायक: गायक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Singing, one who sings. m. (-कः) A singer. E. गै to sing, ण्वुल् aff.
गायत्: गायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Singing. E. गै to sing, affix शतृ.
गायत्रिन्: गायत्रिन् m. (-त्री) A tree that yields the resin formerly called Terra Japonica, (Mimosa catechu;) also गायत्री fem. noun, as below.
गायत्री: गायत्री f. (-त्री) 1 A measure of verse in the Vedas, a stanza usually of twenty-four syllables, variously arranged, but most commonly in three lines. 2 A sacred verse from the Vedas to be recited only mentally; this is usually personified and considered as a goddess, the wife of BRAHMĀ; the metaphorical mother of the three first classes, in their capacity of twice born, investiture with the sacred and distinguishing string, &c. being regarded as a new birth; there is but one Gāyatrī of the Vedas, but according to the system of the Tāntrikas, a number of mystical verses are called Gāyatrīs; each deity has one in particular. 3 A kind of mimosa, (M. catechu:) see the preceding, &c. E. गायन् who sings, and त्रै to preserve, affixes क and ङीष्; this applies especially to the mystical verse, the repetition of which is necessary for salvation; the word is also written गायत्त्री.
गायन: गायन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Singing, a singer. m. (-नः) 1 A singer. 2 A chatterer, a gossip. n. (-नं) 1 Singing. 2 Professing or practising singing as a livelihood. E. गै to sing, aff. ल्युट्.
गारित्र: गारित्र m. (-त्रः) Rice, grain, corn. E. ग to swallow, Uṇādi affix णित्रन.
गारुड: गारुड m. (-डः) 1 Gold. 2 A Mantra or charm against poison. 3 An emerald. E. गरुड the vehicle of VIṢṆU, and अण् affix; of or relating to GARUḌA.
गारुडिक: गारुडिक m. (-कः) A charmer, a dealer in antidotes. E. गारुड the mantra of GARUḌA, or a charm against venom, and ठक् aff.
गारुत्मत्: गारुत्मत् n. (-त्) The emerald. E. गरुत्मत् GARUḌA, and अण् affix; derived from or relating to GARUḌA; the gem is supposed to be generated from his voided phlegm.
गार्ग: गार्ग्ग mfn. (-र्ग्गः-र्ग्गी-र्ग्गं) Descended from the age GARGA. E. गर्ग्ग, and अण् aff.
गार्ग्ग: गार्ग्ग mfn. (-र्ग्गः-र्ग्गी-र्ग्गं) Descended from the age GARGA. E. गर्ग्ग, and अण् aff.
गार्गक: गार्गक n. (-कं) A multitude of the descendants of the saint GARGA. E. गार्ग a descendant of GARGA, and वुञ् affix of multitude; also with ठञ्, गार्गिक.
गार्गीपुत्रकायनि: गार्गीपुत्रकायनि m. (-निः) A descendant of the son of GĀRGĪ. E. गार्गी the wife of the saint GARGA, पुत्र a son, and फिञ् affix, कुक् augment; also without the augment गार्ग्गीपुत्रायनि, or with इञ् affix, गार्ग्गीपुत्रि.
गार्ग्ग्य: गार्ग्ग्य mfn. (-र्ग्ग्यः-र्ग्ग्यी-र्ग्ग्यं) Descended from GARGA, son, daughter, &c. E. गर्ग्ग, and ष्यञ् aff.
