गार्द्ध: गार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं) 1 Derived from a vulture. 2 Greedy. m. (-द्धः) 1 Desire, greediness, cupidity. 2 An arrow. E. गृध greedy, affix अण् or गृध्र with अण् affix, and र rejected optionally.
गार्द्ध mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धी-र्द्धं) Derived from a vulture. E. गृध्र, and अण् aff.
गार्द्धपक्ष: गार्द्धपक्ष m. (-क्षः) An arrow. E. गार्द्ध, and पक्ष a wing; formed with vulture's feathers.
गार्द्धपक्ष m. (-क्षः) An arrow. E. गार्द्ध, and पक्ष a wing.
गार्द्धपत्र: गार्द्धपत्र m. (-त्रः) An arrow. E. as before, पत्र a leaf, a wing.
गार्द्ध्य: गार्द्ध्य n. (-र्द्ध्यं) 1 Greediness. 2 Desire. E. गृध greedy, यञ् aff.
गार्भ: गार्भ mfn. (-र्भः-र्भी-र्भं) 1 Uterine, fœtal. 2 Relating to conception, (any act or ceremony, &c.) E. गर्भ, and अण् aff.
गार्भिक: गार्भिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Foetal, uterine. 2 Relating to or connected with gestation or the foetus in utero. E. गभ, and ठञ् aff.
गार्भिण: गार्भिण n. (-णं) A number of pregnant women. E. गर्भिणी a pregnant woman, and अण् aff.
गार्भिण्य: गार्भिण्य n. (-ण्यं) An assembly of pregnant women. E. गर्भिणी as above, and यञ् aff.
गार्हपत्य: गार्हपत्य m. (-त्यः) A sacred fire perpetually maintained by a householder, received from his father, and transmitted to his descendants, and from which fires for sacrificial purposes are lighted. E. गृहपति a householder, (from गृह a house, and पति master,) and ज्य referential aff.
गार्हस्थ्य: गार्हस्थ्य n. (-स्थ्यं) The order or estate of a householder. E. गृहस्थ, and यञ् aff.
गाल: गाल m. (-लः) 1 Flowing, liquefying. 2 Flowing, dropping. 3 A flux. E. गल to flow, घञ् aff.
गालन: गालन n. (-नं) 1 Straining fluids. 2 Fusing, liquefying, &c. E. गल् to flow, causal form, affix ल्युट्.
गालव: गालव m. (-वः) 1 A tree, the bark of which is used in dying, Lodh, (Symplocus racemosa, Rox.) 2 A pale species of the same: see लोध्र. 3 A kind of ebony; also केन्दुक, (Diospyros glutinosa.) 4 A particular Muni or saint, a disciple of VIŚVĀMITRA. E. गाल flux, and ब what prevents; referring to the astringent qualities of the Lodh.
गालि: गालि m. (-लिः) A curse, execration or imprecation. E. गल in the causal form, to cause to drop, and इन् aff.
गालित: गालित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Melted, fused. 2 Strained. 3 Distilled, dropped. E. गल to drop, causal form, क्त aff.
गालिन्: गालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Fusing, liquefying. 2 Distilling. 3 Abusive, abusing. f. (-नी) A particular gesticulation or Madrā. E. गल to flow, causal form, णिनि aff.
गालोड्य: गालोड्य n. (-ड्यं) The seed of the lotus.
गाह: गाह (ऊ) गाहू r. 1st cl. (गाहते) 1 To churn, to stir or agitate. 2 To penetrate. 3 To destroy. With अव or वि prefixed, To bathe, to perform ablutions. With वि, To shake, to agitate.
गाहित: गाहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, trembling. 2 Destroyed. 3 Plunged into, immersed. E. गाह to agitate, क्त aff.
गाहितृ: गाहितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) 1 Shaking, agitating. 2 Destroying, a destroyer. 3 One who plunges into water, bathes, dives, &c. E. गाह to agitate, तृच् aff.
गिर्: गिर् f. (-गीः) 1 Speech, speaking. 2 A name of SARASVATĪ the goddess of speech. 3 Fame, celebrity. E. गॄ to sound, affix क्विप्, ॠ is changed to इर्.
गिरण: गिरण n. (-णं) Swallowing. E. गॄ to swallow, ल्युट् aff.
गिरा: गिरा f. (-रा) Speech. E. गॄ to sound, क, and टाप् affs.
गिरि: गिरि mfn. (-रिः-रिः-रि) Venerable, respectable, worshipful. m. (-रिः) 1 A mountain, a hill. 2 A wooden ball with which children play. 3 A disease of the eyes. f. (-रिः) 1 Swallowing. 2 A small rat, a mouse. 3 A title given to one order of the Dāsnāmī Gosains. E. गॄ to swallow, &c. इ Uṇādi aff.
गिरिकण्टक: गिरिकण्टक m. (-कः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. गिरि a mountain, and कण्टक a thorn, tearing or splitting rocks.
गिरिकदम्ब: गिरिकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) A species of Kadamba, (Nauclea cadamba.) E. गिरि, and कदम्ब the same.
गिरिकन्दर: गिरिकन्दर m. (-रः) A cave, a cavern. E. गिरि, and कन्दर a cave.
गिरिकदली: गिरिकदली f. (-ली) A species of plantain growing in hilly countries. E. गिरि, and कदली a plantain.
गिरिकर्णिका: गिरिकर्णिका f. (-का) The earth. E. गिरि a mountain, and कर्ण an ear, affixes कन् and टाप्; the mountain-eared.
गिरिकर्णी: गिरिकर्णी f. (-र्णी) 1 A plant, commonly Javāsa, (Hedysarum alhaji.) 2 A different plant, (Clitoria ternatea:) see अपराजिता. E. गिरि a mouse, and कर्णी an ear, affix ङीष्, the mouse-earleaved.
गिरिका: गिरिका f. (-का) A small rat, a mouse. E. कन् added to गिरि the same.
गिरिकाण: गिरिकाण m. (-णः) A blind or one-eyed man, one blind from a particular disease. E. गिरि as above, and काण one-eyed.
गिरिगुड: गिरिगुड m. (-डः) A ball for playing with. E. गिरि, and गुड, each meaning the same thing, a ball.
गिरिज: गिरिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mountain-born, mountaineer, &c. m. (-जः) The Mahwa tree, (Bassia.) f. (-जा) 1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ, as the daughter of the personified HIMĀLA mountain. 2 The Shaddock or pamplemouse, (Citrus decumana.) 3 A plant considered as a white species of Rasnā: see रास्ना. 4 The hill plantain. 5 Jasmine. 6 A pebble, a small stone. n. (-जं) 1 Talc. 2 Benzoin or gum benjamin; it is also confounded with styrax, another gum resin. 3 Bitumen. 4 Iron. E. गिरि, and ज born.
गिरिजामल: गिरिजामल n. (-लं) Talc. E. गिरिज mountain-born, and अमल clear, clean; also गिरिज, and अमल severally.
गिरिज्वर: गिरिज्वर m. (-रः) The thunderbolt. E. गिरि a mountain, and ज्वर what burns.
गिरित: गिरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eaten. 2 Swallowed. E. गॄ to swallow, affix क्त; also गिलित.
गिरिदुर्ग: गिरिदुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A hill fort or any strong hold amongst mountains. E. गिरि, and दुर्ग a place of difficult access.
गिरिधातु: गिरिधातु m. (-तुः) Red chalk. E. गिरि, and धातु a mineral.
गिरिध्वज: गिरिध्वज m. (-जः) A thunderbolt. E. गिरि, and ध्वज a banner.
गिरिपुष्पक: गिरिपुष्पक n. (-कं) Bitumen. E. गिरि, and पुष्प a flower; कन् affix of similitude.
गिरिपृष्ठ: गिरिपृष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) The top of a hill. E. गिरि, and पृष्ठ back.
गिरिप्रिय: गिरिप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fond of or frequenting mountains. f. (-या) The Yak. E. गिरि, and प्रिय fond of.
गिरिमल्लिका: गिरिमल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, (Echites antidysenterica:) see कुटज. E. गिरि a mountain, and मल्ली a jasmin, कन् affix of similitude.
गिरिमान: गिरिमान m. (-नः) A large and powerful elephant. E. गिरि a mountain, and मान measure, like a mountain in bulk.
गिरिभिद्: गिरिभिद् m. (-भित्) A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.) E. गिरि, and भिद् what breaks.
गिरिभू: गिरिभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Mountaineer, mountain-born. f. (-भूः) PĀRVATĪ. m. (-भूः) A small stone. E. गिरि, and भू born.
गिरिमृत्: गिरिमृत् f. (-मृत्) 1 Red chalk. 2 Mountain-soil. E. गिरि a mountain, and मृत् clay, earth.
गिरिमृद्भव: गिरिमृद्भव n. (-वं) Red chalk. E. गिरिमृत्, and भव produced.
गिरिमेद: गिरिमेद m. (-दः) A foetid mimosa. E. गिरि, and मेद filth.
गिरियक: गिरियक m. (-कः) A ball for playing with. E. गिरि a ball, घ pleonastic affix, and कन् added; also गिरियाक the pen, being lengthened.
गिरियाक: गिरियाक m. (-कः) A ball: see the preceding.
गिरिवासिन्: गिरिवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Living in the mountains, being or produced in them. m. (-सी) A large kind of Arum. E. गिरि, and वासिन् what abides.
गिरिश: गिरिश m. (-शः) A name of ŚIVA. E. गिरि a mountain, and शीङ् to sleep, affix ड; inhabiting mount Kailāsa, or frequenting the Himāla range.
गिरिशालिनी: गिरिशालिनी f. (-नी) A plant, (Clitoria ternatea.) E. गिरि, and शालिनी what grows in.
गिरिशृङ्ग: गिरिशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 The peak of a mountain. E. गिरि a mount, and शृङ्ग a peak, alluding to his bulk, or गिरि the mountain Kailāsa, and शृङ्ग chief.
गिरिसार: गिरिसार m. (-रः) 1 The Malaya mountains, situated in the south of India. 2 Iron. 3 Tin. E. गिरि a mountain, and सार essence.
गिरिसुता: गिरिसुता f. (-ता) PĀRVATĪ. E. गिरि Himālaya, and सुता daughter.
गिरीश: गिरीश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A name of Himāla, the snowy mountains on the north of Hindustan, or the range personified. 3 A name of VṚHASPATI. E. गिरि a mountain, (or in the last meaning, गिर् speech,) and ईश lord.
गिल: गिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Who or what swallows. m. (-लः) 1 The citron. 2 Swallowing. E. गॄ to swallow, affix क, and र changed to ल.
गिलग्राह: गिलग्राह m. (-हः) A shark. E. गिल, and ग्राह who seizes, who swallows.
गिलत्: गिलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Swallowing, eating, devouring. E. गै to swallow, शतृ aff.
गिलन: गिलन n. (-नं) Swallowing; also गिरण. E. as before; र changed to ल.
गिलि: गिलि f. (-लिः) 1 Swallowing. 2 Eating. E. see गिरि, र being changed to ल.
गिलित: गिलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Eaten. 2 Swallowed. E. गॄ to swallow, affix क्त, गिरित, and र changed to ल.
गिष्ण: गिष्ण m. (-ष्णः) 1 A Brahman versed in the Sāma Veda, a chanter of that Veda, which is always to be so recited. 2 An actor, a professional singer. E. गै to sing, डिष्ण Uṇādi aff.
गीत: गीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sung, chaunted, sounded, &c. f. (-ता) A name often applied to books, as the Śiva Gītā, Rāma Gītā, Gītā Govinda, Bhagavad Gītā, which last is also often called Gītā only. n. (-तं) Singing, song either general or particular. E. गॄ to sing, affix क्त.
गीतमोदिन्: गीतमोदिन् m. (-दी) A Kinnara or celestial chorister. E. गीत song or singing, and मोदिन् who delights.
गीति: गीति f. (-तिः) 1 Song, singing. 2 A kind of poetical metre, a form of the Ārya metre, in which the stanza consists of four lines of twelve and eighteen syllabic instants alternately. E. गै to sing, affix क्तिन्.
गीरथ: गीरथ m. (-थः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. गी speech, and रथ a car, the conveyer of words.
गीर्ण: गीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Praised. 2 Swallowed. E. गॄ to swallow or make known, affix क्त.
गीर्णि: गीर्णि f. (-र्णिः) 1 Swallowing. 2 Fame, celebrity. 3 Praise, applause. E. गॄ to swallow, &c. affix क्तिन्.
गीर्देवी: गीर्देवी f. (-वी) The goddess SARASVATĪ. E. गी speech, and देवी a goddess, the goddess of language.
गीर्वाण: गीर्व्वाण m. (-णः) A deity, a god. E. गीः speech, and वाण an arrow or weapon in general, whose fiat or word is his weapon; or गी with वन to desire, affix अन्, desiring hymns, prayers, &c. it is also written गीर्ब्बाण.
गीर्व्वाण: गीर्व्वाण m. (-णः) A deity, a god. E. गीः speech, and वाण an arrow or weapon in general, whose fiat or word is his weapon; or गी with वन to desire, affix अन्, desiring hymns, prayers, &c. it is also written गीर्ब्बाण.
गीष्पति: गीष्पति m. (-तिः) 1 A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER and preceptor of the gods. 2 A Paṇḍita or learned teacher. E. गिर् speech, in the nominative case, गीः and पति master, Visarga becomes स and स is here changed irregularly to ष; the compound however is sometimes written differently, thus गीःपति, गीर्पति or गीस्पति.
गु: गु (ओ, शि) r. 6th cl. (गुवति) To stool, to void excrement. (ङ) गुङ् r. 1st cl. (गवते) To sound inarticulately.
गुग्गुल: गुग्गुल m. (-लः) A gum resin: see the next.
गुग्गुलु: गुग्गुलु m. (-लुः) 1 A fragrant gum resin, Bdellium or the exudation of the Amyris agallochum. 2 A species of morunga, (M. hyperanthera.) E. गुज् (here said to mean) disease, and गुड to perfume, affixes क and उ, ड changed to ल; also गुग्गुल.
गुच्छ: गुच्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 A cluster of blossoms. 2 A clump of grass. 3 A necklace of thirty-two strings. 4 A pearl necklace. 5 A peacock's plumage or bundle of peacock's feathers. 6 A bundle. f. (-च्छी) A species of Bonduc: see करञ्ज. E. गु to sound, छ affix, or गुध to play, and च्छक् affix, where bees, &c. sport.
गुच्छक: गुच्छक m. (-कः) 1 A cluster of blossoms. 2 A clump of grass. 3 A kind of necklace. 4 A peacock's plumage, a bundle of peacock's feathers. E. कन् added to the preceding; also गुत्सक.
गुच्छपत्र: गुच्छपत्र m. (-त्रः) The palm tree. E. गुच्छ a cluster, and पत्र a leaf.
गुच्छफला: गुच्छफला m. (-ला) 1 The plaintain. 2 The vine. E. गुच्छ a cluster, and फल fruit.
गुच्छार्द्ध: गुच्छार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A necklace of thirty-four strings. E. गुच्छ a large necklace, and अर्द्ध a part; also गुत्सार्द्ध.
गुच्छाल: गुच्छाल m. (-लः) A species of grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) E. गुच्छ, and अल to be fit for, अच् aff.
गुज: गुज r. 1st cl. (गोजति) or (शि) r. 6th cl. गुजति) or (इ) गुजि r. 1st cl. (गुञ्जति) To sound, to sound inarticulately, to buzz, to hum, &c.
गुज्जरी: गुज्जरी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs, perhaps more correctly गुर्ज्जरी.
गुञ्ज: गुञ्ज m. (-ञ्जः) A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay. f. (-ञ्जा) 1 A small shrub, (Abrus precatorius,) bearing a red and black berry, which forms the smallest of the jeweller's weights. 2 The berry which averages about 1(5/16) grains troy, or the artificial weight called by this name, weighing about 2(3/16) grains: see रक्तिका, &c. 3 A kettle drum. 4 A low murmuring sound. 5 A tavern. 6 Reflection, meditation. E. गुजि to sound, affix क; where the bees buzz.
गुञ्जकृत्: गुञ्जकृत् m. (-त्) A large black bee. E. गुञ्ज a low tone, and कृत् who makes.
गुञ्जत्: गुञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत्) Buzzing, humming, making a low murmuring sound. E. गुजि to sound, शतृ aff.
गुञ्जन: गुञ्जन n. (-नं) Sounding low and deep, as buzzing, murmuring, &c. E. गुजि to sound, and ल्युट् aff.
गुञ्जिका: गुञ्जिका f. (-का) The Ratti or Gunja seed, considered as equal to three barley corns: see गुञ्जा. E. गुञ्जा, and कन् aff.
गुञ्जित: गुञ्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Uttered in a low tone, murmured, &c. n. (-तं) Sounding, murmuring, buzzing. E. गुजि, and क्त aff.
गुटिका: गुटिका f. (-का) 1 A pill, a bolus, any small globe or ball. 2 A small pustule. 3 The cocoon of the silk worm. E. गुड to surround, affix क्वुन्, ड changed to ट.
गुठ: गुठ (इ) गुठि r. 10th cl. (गुण्ठयति) To surround, to envelope or enclose: with अव, to veil, to screen.
गुड: गुड (शि) r. 6th cl. (गुडति) To defend, to guard or preserve. (इ) गुडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (गुण्डति गुण्डयति) 1 To surround, to enclose. 2 To pound, to grind, to reduce to powder. 3 (According to some authorities,) To preserve.

गुड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) Round, globular. m. (-डः) 1 A globe or ball. 2 Treacle, molasses, the first thickening of the juice of the cane by boiling. 3 An elephant's trappings or armour. 4 A mouthful. f. (-डा) 1 A plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli:) see स्नुही. 2 Powder, pounded substance. E. गुङ् to sound, affix ड.
गुडक: गुडक m. (-कः) A conserve, a drug prepared with treacle. n. (-कं) Treacle. E. गुड, and कन् added.
गुडकरी: गुडकरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the musical modes.
गुडची: गुडची f. (-ची) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडुची.
गुडतृण: गुडतृण n. (-णं) Sugar cane. E. गुड raw sugar, and तृण grass.
गुडत्वच्: गुडत्वच् n. (-त्वक्) The aromatic bark of the Laurus cassia. E. गुड sugar, and त्वच् skin, bark, sweet-bark; also गुडत्वच.
गुडत्वच: गुडत्वच n. (-चं) 1 Mace. 2 Cassia bark. E. गुड sugar, sweet as sugar, त्वच् bark, and अच् added in this form of the compound.
गुडदारु: गुडदारु m. (-रुः) Sugar cane. E. गुड raw sugar, and दारु wood.
गुडधेनु: गुडधेनु f. (-नुः) Sugar piled up for distribution at certain religious rites. E. गुड, and धेनु a cow.
गुडपिष्ट: गुडपिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) A sort of sweetmeat, flour or rice and sugar, ground and boiled together. E. गुड, and पिष्ट ground.
गुडपुष्प: गुडपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A kind of bassia, (B. latifolia.) E. गुड sugar, and पुष्प flower; the flowers being full of saccharine matter.
गुडफल: गुडफल m. (-लः) A tree, commonly Pilu, (Careya arborea, &c.:) see पीलु. E. गुड, and फल fruit, the fruit yielding Gur or saccharine matter.
गुडमिश्र: गुडमिश्र n. (-श्रं) A sort of cake or sweetmeat, flour or rice and coarse sugar ground and boiled together. E. गुड, and मिश्र mixed.
गुडमूल: गुडमूल m. (-लः) A kind of amaranth, (A. polygamus;) also अल्पमारिष. E. गुड, and मूल root; having a root as sweet as Gur.
गुडल: गुडल n. (-लं) A spirituous liquor distilled from molasses, a sort of rum. E. गुड sugar, and ल what requires.
गुडशर्करा: गुडशर्क्करा f. (-रा) Sugar, refined sugar. E. गुड molasses, and शर्क्करा sugar or sand.
गुडशर्क्करा: गुडशर्क्करा f. (-रा) Sugar, refined sugar. E. गुड molasses, and शर्क्करा sugar or sand.
गुडशिग्रु: गुडशिग्रु m. (-ग्रुः) A red sort of morunga: see शोभाञ्जन. E. गुड sugar, शिग्रु morunga.
गुडाकेश: गुडाकेश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A title of ARJUNA. E. गुडा Euphorbia, and केश the hair; the hair forming matted locks, resembling in shape the leaves of the Euphorbia: again, गुडाका sloth, and ईश paramount; subduing indolence.
गुडाशय: गुडाशय m. (-यः) A mountain Pilu: see गुडफल.
गुडिका: गुडिका f. (-का) A pill, a bolus. E. गुड to be round, वुन् aff.
गुडुची: गुडुची f. (-ची) A plant: see the next.
गुडूची: गुडूची f. (-ची) A creeper, commonly called Guricha, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. गुड to preserve, (from disease,) ऊचट् affix; also with the pen. vowel short गुडुची.
गुडेर: गुडेर m. (-रः) A mouthful. E. गुड to surround, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
गुडेरक: गुडेरक m. (-कः) A mouthful. E. गुड to preserve, एरक् affix, and कन् added; also गुडेर.
गुडोद्भवा: गुडोद्भवा f. (-वा) Sugar. E. गुड, and उद्भव produced.
गुडौदन: गुडौदन m. (-नं) Boiled rice and coarse sugar. E. गुड, and ओदन rice.
गुण: गुण r. 10th cl. (गुणयति) 1 To invite. 2 To advise. 3 To multiply.

गुण m. (-णः) 1 A quality, attribute, or property in general. 2 A property of all created things; three are particularized, the Sattva, Raja, and Tama, or principles of truth or existence, passion or foulness, and darkness or ignorance. 3 A means of defence, one of six expedients in government, as, peace, war, a march, a halt, a stratagem, and recourse to protection: see सन्धि, &c. 4 Form, shape, &c. or property of the body. 5 Knowledge, ignorance, &c. or quality of the mind. 6 Heroism, valor, &c. 7 White, black, &c. or the attributes of color. 8 An organ of sense. 9 A string in general. 10 A bow-string. 11 Abandoning, leaving. 12 A cook. 13 A name of BHĪMA. 14 Secondary, subordinate. 15 Excellence, merit, freedom from fault or blemish. 16 (In arithmetic,) The given coefficient of any number. 17 (In geometry,) The chord of an are. 18 (In grammar,) The substitution of e, o, ar and al for i, u, ṛ, ḷ. 19 (In rhetoric,) Consistency of plan, elegance of expression, &c. as the merits of a composition. 20 In composition with numerals, multiplication, as द्विगुण twice, त्रिगुण thrice. f. (-णा) A plant of the fibres of which bow- strings are made: see मूर्व्वा. E. गुण to address or advise, affix क्त.
गुणक: गुणक m. (-कः) 1 A numerator, a reckoner. 2 (In arithmetic,) The multiplier. E. गुण to count, क्वुन् aff.
गुणकार: गुणकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who counts, &c. m. (-रः) A name of BHĪMASENA. E. गुण, and कार who makes; BHĪMA performed the duties of a cook at the time all the Pāṇḍava princes became servants to VIRĀṬA.
गुणगान: गुणगान n. (-नं) Panegyric, praise. E. गुण, and गान singing.
गुणग्रहण: गुणग्रहण n. (-णं) Acknowledging or appreciating merit. E. गुण, and ग्रहण taking.
गुणग्राहिन्: गुणग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Who judges or appreciates good qualities. E. गुण, and ग्राहिन् who seizes.
गुणगृह्य: गुणगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 Suited to good qualities. 2 Admiring or attached to merit. E. गुण, and गृह्य to be caught by.
गुणघातिन्: गुणघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) A detractor, a calumniator, envious, censorious. E. गुण, and घातिन् who destroys.
गुणज्ञ: गुणज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One who knows how to appreciate men or things, knowing or judging of their merits. E. गुण, and ज्ञ who knows.
गुणतस: गुणतस ind. 1 According to property or quality. 2 According to desert. E. गुण, and तसि aff.
गुणता: गुणता f. (-ता) 1 Excellence, the possession of good qualities. 2 Substantiality, possession of attributes or qualities in general. 3 Multiplication. E. गुण, and तल् affix; also with त्व, affix गुणत्वं.
गुणत्रय: गुणत्रय n. (-यं) The three properties of nature; purity, passion, and darkness. E. गुण, and त्रय triple; also गुणत्रितयं.
गुणदोषपरीक्षण: गुणदोषपरीक्षण n. (-णं) Test or investigation of merits and faults. E. गुण, दोष fault, परीक्षण trying.
गुणधर्म: गुणधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The virtue incident to the possession of certain qualities, as clemency is the virtue of royalty, &c. E. गुण a property, and धर्म्म virtue.
गुणधर्म्म: गुणधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The virtue incident to the possession of certain qualities, as clemency is the virtue of royalty, &c. E. गुण a property, and धर्म्म virtue.
गुणन: गुणन n. (-नं) 1 Describing, relating qualities. 2 Enumerating. 3 Multiplication. E. गुण to number, ल्युट् aff.
गुणनिका: गुणनिका f. (-का) 1 Dance, the science or profession of dancing, acting, &c. 2 Determining the reading of a manuscript, &c. 3 A cypher. 4 The prologue or introduction to a drama. 5 A necklace. E. कन् added to गुणनी.
गुणनी: गुणनी f. (-नी) Examining books, studying, collating, and correcting copies, &c. E. गुण to advise, affix ल्युट्, and ङीप्.
गुणनीय: गुणनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be advised. 2 To be multiplied. 3 To be enumerated. m. (-यः) Practice, practising any thing, but especially science or study. m. (-यं) The multiplicand. E. गुण to advise, &c. अनीवर् aff.
गुणपूग: गुणपूग n. (-गं) Great merit. E. गुण, and पूग a heap.
गुणप्रकर्ष: गुणप्रकर्ष m. (-र्षः) Great merit, excellence. E. गुण, and प्रकर्ष eminence.
गुणप्रिय: गुणप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Attached to merit, fond of excellence. E. गण, and प्रिय fond of.
गुणभ्रंश: गुणभ्रंश mfn. (-शः) The loss of all good qualities. E. गुण good property, and भ्रंश fall, loss.
गुणमय: गुणमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Endowed with or consisting of properties. 2 Possessed of merit. E. गुण, and मयट् aff.
गुणमहत्: गुणमहत् n. (-हत्) Great merit, superior qualities. E. गुण, and महत् great.
गुणयुक्त: गुणयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Having virtues or properties. E. गुण, and युक्त joined.
गुणलक्षण: गुणलक्षण n. (-णं) Mark or indication of internal property. E. गुण, and लक्षण mark.
गुणलयनिका: गुणलयनिका f. (-का) A tent. E. गुण rope, ली to bind, ल्युट् and ङीप् affix, with कन् added; also गुणलयनी.
गुणलुब्ध: गुणलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Desirous of merit, attached to excellence. E. गुण, and लुब्ध covetous.
गुणवत्: गुणवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Possessing attributes. 2 Endowed with good qualities. 3 Tied, bound, &c. E. गुण quality, and मतुप् poss. aff.
गुणवत्तम: गुणवत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Excellent. E. गुणवत् and तमप् aff.
गुणवत्तर: गुणवत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Excellent. E. गुणवत् and तरप् aff.
गुणवत्ता: गुणवत्ता f. (-त्ता) Excellence. E. गुणवत् and तल् affix; also with त्व, गुणवत्त्वं.
गुणवाचक: गुणवाचक n. (-कं) An adjective or attributive noun. E. गुण, and वाचक a word.
गुणवैशेष्य: गुणवैशेष्य n. (-ष्यं) Preeminence of merit or of any property. E. गुण, and वैशेष्य superiority.
गुणवृक्षक: गुणवृक्षक m. (-कः) A mast. E. गुण a rope, and वृक्ष a tree, कन् affix of similitude; also गुणवृक्षः.
गुणश्लाघा: गुणश्लाघा f. (-घा) Praise, encomium. E. गुण, and श्लाघा praise.
गुणसम्पद्: गुणसम्पद् f. (-पत् or पद्) Great merit. E. गुण, and सम्पद् wealth.
गुणसङ्ग: गुणसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Association with properties or qualities. E. गुण, and सङ्ग combination.
गुणसङ्ग्रह: गुणसङ्ग्रह m. (-हः) A collection of merits or properties. E. गुण, and सङ्ग्रह collection.
गुणसागर: गुणसागर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Endowed with all good qualities. m. (-रः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A form of BUDDHA, a Buddha. E. गुण excellence, and सागर the ocean; an ocean of desert.
गुणस्तुति: गुणस्तुति f. (-तिः) Panegyric, encomium. E. गुण, and स्तुति praise.
गुणहीन: गुणहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Void of merit. 2 Free from properties. E. गुण, and हीन void of.
गुणाकर: गुणाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Possessing all excellences. m. (-रः) A name of BUDDHA the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. गुण attribute, especially good, and आकर a mine; a mine of merit.
गुणातीत: गुणातीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Freed from or beyond all properties. E. गुण, and अतीत passed.
गुणानुरोध: गुणानुरोध m. (-धः) Conformity or suitableness to good qualities, &c. E. गुण, and अनुरोध concurrence.
गुणान्तर: गुणान्तर n. (-रं) 1 Species or sort of merit. 2 Variety of property or quality. E. गुण, and अन्तर difference.
गुणान्वित: गुणान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having attributes or qualities. 2 Excellent, good, endowed with virtues. E. गुण, and अन्वित possessed of.
गुणापवाद: गुणापवाद m. (-दः) Detraction. E. गुण, and अपवाद reproach.
गुणाभास: गुणाभास m. (-सः) Semblance of qualities. E. गुण, and आभास appearance.
गुणाश्रय: गुणाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Virtuous, excellent, able, endowed with good qualities. E. गुण, and आश्रय asylum.
गुणिगण: गुणिगण m. (-णं) A number of virtuous persons. E. गुणिन्, and गण a troop.
गुणित: गुणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Multiplied, (arithmetically.) 2 Collected, heaped together. E. गुण to advise, &c. affix क्त.
गुणिद्वैध: गुणिद्वैध n. (-धः) Equality of merit on two sides. E. गुणिन्, and द्वैध duality.
गुणिन्: गुणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) Endowed with good qualities. m. (-णी) A bow. E. गुण a quality, &c. and इनि aff.
गुणीभूत: गुणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made secondary or subordinate. 2 Invested with attributes, &c. 3 Varied according to its qualities. 4 Having a certain force or application, (a word, &c.) E. गुण, and भृत become, with च्चि augment.
गुणेश्वर: गुणेश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Having good qualities, &c. m. (-रः) The name of a mountain, according to some, Citrakūṭa or Comptah in Bundelcund. E. गुण qualities, and ईश्वर master or possessor.
गुणोत्कर्ष: गुणोत्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Excellence, endowment with superior qualities. E. गुण, and उत्कर्ष abundance.
गुणोत्कीर्तन: गुणोत्कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) Panegyric, eulogium. E. गुण, and उत्कीर्त्तन celebrating.
गुणोत्कीर्त्तन: गुणोत्कीर्त्तन n. (-नं) Panegyric, eulogium. E. गुण, and उत्कीर्त्तन celebrating.
गुणोत्कृष्ट: गुणोत्कृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Superior in merit or in good qualities. E. गुण, and उत्कृष्ट best.
गुणोपेत: गुणोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Endowed with good qualities. E. गुण, and उपेत possessed of.
गुणौघ: गुणौघ n. (-घं) Superior or abundant merit. E. गुण, and ओघ heap.
गुण्ठित: गुण्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pounded, ground, reduced to dust or powder. 2 Covered with, surrounded. E. गुठि to surround, &c. affix क्त; also गुण्डित.
गुण्ड: गुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A fragrant grass, (Scirpus kysoor.)
गुण्डक: गुण्डक m. (-कः) 1 Dust, powder. 2 Dirty meal. 3 An oil vessel. 4 A low tone. E. गुडि to surround, &c. affix वुन्.
गुण्डिक: गुण्डिक mf. (-कः-का) Flour, powder, meal. E. गुडि to pound, वुन् affix, and इ inserted.
गुण्डिचा: गुण्डिचा f. (-चा) The name of the place where the car of JAGANNĀTHA stays for a week at the Ratha Yātrā.
गुण्डित: गुण्डित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pounded, ground. 2 Covered with dust. E. गुड to grind or pound, affix क्त.
गुण्य: गुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) 1 To be enumerated. 2 To be described as qualities, to be praised. 3 To be multiplied, the multiplicand. E. गुण to count, क्यप् aff.
गुत्स: गुत्स m. (-त्सः) 1 A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay. 2 A clump of grass. 3 A necklace of thirty-six strings. 4 A perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण. 5 A bundle. E. गुध to enclose or surround, Uṇādi affix स; also गुत्सक, गुच्छ, &c.
गुत्सक: गुत्सक m. (-कः) 1 A nosegay, a cluster of blossoms. 2 A chowri, a cow tail. E. कन् added to the preceding; also गुच्छक.
गुत्सपुष्प: गुत्सपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Echites scholaris:) see सप्तपर्ण. E. गुत्स, and पुष्प a flower; bearing its flowers in clusters.
गुत्सार्द्ध: गुत्सार्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) A necklace or garland of twenty-four strings. E. गुत्स a large garland, and अर्द्ध a part; also गुच्छार्द्ध.
गुद: गुद n. (-दं) The anus. E. गुद to play, affix क.
गुदकील: गुदकील m. (-लः) Piles. E. गुद the anus, कील a pin or bolt; also with कन् added गुदकीलक.
गुदग्रह: गुदग्रह m. (-हः) Constipation, flatulence, &c. E. गुद the anus, and ग्रह what takes or affects.
गुदभ्रंश: गुदभ्रंश m. (-शः) Prolapsus ani. E. गुद, and भ्रंश loss.
गुदाङ्कुर: गुदाङ्कुर m. (-रः) Piles. E. गुद the anus, and अङ्कुर a sprout.
गुद्र: गुद्र r. 10th cl. (इ) गुद्रि (गुंद्रयति) To lie, to speak falsely.
गुध: गुध r. 1st cl. (गोधते) To play. r. 4th cl. (गोध्यति) To surround, to encompass. r. 9th cl. (गोध्नाति) To be angry.
गुधित: गुधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, inclosed. E. गुध to surround, क्त aff.
गुधेर: गुधेर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) A protector, a defender. E. गुध to invest, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
गुन्दल: गुन्दल m. (-लः) The sound of a small oblong drum. E. गुद to play, अलच् affix, and नुम् inserted.
गुन्दाल: गुन्दाल m. (-लः) 1 A kind of bird, (a sort of pheasant?) 2 The bartavelle: see चकोर. E. गुन्द्रा a kind of grass, and ल what takes or eats, र rejected; also read गुन्द्राल.
गुन्द्र: गुन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A kind of grass, (Saccharum sara.) f. (-न्द्रा) 1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus pertenuis; also C. rotundus.) 2 A plant bearing a fragrant seed; also प्रियङ्गु. E. गुद to play, affix रक्, and नुम् inserted.
गुन्द्राल: गुन्द्राल m. (-लः) A sort of bird: see गुन्दाल.
गुप: गुप r. 1st cl. (जुगुप्सते) 1 To conceal, to hide. 2 To censure, to blame or despise, (this root takes सन् irregularly.) (उ) गुपू r. 1st cl. (गोपयति) To guard or protect. (इर) गुपिर r. 4th cl. (गुप्यति) 1 To be confused or disturbed. 2 To disturb or perplex. गुप r. 10th cl. (गोपयति) 1 To shine. 2 To speak.
गुपिल: गुपिल m. (-लः) A king, a prince. E. गुप to protect, Uṇādi affix इलच्.
गुप्त: गुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Preserved, protected. 2 Hidden, concealed, secret. 3 Joined, combined. 4 Invisible, withdrawn from sight. n. adv. (-प्तं) Privately, secretly. m. (-प्तः) An appellation forming especially the second member of the name of a Vaiśya or man of the third class. f. (-प्ता) 1 Cowach. 2 A woman who hides from her lover's endearments. E. गुप to defend, &c. affix ऊ.
गुप्तगति: गुप्तगति m. (-तिः) A spy or secret emissary. f. (-तिः) Going privately or secretly. E. गुप्त and गति going.
गुप्तचर: गुप्तचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Who or what goes secretly. m. (-रः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. गुप्त, and चर who goes, or चरट् aff.
गुप्ति: गुप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Concealing, hiding, concealment. 2 Preserving, protecting. 3 Restraint, check. 4 A hole in the ground, a cavern, a sink, a cellar, &c. (a place of concealment.) 5 A prison. 6 The well or lower deck of a boat. 7 Digging a hole in the ground. 8 Fortification. E. गुप to hide, &c. affix क्तिन.
गुफ: गुफ r. 6th cl. (गुफति) To string as a garland, &c.
गुफित: गुफित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strung, tied on a string. 2 Arranged in order. E. गुफ to string, affix क्त.
गुम्फ: गुम्फ r. 6th cl. (गुम्फति) To string together as a garland, &c.
गुम्फ m. (-म्फः) 1 Tying, stringing as a garland, &c. 2 A bracelet. 3 A whisker, a mustachio. E. गुम्फ to tie or string, affix अच्.
गुम्फित: गुम्फित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Tied, strung. 2 Arranged, placed in order. E. गुम्फ to tie, affix क्त; also गुफित, and ग्रन्थित.
गुर: गुर r. 1st cl. (गोरति) r. 6th cl. (ई) गुरी (गुरते) To make an effort or exertion.
गुरण: गुरण n. (-णं) Effort, perseverance, great or continued exertion. E. गुर to make an effort, affix ल्युट्; also गोरण.
गुरु: गुरु mfn. (-गुरुः गुर्व्वी गुरु) 1 Heavy, weighty. 2 Great, (large or eminent.) 2 Difficult, arduous. 4 Important. 5 Much, excessive. 6 Best, excellent. 7 Venerable, respectable. 8 Dear, valuable, highly prized. 9 Accented long, (as a foot or vowel.) mn. (-रुः-रु) The long vowel, a sound equal to two Mātras or simple sounds. m. (-रुः) 1 A spiritual parent, from whom the youth receives the initiatory Mantra or prayer, and who conducts the ceremonies necessary at various seasons of infancy and youth, up to the period of investiture with the characteristic thread or string; this person may be the natural parent or the religious preceptor. 2 A religious teacher, one who explains the law and religion to his pupil, instructs him in the Śāstras, &c. 3 A name of VṚHASPATI, who is considered as the Guru or preceptor of the gods. 4 A father or any venerable male relation. E. गॄ to sound or speak, &c. Uṇādi affix कु, and उ substituted for ऋ; declaring the mode of performing the rites, &c.
गुरुकार्य: गुरुकार्य्य (-र्य्यं) n. 1 A serious or momentous affair. 2 The business or office of a spiritual teacher. E. गुरु as above, and कार्य्य business, &c.
गुरुकार्य्य: गुरुकार्य्य (-र्य्यं) n. 1 A serious or momentous affair. 2 The business or office of a spiritual teacher. E. गुरु as above, and कार्य्य business, &c.
गुरुकोप: गुरुकोप m. (-पः) Violent wrath. E. गुरु much, and कोप anger.
गुरुक्रम: गुरुक्रम m. (-मः) Traditionary instruction. E. गुरु a teacher, and क्रम order.
गुरुगत: गुरुगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being with or belonging to a spiritual teacher. E. गुरु, and गत gone to.
गुरुघ्न: गुरुघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Destroying a spiritual parent. m. (-घ्नः) White mustard. E. गुरु, and घ्न who or what destroys.
गुरुजन: गुरुजन m. (-नः) 1 An elder, a venerable person. 2 The elders of a family, &c. E. गुरु, and जन people.
गुरुण्टक: गुरुण्टक m. (-कः) A kind of bird, a sort of peacock: see नीलमयूर.
गुरुतल्पग: गुरुतल्पग m. (-गः) A violator of his teacher's bed. E. गुरु as above, तल्प a bed, and ग who goes.
गुरुतल्पव्रत: गुरुतल्पव्रत n. (-तं) Penance for intercourse with the wife of a Guru. E. गुरु, तल्प a bed, (defiling, &c. understood,) and व्रत penance.
गुरुतल्पिन्: गुरुतल्पिन् m. (-ल्पी) One who has criminal intercourse with his teacher's wife. E. गुरु, तल्प a bed, इनि aff.
गुरुताप: गुरुताप m. (-पः) Excessive heat. E. गुरु, and ताप heat.
गुरुत्व: गुरुत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Sacredness, venerableness, respectability. 2 Greatness, magnitude. 3 Weight, heaviness. 4 Burden, trouble. E. गुरु, and त्व affix; also with तल्, गुरुता.
गुरुप्रमोद: गुरुप्रमोद m. (-दः) Happiness, delight. E. गुरु, and प्रमोद pleasure.
गुरुरत्न: गुरुरत्न n. (-त्नं) A topaz. E. गुरु valuable, रत्न a gem.
गुरुदैवत: गुरुदैवत m. (-तः) The eighth lunar constellation; also पुष्य. E. गुरु and देवता deity, affix अण्; VṚHASPATI is the ruling deity of the constellation.
गुरुपत्र: गुरुपत्र n. (-त्रं) Tin. f. (-त्रा) The tamarind tree. E. गुरु, and पत्र leaf; heavy or abundant in leaves.
गुरुमर्दल: गुरुमर्द्दल m. (-लः) A kind of drum or tabor. E. गुरु heavy or large, and मर्द्दल a small drum.
गुरुमर्द्दल: गुरुमर्द्दल m. (-लः) A kind of drum or tabor. E. गुरु heavy or large, and मर्द्दल a small drum.
गुरुवत्: गुरुवत् ind. Like a Guru, as a Guru. E. गुरु, and बति aff.
गुरुवद्वृत्ति: गुरुवद्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Behaving to any one with as much respect as to a sacred teacher. E. गुरुवत्, and वृति practice.
गुरुवर्चोघ्न: गुरुवर्च्चोघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The lime or citron. E. गुरु much, वर्च्चम् heat, and घ्न what removes; of cooling properties.
गुरुवर्च्चोघ्न: गुरुवर्च्चोघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The lime or citron. E. गुरु much, वर्च्चम् heat, and घ्न what removes; of cooling properties.
गुरुशिंशपा: गुरुशिंशपा f. (-पा) A tree, (Dalbergia sisu:) see शिंशपा.
गुरुशुश्रूषा: गुरुशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) Service of a Guru. E. गुरु, and शुश्रूषा; also गुरुपूजा, गुरुसेवा, &c.
गुरुस्थिर: गुरुस्थिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very firm. E. गुरु, and स्थिर steady.
गुरुहन्: गुरुहन् m. (-हा) The murderer of his Guru or spiritual parent. E. गुरु, and हन् who kills, from हन with क्विप् affix; this is the most heinous of all criminals, according to Hindu notions.
गुर्जर: गुर्ज्जर m. (-रः) The name of a district, Gurjara or Guzerat. plu. m. (-राः) The people of Guzerat. f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music.
गुर्ज्जर: गुर्ज्जर m. (-रः) The name of a district, Gurjara or Guzerat. plu. m. (-राः) The people of Guzerat. f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs or female personifications of music.
गुर्द: गुर्द r. 1st cl. (गुर्दते or गूर्दते) To play. r. 10th cl. (गूर्दयति) 1 To dwell or inhabit. 2 To invite.
गुर्व: गुर्व r. 1st cl. (ई) गुर्वी (गुर्वति) To endeavor, to aim or strive.
गुर्वर्थम्: गुर्व्वर्थम् ind. For or on account of a Guru. E. गुरु, and अर्थ object.
गुर्व्वर्थम्: गुर्व्वर्थम् ind. For or on account of a Guru. E. गुरु, and अर्थ object.
गुर्वङ्गना: गुर्व्वङ्गना f. (-ना) 1 The wife of a Guru. 2 Any woman entitled to great respect. E. गुरु, and अङ्गना a female.
गुर्व्वङ्गना: गुर्व्वङ्गना f. (-ना) 1 The wife of a Guru. 2 Any woman entitled to great respect. E. गुरु, and अङ्गना a female.
गुर्विणी: गुर्व्विणी f. (-णी) A pregnant woman. E. गर्व्व to be proud, Uṇādi affix इनच् and ङीष् fem. affix, उ substituted for the radical अ; also गर्भिणी.
गुर्व्विणी: गुर्व्विणी f. (-णी) A pregnant woman. E. गर्व्व to be proud, Uṇādi affix इनच् and ङीष् fem. affix, उ substituted for the radical अ; also गर्भिणी.
गुर्वी: गुर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) 1 A pregnant woman. 2 The wife of a Guru or spiritual teacher. E. गुरु heavy, &c. and ङीष् aff.
गुर्व्वी: गुर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) 1 A pregnant woman. 2 The wife of a Guru or spiritual teacher. E. गुरु heavy, &c. and ङीष् aff.
गुल: गुल m. (-लः) Raw or unrefined sugar, molasses. f. (-ला) A plant, (Euphorbia tirucalli:) see स्नुहि. (-ली) 1 A pill, a bolus, any small globular substance. 2 Small pox. E. गुड to surround, &c. affixes क and टाप्, or ङीष्, ड changed to ल.
गुलञ्चकन्द: गुलञ्चकन्द m. (-न्दः) An esculent root, commonly कुली.
गुलिका: गुलिका f. (-का) A small ball. E. कन् added to गुली.
गुलिकाक्रीडा: गुलिकाक्रीडा f. (-डा) Playing with a ball, bat and ball, golf, &c. E. गुलिका, and क्रीडा play.
गुलुच्छ: गुलुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A cluster of blossoms; also गुलुञ्छ.
गुलुञ्छ: गुलुञ्छ m. (-ञ्छः) A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay. E. गुड to preserve, affix क्विप्, and ड changed to ल, and उच्छ or इच्छि to gather or glean, affix क; also with कन् added गुलुञ्छक.
गुल्फ: गुल्फ m. (-ल्फः) The ancle. E. गल to go, affix फक्, and उ substituted for the penultimate.
गुल्म: गुल्म m. (-ल्मः) 1 The division of an army, a body of troops, consisting of nine platoons, or nine elephants, nine chariots, twenty-seven horse, and forty-five foot. 2 The spleen. 3 A shrub, a bush. 4 A clump of grass, &c. 5 A fort, an intrenchment. 6 Disciplining an army, keeping it in a posture of defence. 7 A wharf or stairs, a Ghat. 8 A disease; according to some, a chronic enlargement of the spleen, but as variously situated it is any glandular enlargement in the abdomen, as that of the mesenteric gland, &c. so as to be perceived externally. f. (-ल्मी) 1 A tent. 2 Emblic myrobalan; also आमलकी. 3 Small cardamoms: see एला. 4 A cluster or clump of trees, a multitude of thickets. 5 A kind of plant, commonly Kurkavali. E. गुड to surround, मक् affix, ड changed to ल.
गुल्मकेतु: गुल्मकेतु m. (-तुः) A small sort of cane or reed. E. गुल्म, and केतु banner.
गुल्ममूल: गुल्ममूल n. (-लं) Ginger. E. गुल्म, and मूल a root.
गुल्मिन्: गुल्मिन् mfn. (-ल्मी-ल्मिनी-ल्मि) 1 Composed of different divisions, (a force, &c.) 2 Growing, &c. in a clump or cluster. 3 Having the spleen affected by it. f. (-नी) A spreading creeper or any creeping plant. E. गुल्म a clump, इनि and ङीष् affs.
गुल्य: गुल्य m. (-ल्यः) Sweetness, a sweet or saccharine taste. E. गुड molasses, and क्यप् affix; ड changed to ल.
गुवाक: गुवाक m. (-कः) The betelnut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.) E. गु to stool, affix आक, and उ converted to अव irregularly.
गुह: गुह r. 1st cl. (ऊ) गुहू (गुहति) To cover, to cover as with clothes, to wear.

गुह m. (-हः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A name of VIṢṆU. 3 A swift horse. 4 The name of a Niṣāda, ruler of Sringavera, the friend of RĀMA. 5 A name or title proper to persons of the writer caste. f. (-हा) 1 A cave, a cavern. 2 A pit, a hole in the ground. 3 A plant, commonly Cākuliya: see सिंहपुच्छी. E. गुह to conceal, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
गुहागृह: गुहागृह n. (-हं) A cavern. E. गुहा, and गृह a house.
गुहामुख: गुहामुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Wide mouthed, open mouthed. E. गुहा, and मुख mouth.
गुहाशय: गुहाशय m. (-यः) 1 A tiger. 2 Any animal or man living in caverns. 3 A name of VIṢṆU. E. गुहा a cave, and आशय abode.
गुहिन: गुहिन n. (-नं) A wood, a thicket. E. गुह to hide, इनच् aff.
गुहिल: गुहिल n. (-लं) Wealth, property. E. गुह to hide, &c. इलच् aff.
गुहेर: गुहेर m. (-रः) 1 An ironsmith. 2 A guardian, a preserver. E. गुह to cover, एरक् Uṇādi aff.
गुह्य: गुह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 Secret, solitary, retired. 2 Private, concealable, to be kept hidden or secret. 3 Mysterious, mystical. m. (-ह्यः) 1 A tortoise. 2 Hypocrisy. 3 VIṢṆU. n. (-ह्यं) 1 A privity, an organ of generation, &c. 2 The anus. E. गुह to cover, क्यप् affix, deriv. irr.
गुह्यक: गुह्यक m. (-कः) A kind of demigod attendant upon KUVERA the deity of wealth, and guardian of his treasures. E. गुह to preserve or conceal, affix क्वुन् and य inserted.
गुह्यकेश्वर: गुह्यकेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of KUVERA the Hindu PLUTUS. E. गुह्यक a demigod, (see the preceding,) and ईश्वर lord or master.
गुह्यगुरु: गुह्यगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of ŚIVA. E. गुह्य secret, and गुरु a master; ŚIVA being considered as the teacher, especially of the Tantras, or Hindu mystic and magical works.
गुह्यदीपक: गुह्यदीपक m. (-कः) The fire fly. E. गुह्य a solitary place, and दीपक the illuminer; from दीप to light or inflame, and क्वुन् aff.
गुह्यनिष्यन्द: गुह्यनिष्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Urine. E. गुह्य, and निष्यन्द what flows.
गुह्यभाषित: गुह्यभाषित n. (-तं) 1 A Mantra, a mystical prayer or incantation. 2 A secret. E. गुह्य secret, and भाषित spoken.
गू: गू (ओ) ओगू r. 6th cl. (गुवति) To void by stool; also with a short vowel, गु.
गूढ: गूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Hidden, concealed. n. (-ढं) 1 A solitary or private place. 2 A private part. 3 A mystery. E. गुह to hide, affix क्त, deriv. irregular.
गूढचार: गूढचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One who goes about privately. m. (-रः) A secret emissary. E. गूढ, and चार practice.
गूढचारिन्: गूढचारिन् m. (-री) A secret emissary, a spy. E. गूढ, and चारिन् who goes.
गूढज: गूढज m. (-जः) The son of a concealed birth; born privately of a woman whose husband is absent, the real father being unknown; this is one of the twelve forms particularized in Hindu law. E. गूढ hidden, and ज born; also compounded with पुत्त्र a son, गूढजपुत्त्र.
गूढनीड: गूढनीड m. (-डः) The wagtail. E. गूड secret, and नीड a nest.
गूढपथ: गूढपथ m. (-थः) 1 Mind, intellect. 2 A bye-path, a hidden way. E. गूढ secret, and पथ a road; whose path is unperceived.
गूढपाद्: गूढपाद् m. (-द् or त्) A snake. E. गूढ hidden, and पाद a foot, the final vowel rejected; also being retained गूढपाद nom. (-दः)
गूढपुरुष: गूढपुरुष m. (-षः) A spy, a secret emissary, a disguised agent, &c. E. गूढ concealed, and पुरुष a man.
गूढभाषित: गूढभाषित n. (-तं) Secret intelligence, private communication. E. गूढ secure, and भाषित what is said.
गूढमार्ग: गूढमार्ग m. (-र्गः) A subterraneous passage, a defile, a bye-road, or secret way. E. गूढ concealed, and मार्ग a road.
गूढमैथुन: गूढमैथुन m. (-नः) A crow. E. गूढ secret, and मैथुन copulation.
गूढवर्चस्: गूढवर्च्चस् m. (-र्च्चाः) A frog. E. गूढ hidden, and वर्च्चस light, warmth; perhaps an idea is implied analogous to that of cold blooded animals: some explain it वर्च्चस् foeces, whose excrement is unknown.
गूढवर्च्चस्: गूढवर्च्चस् m. (-र्च्चाः) A frog. E. गूढ hidden, and वर्च्चस light, warmth; perhaps an idea is implied analogous to that of cold blooded animals: some explain it वर्च्चस् foeces, whose excrement is unknown.
गूढसाक्षिन्: गूढसाक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) A concealed witness, one placed by the plaintiff, so as to overhear what has been said by the defendant. E. गूढ, and साक्षिन् a witness.
गूढाङ्ग: गूढाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A tortoise. E. गूढ, and अङ्ग body, hidden in his shell.
गूढाङ्घ्रि: गूढाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) A snake. E. गूढ, and अङ्घ्रि foot.
गूढोत्पन्न: गूढोत्पन्न m. (-न्नः) The son of concealed birth: see गूढज. E. गूढ privately, and उत्पन्न born.
गूथ: गूथ m. (-थः) Foeces, ordure. E. गू to void by stool, and थक् Uṇādi aff.
गूथलक्त: गूथलक्त m. (-क्तः) A small bird, considered to be a species of the Maina, (Turdus salica.) E. गूथ ordure, and लक्त marked.
गून: गून m. (-नः-ना-नं) Voided, (as ordure.) E. गू to stool, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
गूर: गूर r. 10th cl. (गूरयते) 1 To strive, to endeavor, to make an effort or exertion. 2 To eat. (ई) गूरी r. 4th cl. (गूर्यते) 1 To hurt, to injure, as to wound, to kill, &c. 2 To be decayed or old.
गूरण: गूरण n. (-णं) Effort, exertion. E. गूर to strive, affix ल्युट्; also गुरण.
गूर्द: गूर्द r. 1st cl. (गूर्दते) To play. r. 10 cl. (गूर्दयति) 1 To dwell or inhabit. 2 To invite; these roots are both written more usually with the short vowel.
गूवाक: गूवाक m. (-कः) The betelnut tree: see गुवाक.
गूषणा: गूषणा f. (-णा) The eye in a peacock's tail.
गूहमान: गूहमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Hiding, concealing. E. गुह to hide, शानच् aff.
गूहयित्वा: गूहयित्वा ind. Having concealed, hidden, disguised. E. गुह to hide, causal form, क्त्वा aff.
गृ: गृ r. 1st cl. (गरति) To sprinkle, to moisten or wet.
गृज: गृज r. 1st cl. (गर्जति) also (इ,) गृजि (गृञ्जति) To sound, to roar, to grumble, &c. also गर्ज.
गृञ्जन: गृञ्जन n. (-नं) Poisoned flesh, the meat of an animal destroyed by poison. m. (-नः) 1 Garlic, or a small variety of it of a red colour. 2 A turnip. 3 The tops of hemp chewed as an inebriating substance, the Gāñja. E. गृजि to sound, and ल्युट् affix; applied to the latter as causing eructation.
गृणत्: गृणत् mfn. (-णन्-णन्ती-णत्) 1 Speaking. 2 Praising, flattering. E. ग to speak, शतृ aff.
गृण्डीव: गृण्डीव m. (-वः) An animal of prey, considered as a large kind of jackal. E. गॄ to sound, and डीव affix; deriv. irr.; also sometimes short गृण्डिव.
गृत्स: गृत्स m. (-त्सः) A name of KANDARPA. E. गृध to be desirous, and स Uṇādi aff.
गृध: गृध r. 4th cl. (उ,) गृधु (गृध्यति) To covet, to desire greedily, to be greedy.
गृधु: गृधु m. (-धुः) 1 The deity KĀMA or love. 2 A libidinous man. E. गृध to desire, कु Uṇādi aff.
गृधू: गृधू m. (-धूः) 1 Understanding. 2 Air voided downwards. 3 Bad, wicked. E. गृध, and कू Uṇādi aff.
गृध्नु: गृध्नु mfn. (-ध्नुः-ध्नुः-ध्नु) Covetous, cupidinous, greedy. E. गृध to be greedy, क्नु aff.
गृध्नुता: गृध्नुता f. (-ता) Covetousness, greediness, extreme and illiberal desire. E. गृध्नु greedy, and तल् abstract aff.
गृध्र: गृध्र mfn. (-ध्रः-ध्रा-ध्रं) Desirous, greedy, covetous. m. (-घ्रः) A vulture. E. गृध to desire, and क्रन् Uṇādi affix; it may also be written गृद्ध.
गृध्रनखी: गृध्रनखी f. (-खी) 1 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) 2 A wild kind of the same, (Zizyphus nepeca.) E. गृध्र a vulture, and नख nail, having thorns like a vulture's claws.
गृध्रराज: गृध्रराज m. (-जः) A name of JAṬĀYU. E. गृध्र, and राज king.
गृध्रसी: गृध्रसी f. (-सी) 1 Lumbago. 2 Rheumatism affecting the loins. E. गृध desire, सो to destroy, ड and ङीप् affixes; also sometimes written ग्रध्रसी.
गृष्टि: गृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) 1 A cow that has had one calf. 2 A yam. 3 The jujube, (Zizyphus jujuba.) E. घृष to grind, affix क्तिन्, and घ changed to ग.
गृह: गृह r. 1st cl. (ऊ,) गृहू (गर्हते) also r. 10th cl. (गृहयते) To take, to seize, to receive or accept; also ग्रह.

गृह n. (-हं) 1 A house, a mansion, a habitation in general. 2 A wife: (in these senses the plural is always masculine, गृहाः). 3 A name, an appellation. E. गृह to receive or take, (grain, goods, &c.) affix क.
गृहकच्छप: गृहकच्छप m. (-पः) A small flat oblong stone, used for grinding condiments, &c. E. गृह a house, and कच्छप a tortoise.
गृहकन्या: गृहकन्या f. (-न्या) The aloe, (Aloes perfoliata;) also घृतकुमारी, कुमारी, &c. E. गृह a house, and कन्या a virgin.
गृहकपोतक: गृहकपोतक m. (-कः) A pigeon, a tame or domestic pigeon. E. गृह a house, and कपोतक a dove or pigeon.
गृहकरण: गृहकरण n. (-णं) 1 Household affairs. 2 House building. E. गृह, and करण making.
गृहकारक: गृहकारक m. (-कः) 1 A house builder. 2 A thatcher. E. गृह, and कारक who makes.
गृहकारिन्: गृहकारिन् m. (-री) 1 A kind of wasp. 2 A house builder. E. गृह a house, and कारिन् who makes, building a nest or house of clay, &c.
गृहकार्य: गृहकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Household affairs. E. गृह, and कार्य्य business; also गृहकर्म्म, &c.
गृहकार्य्य: गृहकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Household affairs. E. गृह, and कार्य्य business; also गृहकर्म्म, &c.
गृहगोधा: गृहगोधा f. (-धा) A small house lizard. E. गृह a house, and गोधा or गोधिका an iguana; hence also गृहगोधिका, or ध being changed to ल, गृहगोलिका.
गृहगोलिका: गृहगोलिका f. (-का) A lizard: see the preceding.
गृहचटक: गृहचटक m. (-कः) A house sparrow. E. गृह, and चटक a sparrow.
गृहच्छिद्र: गृहछिद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 Private or family afflictions or troubles. 2 A breach in a house. E. गृह, and छिद्र a hole; also गृहरग्ध्रं.
गृहछिद्र: गृहछिद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 Private or family afflictions or troubles. 2 A breach in a house. E. गृह, and छिद्र a hole; also गृहरग्ध्रं.
गृहज: गृहज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born in the house. m. (-जः) A slave born in the house. E. गृह, and ज born; also गृहजात.
गृहतटी: गृहतटी f. (-टी) A terrace in front of a house, a threshold. E. गृह a house, and तट a bank.
गृहदास: गृहदास mf. (-सः-सी) A domestic slave. E. गृह, and दास a slave.
गृहदीप्ति: गृहदीप्ति f. (-प्तिः) A virtuous woman. E. गृह, and दीप्ति light.
गृहद्वार: गृहद्वार m. (-रः) The door of a house. E. गृह, and द्वार a door.
गृहद्रुम: गृहद्रुम m. (-मः) A plant commonly Medhasriṅgi: see मेढशृङ्गी. E. गृह a house, द्रुम a tree, growing near dwellings.
गृहनाशन: गृहनाशन m. (-नः) A pigeon. E. गृह, and नाशन who injures; defacing the walls of a house by building in and about it.
गृहनीड: गृहनीड m. (डः) A sparrow. E. गृह, and नीड a nest, who builds his nest in human dwellings.
गृहपति: गृहपति m. (-तिः) 1 A householder, a man of the second class, or who after having finished his studies is married and settled. 2 A householder of particular merit, giving alms, and performing all the prescribed ceremonies, &c. 3 Maintenance of a sacred and perpetual fire. 4 Virtue, especially of a householder, as hospitality, &c. E. गृह a house, and पति lord or master.
गृहपोतक: गृहपोतक m. (-कः) The site of a habitation, the ground on which it stands, and which is attached to it. E. गृह, and पोत a young animal, affix कन्, the rudiments of the house.
गृहबलि: गृहबलि m. (-लिः) Offering of the reliques of a meal, or sacrifice to the spirits of the air, &c. E. गृह, and वलि offering.
गृहबलिप्रिय: गृहबलिप्रिय m. (-यः) A kind of crane, the Vaca. E. गृह a house, बलि food offered in oblation, and प्रिय fond of: see the next.
गृहबलिभुज्: गृहबलिभुज् m. (-भुक्) 1 A sparrow. 2 A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.) 3 A crow. E. गृह a house or a wife, बलि grain, &c. used in oblations, or any edible grain, and भुज् who eats; that is, who eats the food of his female, or the fragments of offerings fallen in or about the house; also गृहवलिप्रिय.
गृहभङ्ग: गृहभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 An exile, one who is driven from his house. 2 Family decay. 3 Breaking down or into a house. E. गृह, and भङ्ग breaking.
गृहभञ्जन: गृहभञ्जन n. (-नं) 1 Breaking down or destroying a house. 2 Causing the ruin or decay of a family. E. गृह, and भञ्जन breaking.
गृहभूमि: गृहभूमि f. (-मिः) The site of a habitation. E. गृह a house, and भूमि ground.
गृहमणि: गृहमणि m. (-णिः) A lamp. E. गृह a house, and मणि a jewel.
गृहमाचिका: गृहमाचिका f. (-का) A bat. E. गृह a house, and माचिका a fly.
गृहमृग: गृहमृग m. (-गः) A dog. E. गृह a house, and मृग a deer.
गृहमेधिन्: गृहमेधिन् m. (-धी) A householder. f. (-धिनी) 1 A housewife, the wife of a householder. 2 Natural sense or intelligence. E. गृह a house, मेध to understand, and इनि aff.
गृहयाप्य: गृहयाप्य m. (-प्यः) The householder, the master of a house or family. E. गृह to take, आप्य Uṇādi affix, and अय inserted.
गृहयालु: गृहयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Disposed to seize or take. E. गृह to take, अय inserted, and आलुच् aff.
गृहरन्ध्र: गृहरन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) 1 Private or family affairs, especially of an unpleasing nature. 2 A breach in the wall of a house. E. गृह, and रन्ध्र a hole; also गृहछिद्रं.
गृहवाटिका: गृहवाटिका f. (-का) A garden or grove near a house. E. गृह a house, वट to surround, affix ण्वुल्, and fem. form.
गृहव्यापार: गृहव्यापार m. (-रः) Household affairs, domestic economy. E. गृह, and व्यापार practice.
गृहस्तम्भ: गृहस्तम्भ m. (-म्भः) The pillar of a house. E. गृह, and स्तम्भ a post.
गृहस्थ: गृहस्थ m. (-स्थः) A householder, the man of the second class, or he who, after having finished his studies, and been invested with the sacred thread, performs the duties of the master of a house, and father of a family. E. गृह a house, and स्थ who stays or abides.
गृहस्थधर्म: गृहस्थधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The practice or duty of a householder. E. गृहस्थ, and धर्म्म duty.
गृहस्थधर्म्म: गृहस्थधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The practice or duty of a householder. E. गृहस्थ, and धर्म्म duty.
गृहस्थाश्रम: गृहस्थाश्रम m. (-मः) The order of householder. E. गृहस्थ, and आश्रम order of life.
गृहस्थूण: गृहस्थूण n. (-णं) The pillar of a house. E. गृह a house, and स्थूण a prop or pillar.
गृहाक्ष: गृहाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A loophole, an eyelet hole, a round or oblong window. E. गृह a house, and अक्ष for अक्षि an eye.
गृहागत: गृहागत m. (-तः) A guest. E. गृह, and आगत come to.
गृहाधिप: गृहाधिप m. (-पः) The Gṛhastha or householder: see गृहस्थ. E. गृह a house, and अधिप a master.
गृहाभिपालिन्: गृहाभिपालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Watching, taking care of the house. m. (-ली) A watchman. E. गृह and अभि before पाल to protect, णिनि aff.
गृहाम्ल: गृहाम्ल n. (-म्लं) Sour gruel, made from the fermentation of rice water. E. गृह a house, and अम्ल sour, the domestic acid.
गृहायणिक: गृहायणिक m. (-कः) A householder. E. गृह a house, फिञ् derivative affix, and कन् added.
गृहाराम: गृहाराम m. (-मः) A garden, a grove, &c. near a house. E. गृह a house, and आराम a garden.
गृहालिका: गृहालिका f. (-का) A small lizard. E. गृह a house, आलि a scorpion, कन् affix of similitude.
गृहावग्रहणी: गृहावग्रहणी f. (-णी) The threshold, a raised ground or a terrace in front of the door. E. गृह a house, and अव prefixed to ग्रह to take, affixes ल्युट् and ङीप्.
गृहावस्थित: गृहावस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dwelling or living in a house. 2 Lying in any place. E. गृह, and अवस्थित placed or situated in.
गृहाशया: गृहाशया f. (-या) The betel tree, (Piper betel.) E. गृह a house, &c. आशय an asylum, growing near dwellings.
गृहाश्मन्: गृहाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) A flat oblong stone, upon which condiments are ground together. E. गृह a house, and अश्मन् a stone.
गृहिणी: गृहिणी f. (-णी) A wife. E. गृह a house, and इनि and ङीष् affs.
गृहिन्: गृहिन् m. (-ही) A householder. E. गृह a house, and इनि aff.
गृहीत: गृहीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken, attached, seized, caught. 2 Obtained. 3 Known, understood. 4 Promised, agreed. 5 Learnt, acquired. E. ग्रह to take, affix क्त, र charged to ऋ.
गृहीतविद्य: गृहीतविद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Versed in science, learned, studied. E. गृहीत, and विद्या learning.
गृहीतदिश्: गृहीतदिश् mfn. (-दिक्) Flown, escaped, retreated. E. गृहीत seized, and दिश place.
गृहीतवेतन: गृहीतवेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Paid, remunerated. E. गृहीत, and वेतन wages.
गृहीतृ: गृहीतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Taking, disposed to seize or take. E. ग्रह to seize, affix तृच्, and ई inserted.
गृहीत्वा: गृहीत्वा ind. Having taken. E. ग्रह to take, क्त्वा aff.
गृहोपकरण: गृहोपकरण n. (-णं) Any domestic utensil. E. गृह, and उपकरण instrument.
गृहोत्पात: गृहोत्पात m. (-तः) 1 A domestic nuisance, as vermin, &c. 2 Family misfortune. E. गृह, and उत्पात calamity.
गृहोलिका: गृहोलिका f. (-का) A small house lizard. E. गृह to take, and उल and कन् affixes: see गृहगोधिका.
गृह्णत्: गृह्णत् mfn. (-ह्णन्-ह्णन्ती-ह्णत्) Taking, seizing, accepting, &c. E. ग्रह to take, शतृ aff.
गृह्य: गृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 Dependant, subservient. 2 A partisan of or belonging to a side or party. 3 To be taken or seized. 4 To be trusted to, to be relied on. 5 To be acknowledged or admitted, to be adopted as faith or belief. 6 Domestic, of or belonging to a house. m. (-ह्यः) A tame or domesticated animal. n. (-ह्यं) 1 The name of a book, containing directions for religious rites, a section or component treatise of the Sāma Veda, by GOBHILA and others; which contains rules for the performance of domestic and other ceremonies: the ritual of the Vedas. f. (-ह्या) A suburb, a village adjoining to a city, or a small village attached to a larger. E. ग्रह or गृह to take, affix क्यप्; or गृह a house, यत् affix; also with कन् added गृह्यक.
गृह्यक: गृह्यक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Dependent, docile, not following one's own inclinations. m. (-कः) A tame or domesticated animal, whether a bird or beast, &c. E. गृह for ग्रह to take, क्यप् affix, and कन् added.
गृह्यगुरु: गृह्यगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of ŚIVA. E. गृह्य, and गुरु a teacher.
गृह्यसूत्र: गृह्यसूत्र n. (-त्रं) A precept of the Gṛhya or ritual of the Vedas. E. गृह्य, and सूत्र a rule.
गॄ: गॄ r. 6th cl. (गिरति or गिलति) To swallow, to eat. r. 9th cl. (गृणाति) To sound, to sound intelligibly or articulately, to speak. r. 10th cl. (गीरयते) 1 To know. 2 To make known, to teach: With निर् or उत् prefixed, To reject, to vomit. With सम् and उत्, 1 To throw up. 2 To cry aloud.
गेण्डु: गेण्डु m. (-ण्डुः) A ball for playing with. E. गा to go, affix इण्डु, or with कन् added गेण्डुक.
गेण्डुक: गेण्डुक m. (-कः) A ball; also गेण्डूक, the penultimate being made long.
गेप: गेप r. 1st cl. (ऋ) गेपृ (गेपते) 1 To shake or tremble. 2 To move.
गेय: गेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 A singer. 2 A song or chaunt, what is to be sung or chaunted. n. (-यं) Song, singing. E. गै to sing, affix यत्.
गेव: गेव r. 1st cl. (ऋ) गेवृ (गेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
गेष: गेष r. 1st cl. (ऋ) गेषृ (गेषते) To seek, to search, to investigate.
गेष्ण: गेष्ण m. (-ष्णः) 1 A professional singer, an actor, a mime, &c. 2 A chaunter of the Sāma Veda. E. गै to sing, and इष्णच् Uṇādi aff.
गेष्णु: गेष्णु m. (-ष्णुः) 1 A singer. 2 An actor. 3 A chaunter of the Sāma Veda: see गेष्ण. E. गै to sing, and इष्णुच् Uṇādi aff.
गेह: गेह n. (-हं) A house, a dwelling. E. ग a name of GAṆEŚA, इह to desire, affix घञ्; that deity being usually invoked upon laying the foundations of a house.
गेहनर्द्दिन्: गेहनर्द्दिन् m. (-र्द्दी) A lazy or effeminate man, a cotquean. E. गेह a house, and नर्द्दिन् who makes a noise: see the next.
गेहशूर: गेहशूर m. (-रः) A slothful and trifling man, one who is unfit for concerns beyond those of the house, a cotquean, a house-hero. E. गेह a house, and शूर a hero.
गेहिन्: गेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Having a house, a householder, &c. E. गेह, and इनि aff.
गै: गै r. 1st cl. (गायति) To sound, to sing. With उद् or प्र prefixed; (उद्गायति प्रगायति) To sing, to chaunt, to sing out or aloud. (उद्गीयते प्रगीयते) To be sung or chaunted. With वि (विगायति) To assert repeatedly.
गैर: गैर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Mountain, mountaineer, mountain-born. E. गिरि, and अण् aff.
गैरिक: गैरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mountain, mountain-born or produced. n. (-कं) 1 Red chalk, or as sometimes applied, red orpiment. 2 Gold. E. गिरि a mountain, affix ठक्.
गैरेय: गैरेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Mountain, mountaineer, mountain-born. n. (-यं) 1 Bitumen. 2 Red chalk. E. गिरि a mountain, affix ढक्.
गो: गो m. (-गौः) 1 Heaven, Svarga or paradise. 2 A bull. 3 A ray of light. 4 The thunderbolt. 5 The moon. 6 The sun. 7 A kind of sacrifice, the sacrifice of a cow. 8 The moment of the sun's entering Taurus. mn. (-गौः-गु) 1 The hair of the body. 2 Water: (in the last sense some confine it to the mas. plu. गावः and according to others, it is neuter in several other senses.) f. (-गौः) 1 A cow. 2 The eye. 3 An arrow. 4 A quarter, as the east, west, &c. 5 Speech; also identified with the goddess of speech, SARASVATĪ. 6 The earth. 7 A mother. E. गम to go, and डो Uṇādi aff.
गोकण्टक: गोकण्टक m. (-कः) 1 The name of a plant: see गोखुर. 2 The print of a cow's hoof or spot so marked. E. गो the earth or a cow, &c. and कण्टक a thorn.
गोकर्ण: गोकर्ण m. (-र्णः) 1 A span from the tip of the thumb to that of the little finger. 2 A kind of deer, (the Nīlgau?) 3 A mule. 4 A class of demigods. 5 A kind of snake. 6 A snake in general. 7 A place of pilgrimage on the Malabar coast. f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides:) see मूर्व्वा. E. गो a cow, and कर्ण an ear, having ears like a cow, &c.
गोकिराटिका: गोकिराटिका f. (-का) A bird, considered as one kind of the common Maina, (Turdus salica.) E. गो the earth, and किर a hog, अट who goes, with कन् added in the fem. form; resembling a hog, feeding on ordure, &c.
गोकिल: गोकिल m. (-लः) 1 A plough. 2 A pestle. E. गो the earth, and किल to go, affix क; also गोकील.
गोकील: गोकील m. (-लः) 1 A pestle. 2 A plough. E. गो the earth, and कील a pin or bolt.
गोकुल: गोकुल n. (-लं) 1 A herd of kine, a multitude of cattle. 2 A cowhouse or station. 3 A village or tract on the Jumna, the residence of NANDA and of KṚṢṆA during his youth. E. गो a cow, and कुल an assemblage.
गोकुलिक: गोकुलिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Squint-eyed. 2 One who gives help to a cow in the mud. E. गो the eye, &c. and कुल to accumulate, affix ठक्.
गोकृत: गोकृत n. (-तं) Cowdung. E. गो a cow, and कृत made.
गोक्षुर: गोक्षुर m. (-रः) The name of a plant; also Gokhura, (Ruellia longifolia, Rox. it is also applied in Bengal to Tribulus lanuginosus.) n. (-रं) A cow's hoof. E. गो a cow, and क्षुर a hoof, the thorns getting between the hoofs of cattle; also with कन् added गोक्षुरक, and with खुर a hoof, गोखुर.
गोखुर: गोखुर m. (-रः) See गोक्षुर; also गोखुरि.
गोगोयुग: गोगोयुग n. (-गं) A pair of oxen. E. गो, and गोयुग a pair.
गोगोष्ठ: गोगोष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A cattle shed. E. गो, and गोष्ठ a shed.
गोगृष्टि: गोगृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A cow that has had one calf. E. गो a cow, and गृष्टि q. v. the same as the compound.
गोग्रन्थि: गोग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) 1 Dried cow-dung. 2 A station for cows, a cowyard or house, &c. E. गो a cow, ग्रन्थ to arrange, and इन् aff.
गोग्रह: गोग्रह m. (-हः) Spoil, booty, capture of cattle. E. गो, and ग्रह seizing.
गोग्रास: गोग्रास m. (-सः) The ceremony of presenting grass to the cow when making atonement. E. गो, and ग्रास a mouthful.
गोघ्न: गोघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Who or what kills kine. m. (-घ्नः) A guest. E. गो a cow, and घ्न what kills, from हन् with टक् affix; a cow being killed on the arrival of the latter, or being presented to him.
गोघृत: गोघृत n. (-तं) 1 Rain. 2 Ghee made from cow's milk. E. गो the earth, घृत what sprinkles, from घृ to sprinkle or wet, affix क्त.
गोचर: गोचर m. (-रः) 1 An object of sense, as sound, shape, colour, &c. 2 A country, a district. 3 The house or mansion of a planet, or its presence in any sign which is that of a person's nativity. 4 Pasturage. E. गो an organ of sense, &c. and चर what goes, from चर to go, घ aff.
गोचर्मन्: गोचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 A cow's hide. 2 A hide of land, 300 feet long, by 10 broad: it is also defined as that extent of land, the crop of which will support a man for a year. E. गो, and चर्म्मन् skin.
गोचर्म्मन्: गोचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 A cow's hide. 2 A hide of land, 300 feet long, by 10 broad: it is also defined as that extent of land, the crop of which will support a man for a year. E. गो, and चर्म्मन् skin.
गोचारक: गोचारक m. (-कः) A cowherd. E. गो, चर to go, causal form, वुन् aff.
गोच्छाल: गोछाल m. (-लः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended, &c. see अलम्बुष.
गोछाल: गोछाल m. (-लः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended, &c. see अलम्बुष.
गोजल: गोजल n. (-लं) Cow's urine. E. गो, and जल water.
गोजागरिक: गोजागरिक m. (-कः) A prickly nightshade. n. (-कं) Happy, fortunate, auspicious. E. गो the earth, जागृ to wake or to be awake, affix ठक्.
गोजिह्वा: गोजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A potherb growing wild, (Elephantophus scaber.) E. गो a cow, and जिह्वा a tongue: the leaves being so compared; also with कन् added गोजिह्वका.
गोडु: गोडु m. (-डुः) A lump of flesh on the navel. E. गुड to be sound, affix घञ्.
गोडुम्ब: गोडुम्ब mf. (-म्बः-म्बा) The water melon. f. (-म्बा) A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.) E. गो the earth, लुवि to hurt, affix अच्, and ल changed to ड.
गोणी: गोणी f. (-णी) 1 Torn or ragged clothes. 2 A sack. 3 The measure of a Droṇa. E. गुण to reckon, affixes अच् and ङीष्, the deriv. irr.
गोण्ड: गोण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं) A person with a prominent navel. m. (-ण्डः) A man of a low tribe, a mountaineer, especially inhabiting the eastern portion of the Vindhya range, between the Nerbudda and Kṛṣṇa, giving name to the province of Gondwana. 2 A prominent navel, or a lump of flesh on the navel, &c. E. गुडि to enclose, &c. अच् aff.
गोतम: गोतम m. (-मः) The name of a sage; also गौतम.
गोतमान्वय: गोतमान्वय m. (-यः) A name of ŚĀKYA or ŚĀKYA MUNI, a Bauddha sage. E. गोतम a sage, and अन्वय lineage; the descendant of GOTAMA.
गोतल्लज: गोतल्लज m. (-जः) An excellent cow. E. गो a cow, तल्लज implying excellence.
गोत्र: गोत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Family, race, lineage, kin. 2 A name, an appellation. 3 A forest. 4 A field. 5 A Catta, an umbrella or parasol. 6 A road. 7 Knowledge of futurity, inspiration. 8 A genus, a class or species. 9 A caste, a tribe or subdivision of it into families, as in that of the Brahman; twenty-four Gotras are reckoned, supposed to be sprung from and named after celebrated teachers, as ŚĀṆḌILYA, KAŚYAPA, GAUTAMA, BHĀRADVĀJA, &c. 10 Increase. 11 Wealth. f. (-त्रा) 1 The earth. 2 A herd of kine. m. (-त्रः) 1 A mountain. E. गु to sound, and त्र Uṇādi affix, or गो the earth, &c. and त्र what preserves, from त्रै with क aff.
गोत्रज: गोत्रज m. (-जः) A relation: in law, the term is nearly equivalent to the Gentile of Roman law, and is applied to kindred of the same general family, who are connected by offerings of food and water, and stands opposed to the Bandhu or cognate kin, who do not partake in the offerings to the common ancestors: see बन्धु. E. गोत्र as above, ज born.
गोत्रभिद्: गोत्रभिद् m. (-भिद् or भित्) A name of INDRA. E. गोत्र a mountain, and भिद् who splits, (with his thunderbolt.)
गोत्ररिक्थ: गोत्ररिक्थ n. (-क्थं) Patrimony, inheritance. E. गोत्र, and रिक्थ wealth.
गोद: गोद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Who or what gives a cow. m. (-दः) The brain. E. गो light or a cow, and द what gives.
गोदन्त: गोदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Yellow orpiment. 2 A cow's tooth. 3 A fossile substance of a white colour, apparently an earthy salt. E. गो a cow, and दन्त a tooth, a cow's tooth, from its similar hardness, &c.
गोदा: गोदा f. (-दा) The Godāvarī river. E. गो water, and द who gives: see गोदावरी.
गोदान: गोदान n. (-नं) Gift of a cow. E. गो, and दान gift; also गोप्रदान.
गोदारण: गोदारण m. (-णः) 1 A plough. 2 A spade or hoe. E. गो the earth, and दारण what cuts or tears.
गोदावरी: गोदावरी f. (-री) The name of a river in the peninsula, the Godāvarī. E. गो water, and द what gives, गोद and आवृ to cover or conceal; affixes अप् and ङीष्.
गोदुग्ध: गोदुग्ध n. (-ग्धं) Cow's milk. E. गो, and दुग्ध milk.
गोदुह्: गोदुह् m. (-धुक्) A cowherd, a milkman. E. गो a cow, दुह to milk, and क्विप् affix; also with क affix गोदुह, nom. (-हः)
गोदोहनी: गोदोहनी f. (-नी) A milk pail. E. गो a cow, and दुह to milk, with ल्युट् and ङीष् aff.
गोद्रव: गोद्रव n. (-वं) Cow's urine. E. गो, and द्रव what runs from.
गोधन: गोधन n. (-नं) A herd of cows, a multitude or number of cattle, especially if considered as property. m. (-नः) A large headed arrow. E. गो a cow, and धन wealth.
गोधा: गोधा f. (-धा) 1 A leathern fence worn by archers on the left arm, to prevent its being injured by the bowstring. 2 An iguana, either the Gosamp or the alligator. E. गुध to surround, affixes अङ् and टाप्; see गोधिक.
गोधापदिका: गोधापदिका f. (-का) Cissus pedata. E. कन् added to the next.
गोधापदी: गोधापदी f. (-दी) A plant, (Cissus pedata.) E. गोधा, and पद for पाद a foot, affix ङीष्, the root being compared to an alligator's foot.
गोधि: गोधि m. (-धिः) 1 The forehead. 2 The Gangetic alligator. 3 An iguana. E. गो the eye or water, and धा to possess, with कि aff.
गोधिका: गोधिका f. (-का) 1 The Gangetic alligator. 2 The iguana. E. कन् with the fem. form added to गोधा.
गोधिकात्मज: गोधिकात्मज m. (-जः) The iguana. E. गोधा an alligator, and आत्मज offspring, here used to imply diminution: so गोधिकापुत्र, &c.
गोधुम: गोधुम m. (-मः) Wheat: see the next.
गोधूम: गोधूम m. (-मः) 1 Wheat. 2 The orange. 3 The name of a drug. E. गुध to surround, and ऊम Uṇādi aff.
गोधूमचूर्ण: गोधूमचूर्ण n. (-र्लं) Wheat flour. E. गोधूम, and चूर्ण powder.
गोधूमसम्भव: गोधूमसम्भव n. (-वं) Sour paste. E. गोधूम, and सम्भव produced.
गोधूलि: गोधूलि f. (-लिः) A period of the day, in the hot season when the sun is half risen; in the cold and dewy seasons, when the sun is full but mild; and in the three other seasons, sunset. E. गो, and धूलि dust.
गोधेनु: गोधेनु f. (-नुः) A milch cow. E. गो a cow, and धेनु the same.
गोधेर: गोधेर m. (-रः) A guardian, a protector, a preserver.
गोनन्दी: गोनन्दी f. (-न्दी) The female of the Sāras or Indian crane. E. गो water, नदि to be happy, अच् and ङीष् affs.
गोनर्द: गोनर्द m. (-र्दः) The Sāras or Indian crane. n. (-र्दं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गो water, नर्द to sound, affix अच्.
गोनर्दीय: गोनर्द्दीय m. (-यः) A name of the saint PATAÑJALI, the founder of the Yoga philosophy. E. गो heaven, नर्द्दीय to be sounded or celebrated.
गोनर्द्दीय: गोनर्द्दीय m. (-यः) A name of the saint PATAÑJALI, the founder of the Yoga philosophy. E. गो heaven, नर्द्दीय to be sounded or celebrated.
गोनस: गोनस m. (-सः) 1 A large kind of snake, by some considered to be the same with the Boa or Bor. 2 A kind of gem. E. गो a cow, and नस a nose, cow-nosed; also गोनास.
गोनाथ: गोनाथ m. (-थः) 1 A bull. 2 A herdsman. E. गो, and नाथ master.
गोनास: गोनास m. (-सः) A snake: see गोनास.
गोनिष्यन्द: गोनिष्यन्द n. (-न्दं) Cow's urine. E. गो, and निष्यन्द what oozes.
गोप: गोप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) 1 A helper, a friend or patron. 2 A preserver, a cherisher. 3 Who or what hides or conceals. m. (-पः) 1 Superintendent of a district. 2 The head of a cowpen. 3 A herdsman, a cowherd, a milkman by caste and occupation. 4 A king. 5 Myrrh: see गोपरस. f. (-पा or -पी) A plant, (Echites frutescens). f. (-पा) A milkwoman, a female cowherd. f. (-पी) 1 A cowherd's wife, but especially applied to those of Vṛndāvana, the companions and objects of KṚṢṆA'S juvenile sports, and who are considered sometimes as holy or celestial personages. 2 A protectress. 3 Nature, elementary nature. E. गो the earth, &c. and प what preserves; also in some senses गुप to hide, to protect, &c. affix घञ्, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.
गोपक: गोपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) One who guards or protects. (-कः) 1 Myrrh. 2 The superintendant of a district. E. कन् added to the preceding.
गोपकन्या: गोपकन्या f. (-न्या) 1 The daughter of a cowherd. 2 A nymph of Vṛndāvana. 3 A medicinal plant. E. गोप, and कन्या a daughter.
गोपघोण्टा: गोपघोण्टा f. (-ण्टा) A wild sort of jujube, (Zizyphus nepeca.) E. गोप a cowherd, and घोण्टा the jujube.
गोपति: गोपति m. (-तिः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 Of INDRA. 3 The sun. 4 A king. 5 A bull. E. गो the earth, &c. and पति lord or master.
गोपतिचाप: गोपतिचाप m. (-पः) The rainbow. E. गोपति INDRA, and चाप a bow.
गोपदल: गोपदल m. (लः) The areca tree. E. गोप preserving, and दल a leaf.
गोपन: गोपन n. (-नं) 1 Protecting, guarding. 2 Concealment, hiding. 3 Reviling, abuse. 4 Flurry, hurry, alarm. 5 Light, lustre. 6 The leaf of the Laurus cassia. E. गुप to hide, ल्युट् aff.
गोपनीय: गोपनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Secret, mysterious, to be concealed or hidden. 2 To be preserved or protected. E. गुप to hide, &c. अनीयर् aff.
गोपबधू: गोपबधू f. (-धूः) 1 The wife of a cowherd. 2 A plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa.) E. गोप, and वधू a wife.
गोपबधूटी: गोपबधूटी f. (-टी) The youthful wife of a cowherd.
गोपभद्र: गोपभद्र m. (-द्रः) The fibrous root of a waterlily. E. गोप a cowherd, and भद्र lucky, auspicious.
गोपभद्रिका: गोपभद्रिका f. (-का) The name of a tree: see गम्भारी. E. गोप a preserver, and भद्र auspicious, and कन् and टाप् affs.
गोपरस: गोपरस m. (-सः) Gum myrrh. E. गोप secret, and रस juice, exuding in a manner or place unknown.
गोपवल्ली: गोपवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens:) see श्यामलता. 2 Another plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa.) E. गोप a cowherd, and वल्ली a pedicle, being used in medicines for cattle.
गोपाटविक: गोपाटविक m. (-कः) A cowherd. E. गो, and पाटविक clever.
गोपानसी: गोपानसी f. (-सी) 1 The wood of a thatch. 2 A crooked beam which supports it. 3 The bamboo frame work on which it rests. E. गोप preserving, affixes नसट् and ङीष्, आ inserted.
गोपायक: गोपायक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) A preserver, a cherisher, one who guards or protects. E. गुप to preserve, ण्वुल् aff.
गोपायित: गोपायित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Preserved, protected, cherished. E. गुप to protect, affix क्त.
गोपाल: गोपाल m. (-लः) 1 A king, a sovereign. 2 A cowherd. 3 A name of KṚṢṆA. E. गो the earth, &c. and पाल who preserves or protects.
गोपालक: गोपालक m. (-कः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 KṚṢṆA. 3 A cow keeper or protector. E. गो a cow or the earth, पाल् to cherish, and वुन् aff.
गोपालिका: गोपालिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of worm. 2 A female cowherd: see गोपालक.
गोपाष्टमी: गोपाष्टमी f. (-मी) The eighth lunation of the light half of Kārttika, on which KṚṢṆA became a cowherd; cows are to be worshipped. E. गोप, and अष्टमी the eighth.
गोपिन्: गोपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) A protector, one who preserves or protects. f. (-नी) 1 A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens.) 2 A cowherd's wife. E. गुप to preserve, णिनि and ङीष् affs.
गोपिका: गोपिका f. (-का) A female cowherd, &c.: see गोपक.
गोपिल: गोपिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) One who preserves or protects. E. गुप, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
गोपीचन्दन: गोपीचन्दन n. (-नं) A species of white clay, said to be brought from Dvārakā, and used by the worshippers of VIṢṆU to smear their faces with. E. गोपी, and चन्दन Sandal.
गोपीथ: गोपीथ m. (-थः) Preserving, protecting. n. (-थं) A holy place, a place of pilgrimage. E. गोप preserving, and थक् Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.
गोपुच्छ: गोपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 A cowtail. 2 A sort of necklace, one of four or thirty-four strings. 3 A sort of monkey. E. गो a cow, and पुच्छ a tail, resembling or possessing a cow's tail.
गोपुटिक: गोपुटिक n. (-कं) A temple or edifice consecrated to ŚIVA'S bull. E. गो a cow, and पट to enclose, affix इकन्.
गोपुर: गोपुर n. (-रं) 1 A town gate. 2 A gate in general. 3 The ornamented gateway of a temple. 4 A kind of grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. गुप to preserve, and ऊरच् aff.
गोपुरीष: गोपुरीष n. (-षं) Cowdung. E. गो, and पुरीष dung.
गोपेन्द्र: गोपेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. गोप a cowherd, and इन्द्र lord or chief.
गोपेश: गोपेश m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚĀKYA MUNI, a Buddha. 2 A name of KṚṢṆA. 3 A chief herdsman, the keeper or owner of kine. 4 A name of NANDA. E. गोप a cowherd, and ईश lord.
गोप्तृ: गोप्तृ mfn. (-प्ता-प्त्री-प्तृ) A preserver, a protector, one who defends or cherishes. E. गुप to preserve, &c. affix तृच्.
गोप्य: गोप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 1 To be cherished or preserved. 2 To be kept secret or hidden. 3 To be kept, to be taken care of. m. (-प्यः) 1 A slave. 2 The son of a female slave. E. गुप to preserve, &c. ण्य aff.
गोप्यक: गोप्यक m. (-कः) A servant or slave. E. कन् added to the preceding.
गोप्याधि: गोप्याधि f. (-धिः) A pledge, that is not to be used, but to be carefully preserved. E. गोप्य to be preserved, and आधि a pledge.
गोप्रकाण्ड: गोप्रकाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An excellent cow. E. गो a cow, and प्रकाण्ड excellent; the compound is always neuter.
गोप्रचार: गोप्रचार m. (-रः) Pasturage ground. E. गो, and प्रचार going.
गोबध: गोबध m. (-धः) Killing a cow. E. गो, and बध killing.
गोबाल: गोबाल m. (-लः) The hair of a cow. E. गो, and बाल hair.
गोभण्डीर: गोभण्डीर m. (-रः) A water fowl. E. गो water, भडि to sound, affix ईरच्.
गोम: गोम r. 10th cl. (गोमयति) To smear, to anoint.
गोमक्षिका: गोमक्षिका f. (-का) A gadfly. E. गो a cow, and मक्षिका a fly: stinging cattle.
गोमण्डल: गोमण्डल n. (-लं) The earth, the globe. E. गो, and मण्डल sphere.
गोमत्: गोमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Possessing herds, rich in cattle. f. (-मती) The name of a river, the Goomtī, in the province of Oude. 2 A prayer or formula of the Vedas, to be repeated during expiation for killing a cow. E. गो a cow or water, and मतुप् aff.
गोमतल्लिका: गोमतल्लिका f. (-का) A tractable and good cow. E. गो a cow, मतल्लिका excellence.
गोमध्यमध्य: गोमध्यमध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्वं) Slender in the waist. E. गो a cow, &c. मध्य middle: repeated.
गोमन्त: गोमन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 The name of a mountain. 2 An owner of cattle. 3 A herd of cattle. E. गो the earth, मन to mind, झच् aff.
गोमय: गोमय mn. (-यः-यं) 1 Cowdung. 2 The property or nature of a cow. E. गो a cow, and मयट् affix of relation or comprehension.
गोमयच्छत्र: गोमयछत्र n. (-त्रं) A mushroom, a fungus. E. गोमय cowdung, and छत्र a Catta or parasol.
गोमयछत्र: गोमयछत्र n. (-त्रं) A mushroom, a fungus. E. गोमय cowdung, and छत्र a Catta or parasol.
गोमयछविका: गोमयछविका f. (-का) A kind of fungus or mushroom. E. कन् and the fem. form added to the preceding.
गोमयप्रिय: गोमयप्रिय n. (-यं) A sort of grass, (Andropogon schoenanthus.) E. गोमय cowdung, and प्रिय favourable to.
गोमयोत्था: गोमयोत्था f. (-त्था) A kind of beetle found in cowdung. E. गोमय cowdung, and उत्थ what rises or is generated.
गोमयोद्भव: गोमयोद्भव m. (-वः) Cassia fistula. E. गोमय, and उद्भव born, produced, requiring manure.
गोमायु: गोमायु m. (-युः) 1 A jackall. 2 A kind of Gandharba or celestial musician. 3 The bile or bilious humor of the cow. E. गो sound, &c. मा to measure, and उण् Uṇādi affix, य inserted, or गो a cow, and मायु bile.
गोमिथुन: गोमिथुन n. (-नं) A pair of cattle. E. गो, and मिथुन a couple.
गोमिन्: गोमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Rich in herds, &c. m. (-मी) 1 The owner of cattle. 2 A jackall. 3 A worshipper. 4 An attendant on a Buddha. E. गो a cow, &c. मिनि aff.
गोमिल: गोमिल m. (-लः) Name of a Muni.
गोमीन: गोमीन m. (-नः) A sort of fish, the bull-fish. E. गो, and मीन a fish.
गोमुख: गोमुख n. (-खं) 1 A house built unevenly or crookedly, viz. with angles, projections, &c. 2 A kind of musical instrument, (a sort of horn or trumpet?) 3 Spreading unguents, plastering, smearing. 4 A hole in a wall made by thieves, &c a breach. m. (-खः) 1 A shark. 2 A kind of Yakṣa; according to the Jainas, a demigod subservient to their deified saints. nf. (-खं-खी) A cloth-bag, containing a rosary into which the hand is thrust to count the beads. f. (-खी) The chasm in the Himālaya mountains through which the Ganges flows, erroneously conceived by the Hindus to be of the shape of a cow's mouth. 2 A river in Bengal. E. गो a cow, and मुख face, having the face of a cow, &c.
गोमूढ: गोमूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Stupid as an ox. E. गो, and मूढ foolish.
गोमूत्र: गोमूत्र n. (-त्रं) Cow's urine. E. गो, and मूत्र urine.
गोमूत्रिका: गोमूत्रिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of grass, described as growing in corn fields, of a reddish colour, and eaten by cattle, commonly Tāmbāda (तांवड.) 2 A verse the second half of which repeats nearly all the syllables of the first. 3 A form of calculation. E. गो, मूत्र urine, कन् affix; operating on cows as a diuretic.
गोमेद: गोमेद m. (-दः) A yellow gem: see the next.
गोमेदक: गोमेदक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A gem or precious stone brought from the Himālaya and Indus, described as of four sorts, white, pale yellow, red, and dark blue, perhaps varieties of agate. 2 A kind of poison: see काकोल. 3 Smearing the body with unguents. E. गो the eye, मिद to anoint, &c. affix घञ् and कन्.
गोमेदसन्निभ: गोमेदसन्निभ m. (-भः) Chalcedony or opal. E. गोमेद, and सन्निभ what resembles.
गोमेध: गोमेध m. (-धः) The offering or sacrifice of a cow. E. गो a cow, and मेध sacrifice.
गोयान: गोयान n. (-नं) 1 A cart. 2 A carriage drawn by oxen. E. गो, and आत a vehicle.
गोयुग: गोयुग n. (-गं) A yoke of oxen. E. गो, and युग a pair.
गोरक्ष: गोरक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) A cow-keeper, the cherisher or preserver of kine. m. (-क्षः) 1 The orange. 2 Keeping or tending cattle. 3 A name of ŚIVA. f. (-क्षी) A small shrub. E. गो a cow, and रक्ष who preserves.
गोरक्षक: गोरक्षक m. (-कः) A cow keeper, one who tends cattle. E. कन् added to the last.
गोरक्षजम्बू: गोरक्षजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) 1 Wheat. 2 A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides;) also गाङ्गेरुकौ. 3 The fruit of the jujube. E. गोरक्ष, and जम्बू a rose-apple.
गोरक्षण: गोरक्षण n. (-णं) Tending or taking charge of cattle. E. गो, and रक्षण protecting.
गोरक्षतण्डुला: गोरक्षतण्डुला f. (-ला) A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. गोरक्ष cow-preserving, and तण्डुल grain, used in medicines for cattle.
गोरक्ष्य: गोरक्ष्य n. (-क्ष्यं) Tending cattle. E. गो, and रक्ष्य to be preserved.
गोरङ्कु: गोरङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 A waterfowl. 2 A prisoner, a person or animal confined. 3 A naked man, a mendicant, &c. wandering about without clothes. E. गो water, sky, &c. रङ्कु a kind of deer: as it were, the water deer, &c.
गोरण: गोरण n. (-णं) Effort, exertion. E. गुर to make effort, affix ल्युट्; also गुरण.
गोरस: गोरस mn. (-सः-सं) 1 Milk. 2 Curdled or coagulated milk. 3 Buttermilk. E. गो a cow, and रस juice.
गोरसज: गोरसज n. (-जं) 1 Buttermilk. 2 Curds. E. गोरस, and ज produced.
गोराज: गोराज m. (-जः) A bull. E. गो a cow, and राजन् a king, टच् aff.
गोराटी: गोराटी f. (-टी) A small bird, (Turdus salica.) E. गो speech, रट to utter, affix घञ्, feminine affix ङीष्.
गोरुत: गोरुत n. (-तं) A measure of distance equal to two Cros or Cos: see गव्यूति.
गोरोच: गोरोच n. (-चं) Yellow orpiment. E. गो, and रोच what shines.
गोरोचना: गोरोचना f. (-ना) A bright yellow pigment prepared from the urine of a cow, or vomited in the shape of scibulæ by the animal; or according to some, found in the head of a cow; it is employed in painting and dying, and is of especial virtue in marking the foreheads of the Hindus with the Tilaka or sectarial mark; it is also used in medicine as a sedative, tonic, and anthelmintic remedy, &c. E. गो a cow, रुचि to shine, affix ल्युट्.
गोर्द: गोर्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) The brain. E. गुर to endeavor, and दन affix; also गोद.
गोर्द्द: गोर्द्द n. (-र्द्दं) The brain. E. गुर to endeavor, and दन affix; also गोद.
गोल: गोल mn. (-लः-लं) A circle, a ball, any thing round or globular. m.
