(-लः) 1 A widow's bastard. 2 Myrrh. 3 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.) 4 A globe, celestial or terrestrial. 5 Conjunction of planets, or the presence of several in one sign. f. (-ला) 1 A globe, a sphere, a Mandala. 2 A wooden ball with which children play. 3 A woman's female friend. 4 The Godāvarī river. 5 A large water jar. 6 Ink. 7 Red arsenic. 8 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. E. गो heaven, water, &c. and ल what gets or receives; again, गुड to be round, &c. affix घञ् and ड changed to ल.
गोलक: गोलक m. (-कः) 1 A wooden ball for playing with, or any thing globular, a sphere, a globe, &c. 2 A widow's bastard. 3 A water jar. 4 Gum myrrh. 5 Pease. n. (-कं) The heaven of KṚṢṆA. E. कन् added to the preceding.
गोलाङ्गुल: गोलाङ्गुल m. (-लः) A kind of monkey, described as of a black colour, and having a tail like a cow. E. गो a cow, and लाङ्गुल a tail.
गोलाध्याय: गोलाध्याय m. (-यः) The division of mathematical science which treats of the spheres, spherics. E. गोल the globe, and अध्याय chapter.
गोलास: गोलास m. (-सः) A mushroom, a kind of fungus springing from cowdung.
गोलिह: गोलिह m. (-हः) A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali. E. गो a cow, and लिह to lick, affix क; upon which kine graze.
गोलीढ: गोलीढ m. (-ढः) A plant: see the preceding. E. गो, and लिह as above, affix क्त.
गोलोक: गोलोक n. (-कं) The heaven of KṚṢṆA. E. गो a cow, and लोक world.
गोलोमिका: गोलोमिका f. (-का) A kind of small shrub. E. गोलोमन् cow's hair, कन् affix, fem. form.
गोलोमी: गोलोमी f. (-मी) 1 A kind of bent grass, with white blossoms; also श्वेतदूर्व्वा. 2 Root of sweet flag. 3 Orris root. 4 A whore, a harlot. 5 A small shrub. E. गो the earth, &c. and लोमन् hair, the hair of the earth.
गोवन्दनी: गोवन्दनी f. (-नी) A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु. E. गो the earth, and वन्दनी praising.
गोवर्द्धन: गोवर्द्धन m. (-नः) A celebrated hill in Vindrāvan or the country about Mathura; it was upheld by KṚṢṆA upon one finger, to shelter the cowherds from a storm excited by INDRA, as a test of the former's divinity. E. गो a cow, and वर्द्धन encreasing; pasturing cattle.
गोवर्द्धनधर: गोवर्द्धनधर m. (-धः) A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. E. गोवर्द्धन Govardhana, and धर who upholds: see the preceding.
गोवशा: गोवशा f. (-शा) A barren cow. E. गो a cow, and वशा barren.
गोविन्द: गोविन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 One of the most usual appellations of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU in that form. 2 A name of VṚHASPATI, regent of JUPITER. 2 A cowkeeper, one who protects, cherishes or owns cattle. E. गो language, here the language of the Vedas especially, and विन्द who knows, from विद to know, with श affix; also गो heaven, a cow, विद to obtain, by whom heaven is obtained, or who obtains felicity by protecting kine.
गोविष्: गोविष् f. (-विद्) Cowdung. E. गो a cow, and विष् ordure; also गोविष्ठा.
गोवृन्द: गोवृन्द n. (-न्दं) 1 Property in cattle, possession of flocks and herds. 2 A herd, a drove of cattle. E. गो a cow, and वृन्द a heap, a multitude.
गोवृन्दारक: गोवृन्दारक m. (-कः) A capital cow. E. गो a cow, and वृन्दारक affix of pre-eminence.
गोवृष: गोवृष m. (-षः) A bull. E. गो a cow, and वृष best, pre-eminent.
गोव्रज: गोव्रज m. (-जः) A station for cattle. E. गो and व्रज a pen, a fold.
गोशकृत्: गोशकृत् n. (-कृत्) Cowdung. E. गो a cow, and शकृत् ordure.
गोशाल: गोशाल mfn. sub. (-लः-ला-लं) A cowhouse. adj. Born in a cowhouse. E. गो a cow, and शाला a hall.
गोशीर्ष: गोशीर्ष n. (-र्षं) 1 A kind of Sandal, described as of the colour of brass, and of great fragrance. 2 The head of a cow. E. गो a cow, and शीर्ष the head.
गोशीर्षक: गोशीर्षक m. (-कः) A plant; also called Droṇapuṣpī. E. कन् added to गोशीर्ष.
गोशृङ्ग: गोशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A tree; also Berbera. n. (-ङ्गं) The horn of a cow. E. गो, and शृङ्ग a horn.
गोष्ठ: गोष्ठ r. 1st cl. (गोष्ठते) To assemble, to collect, to heap together.

गोष्ठ mn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठं) 1 A cowpen, a fold for cattle, any place where animals are kept. 2 A station of cowherds. f. (-ष्ठी) 1 An assembly, a meeting. 2 Conversation, discourse, dialogue, dispute. 3 Family connexions, but especially the dependant or junior branches. 4 A dramatic composition in one act. E. गो a cow, and ष्ठ from स्था to stay, with क affix; here meaning the place of abiding, or गोष्ठ to assemble, affix अच्.
गोष्ठवेदिका: गोष्ठवेदिका f. (-का) A mound or altar in a cowpen. E. गोष्ठ, and वेदिका a mound.
गोष्ठश्व: गोष्ठश्व mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं) Malignant, censorious, envious: especially applied to a person who stays at home, and slanders his neighbours. E. गोष्ठ a cowpen, in the first case used for abode in general, and श्वि to increase, affix ड, who magnifies himself in his own house. m. (-श्वः) A horse in a cowpen. E. गोष्ठ, and अश्व a horse, the form is irregular.
गोष्ठाष्टमी: गोष्ठाष्टमी f. (-मी) A particular holiday: see गोपाष्टमी.
गोष्ठीपति: गोष्ठीपति m. (-ति) 1 The chief person in assembly, a president. 2 The master of a family. E. गोष्ठी, and पति master.
गोष्पद: गोष्पद n. (-दं) 1 A spot frequented by kine. 2 A measure, as much as a cow's footstep will hold. 3 The mark or impression of a cow's foot. 4 A cow's foot or hoof. E. गो a cow, and पद for पाद a foot.
गोस: गोस m. (-सः) 1 Gum myrrh. 2 The last watch of the night, early morning or day-break. E. गो water, dew, and षो to destroy, to absorb, affix ड.
गोसंख्य: गोसंख्य m. (-ख्यः) A herdsman, a cowherd. E. गो a cow, and सम् prefixed to ख्या to count, affix ड.
गोसगृह: गोसगृह n. (-हं) The inner part of a house, an inner or sleeping room, a bedchamber.
गोसङ्ग: गोसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Dawn, day-break. E. गो a cow, and सङ्ग meeting, junction; the herd assembling at that time.
गोसदृक्ष: गोसदृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Gayal, (Bos gavæus.) E. गो a cow, and सदृक्ष like, from सदृश with स aff.
गोसन्दाय: गोसन्दाय m. (-यः) One who gives a cow. E. गो a cow, दा to give, with सम् prefixed, युक् augment, affix अच्.
गोसम्भव: गोसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced from or by a cow. E. गो and सम्भव born.
गोसर्ग: गोसर्ग m. (-र्गः) Dawn, day-break. E. गो a cow, and सर्ग going forth, the cattle then going forth to pasture.
गोसव: गोसव m. (-वः) The sacrifice of a cow, one of the grand sacrifices of the Hindus in former times, and not permitted in the present or Kali age: see गोमेध. E. गो a cow, and सव sacrifice.
गोसशश: गोसशश m. (-शः) Myrrh: see गोस and शश.
गोस्तन: गोस्तन m. (-नः) 1 The udder of a cow. 2 A garland consisting of four or of thirty-four strings. 3 A cluster of blossoms, a nosegay, &c. f. (-ना or नी) A grape. E. गो a cow, and लन a breast, full or clustering like the udder of a cow.
गोस्थान: गोस्थान n. (-नं) A cowpen, a station for cattle. E. गो a cow, and स्थान a place; also with कन् added गोस्थानक.
गोस्वामिन्: गोस्वामिन् m. (-मी) 1 The master or possessor of herds. 2 A holy man, a religious personage and teacher; in common language, a Gosain. E. गो kine, or an organ of sense, and स्वामिन् a lord or master.
गोहत्या: गोहत्या f. (-त्या) Killing a cow. E. गो, and हत्या murder.
गोहन्न: गोहन्न n. (-न्नं) Cowdung. E. गो and हन्न ordure.
गोहरीतकी: गोहरीतकी f. (-की Vilva) or Bel, (Ægle marmelos.)
गोहित: गोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Proper or fit for cattle. 2 Cherishing or protecting kine. m. (-तः) 1 A creeping plant; also घोषा. 2 The Bel tree. E. गो a cow, and हित suitable, &c.
गोहिर: गोहिर n. (-रं) The heel. E. गूह to cover, इरन् aff.
गोह्य: गोह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be covered or concealed. 2 To be kept secret. E. गूह to cover, ण्यत् aff.
गौञ्जिक: गौञ्जिक m. (-कः) A goldsmith. E. गुञ्जा the small weight especially used by goldsmiths, and ठक् aff.
गौड: गौड m. (-डः) The district of Gaur, the central part of Bengal, extending from Bang to Bhuvaneswar in Orissa: the ruins of its capital, called by the same name, are still extensive. m. plu. (-डाः) The inhabitants of Gaur. f. (-डी) 1 Rum or spirit distilled from Gur or molasses. 2 One of the Rāgiṇīs. 3 A style of poetry, the bold and spirited style. E. गुड to surround, or गुड raw sugar, and अण् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.
गौडिक: गौडिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to Gur or molasses. n. (-कं) Rum. E. गुड as above, affix of relation ठञ्.
गौण: गौण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 Having qualities or attributes. 2 Relating to multiplication or enumeration. 3 Secondary, subordinate. 4 Secondary as applied to the month, reckoned from fullmoon to full moon. E. गुण, and अण् aff.
गौणिक: गौणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having qualities, relating to or connected with them. E. गुण, and ठञ् aff.
गौतम: गौतम m. (-मः) 1 The name of a saint or sage and founder of the Nyāya philosophy. 2 A legislator of the same name. 3 A name of ŚĀKYA Muni, the original Buddha or founder of the Bauddha sect. 4 A name of the first pupil of the last Jina. 5 Name of a tribe or family of Brahmans descended from GOTAMA. 6 A poison, one of the fixed kinds, or mineral, vegetable, &c. f. (-मी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A female Rākṣasa or goblin. 3 A yellow dye: see गोरोचना. 4 The Godāvarī river. E. गोतम a sage, and अण् patronymic affix, &c.
गौधार: गौधार m. (-रः) An iguana. E. गोधा an alligator, and आरक् affix of descent; considered as the offspring of the alligator, on account of its smaller size, and similar shape; also गौधेय and गाधेर.
गौधेय: गौधेय m. (-यः) An iguana. E. गोधा, and ढक् affix: see the last.
गौधेर: गौधेर m. (-रः) An iguana. E. गौधा, and द्रक् affix: see गौधार.
गौपुच्छिक: गौपुच्छिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to a cow's tail, bought for a cow's tail, &c. E. गो, and पुच्छ a tail, affix ठञ्.
गौर: गौर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 White. 2 Yellow. 3 Pale red: (or it may be used as a noun substantive mas. to imply either of these colours.) 4 Clean, cleansed, pure. m. (-रः) 1 White mustard. 2 The moon. 3 A tree, (Grislea tomentosa:) see धव. 4 A name of CAITANYA. n. (-रं) 1 The filament of a lotus. 2 Gold. 3 Saffron. f. (-रा or री) 1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ. (-री) 2 A young girl, eight years old. 3 Any young girl prior to menstruation, a maid, a virgin. 4 The name of a river. 5 The wife of the deity VARUṆA. 6 The earth. 7 Turmeric. 8 A yellow die called Gorocanā. 9 A plant: see रोचनी. 10 A plant bearing a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु. 11 One of the female energies or Śaktis of the Bauddhas. 12 A white kind of Dūrbbā or bent grass. 13 Arabian jasmin. 14 Sacred basil or Tulasi. 15 One of the Rāgiṇīs. E. गुड to sound, and रन् Uṇādi affix, the deriv. is irregular; also गुरी to endeavour, घञ् affix, and derivative irr.; upon whom or what the mind exerts itself; again, गौर white, pure, &c. affix ङीष्, that which is white or brilliant, &c. which applies to the virgin, &c.
गौरचन्द्र: गौरचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A name of the saint CAITANYA.
गौरव: गौरव n. (-वं) 1 Reputation, respectability, venerableness or weight. 2 Physical weight, heaviness. E. गुरु heavy, respectable, &c. and अण् affix, implying condition of being.
गौरवित: गौरवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Venerable, respectable. E. गौरव, and इतच् aff.
गौरवेरित: गौरवेरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, famed, celebrated. E. गौरव fame, and ईरित declared.
गौरशाक: गौरशाक m. (-कः) A species of bassia; also धूमल. E. गौर pale white, and शाक a potherb.
गौरसर्षप: गौरसर्षप m. (-पः) 1 White mustard. 2 The white mustard seed considered as a measure of weight. E. गौर white, and सर्षप mustard; also गौर.
गौराङ्ग: गौराङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A name of CAITANYA. E. गौर pale, and अङ्ग body.
गौरार्द्रक: गौरार्द्रक m. (-कः) A kind of poison. E. गौर white, and आर्द्रक ginger.
गौरास्य: गौरास्य m. (-स्यः) A black monkey with a white face. E. गौर, and आस्थ face.
गौरिका: गौरिका f. (-का) A virgin, a young girl, one eight years old, or in whom menstruation has not commenced. E. गौरी as above, and कन् aff.
गौरिल: गौरिल m. (-लः) 1 White mustard. 2 Iron or steel filings or dust. E. गौर pale white, and इलच् aff.
गौरीज: गौरीज m. (-जः) KĀRTTIKEYA or GAṆEŚA. n. (-जं) Tale. E. गौरी, and ज born.
गौरीपट्ट: गौरीपट्ट m. (-ट्टः) The horizontal plate of the Liṅga, typical of the female organ. E. गौरी, and पट्ट a layer.
गौरीपति: गौरीपति m. (-तिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. गौरी, and पति husband.
गौरीपुत्त्र: गौरीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A name of the deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. गौरी the goddess, and पुत्र a son, the son of GAURĪ.
गौरीललित: गौरीललित n. (-तं) Yellow orpiment. E. गौरी the goddess, or a young girl, and ललित loved, liked; this being used as a dye to stain the clothes of women, &c.
गौरुतल्पिक: गौरुतल्पिक m. (-कः) A violator of the bed of a Guru. E. गुरु, तल्प a bed, and ठञ् aff.
गौलक्षणिक: गौलक्षणिक m. (-कः) One who distinguishes the good marks of a cow. E. गो, लक्षण a mark, ठक् aff.
गौशतिक: गौशतिक m. (-कः) One possessing a hundred cows. E. गौ, शत a hundred, and ठञ् aff.
गौष्ठीन: गौष्ठीन n. (-नं) The site of an old and abandoned cowpen. E. गाष्ठ a cowpen, and खञ् aff.
गौसहस्रिक: गौसहस्रिक m. (-कः) One who has a thousand cows. E. गो, सहस्र a thousand, ठञ् aff.
ग्रथ: ग्रथ r. 1st cl. (इ) ग्रथि (ग्रन्थते) 1 To be crooked. 2 To be crooked metaphorically, to be wicked. 2 To curve, to bend or make crooked. 3 To string together, to arrange r. 10th cl. (ग्रन्थयति) To bind or tie.
ग्रथित: ग्रथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strung, tied together or in order. 2 Collected. 3 Arranged, classed. 4 Overcome. 5 Hurt, injured. E. ग्रथि to bind, affix क्त.
ग्रन्थ: ग्रन्थ r. 1st, 9th and 10th cls. (ग्रन्थति ग्रथ्नाति ग्रन्थयति) To string, to tie together, to connect or arrange in a regular series. With उद् prefixed, To untie, to loosen.

ग्रन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 Stringing or tying together, (literally or metaphorically.) 2 Wealth, property. 3 A book or composition in prose or verse. 4 A metre or measure of thirty-two syllables. E. ग्रन्थ to dispose or arrange, affix अच्.
ग्रन्थकर्तृ: ग्रन्थकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) An author. E. ग्रन्थ, and कर्त्तृ maker.
ग्रन्थकर्त्तृ: ग्रन्थकर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) An author. E. ग्रन्थ, and कर्त्तृ maker.
ग्रन्थकार: ग्रन्थकार m. (-रः) An author. E. ग्रन्थ, and कार who makes.
ग्रन्थकुटी: ग्रन्थकुटी f. (-टी) An office, a study, a library. E. ग्रन्थ a book, and कुटी a house or room.
ग्रन्थन: ग्रन्थन nf. (-नं-ना) Arranging, stringing, tying or connecting together either as a chaplet or a book. E. ग्रन्थ to arrange, affix युच्.
ग्रन्थविस्तर: ग्रन्थविस्तर m. (-रः) A voluminous work. E. ग्रन्थ, and विस्तर extent.
ग्रन्थि: ग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) 1 The joint or knot of a reed or cane, &c. 2 A tie, the knot of a cord, &c. 3 A joint or articulation of the body. 4 A plant, commonly Ganṭhiāla: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण. 5 Crookedness, distortion. 6 A complaint, knotting of the vessels as in varicocele, &c. E. ग्रन्थ to connect, &c. Uṇādi affix इन्.
ग्रन्थिक: ग्रन्थिक m. (-कः) 1 An astrologer, a fortune teller. 2 The youngest of the Pāṇḍus. 3 A thorny plant: see करीर. n. (-कं) 1 The root of long pepper. 2 A kind of resin, Bdellium. 3 A perfume: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण. E. कन् added to the preceding, or ग्रन्थ a book, &c. and ठक् aff.
ग्रन्थित: ग्रन्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Strung, tied. E. ग्रन्थ to tie, affix क्त.
ग्रन्थिदूर्वा: ग्रन्थिदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A species of Dūrvā grass. E. ग्रन्थि, and दूर्व्वा Panicum dactylon.
ग्रन्थिदूर्व्वा: ग्रन्थिदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A species of Dūrvā grass. E. ग्रन्थि, and दूर्व्वा Panicum dactylon.
ग्रन्थिन्: ग्रन्थिन् mfn. (-न्थी-न्थिनी-न्थि) 1 Bookish, read, learned. 2 Relating or belonging to a book, &c. E. ग्रन्थ, and इनि aff.
ग्रन्थिपर्ण: ग्रन्थिपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A plant, and according to some authorities a perfume, commonly called Ganṭhiāla. E. ग्रन्थ a knot, and पर्ण a leaf.
ग्रन्थिबन्धन: ग्रन्थिबन्धन n. (-नं) 1 Tying a knot. 2 A ligament. 3 Tying together the garments of the bride and bridegroom at the marriage ceremony. E. ग्रन्थि, and बन्धन binding.
ग्रन्थिमत्: ग्रन्थिमत् m. (-मान्) A plant, (Heliotropium indicum;) also अस्थिसंहार. E. ग्रन्थि knot, and मतुप् poss. aff.
ग्रन्थिमूल: ग्रन्थिमूल n. (-लं) Garlic. E. ग्रन्थि, a knot, and मूल root.
ग्रन्थिल: ग्रन्थिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Knotted, knotty, &c. m. (-लः) 1 A plant, commonly Buïñci (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) 2 Karīr, a thorny plant, (Capparis:) see करीर. n. (-लं) 1 Green or undried ginger. 2 Root of long pepper. E. ग्रन्थि a knot, and लच् aff.
ग्रन्थिवर्हिन्: ग्रन्थिवर्हिन् m. (-र्ही) A plant: see ग्रन्थिपर्ण. E. ग्रन्थि a knot, वर्ह to cover, and णिनि aff.
ग्रन्थिहर: ग्रन्थिहर m. (-रः) A counsellor, a minister. E. ग्रन्थि a knot, and हर who removes; who unites the knots of business.
ग्रन्थीक: ग्रन्थीक n. (-कं) The root of long pepper: see ग्रन्थिक.
ग्रस: ग्रस r. 1st cl. (उ) ग्रसु (ग्रसते) 1 To eat. 2 To swallow, to devour. r. 1st and 10th cls. (ग्रसति ग्रासयति) To take, to seize.
ग्रसन: ग्रसन n. (-नं) 1 Swallowing, eating. 2 Taking, seizing. E. ग्रस to take, ल्युट् aff.
ग्रसमान: ग्रसमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Swallowing, devouring. 2 Receiving or listening to any thing eagerly. E. ग्रस to eat, शानच् aff.
ग्रसिष्णु: ग्रसिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Eating, taking food. E. ग्रस to eat, इष्णुच् aff.
ग्रस्त: ग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Inarticulately pronounced, slurred, uttered with the omission of a letter or syllable. 2 Eaten. 3 Taken, seized. 4 Affected by. 5 Commenced as an eclipse, eclipsed. E. ग्रस to eat, affix क्त.
ग्रस्तास्त: ग्रस्तास्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Commenced and ended as an eclipse. E. ग्रस्त seized, अस्त set.
ग्रह: ग्रह r. 1st, and 10th cls. (ग्रहति ग्रहयति) r. 9th cl. (ऊ) ग्रहू (गृह्णाति गृह्णीते) 1 To take, to seize, to receive or accept. With अनु prefixed, To favour, to shew kindness to. With अव, To oppose. With उत्, To deposit, to trust. With उप, To provide. 2 To favour. With नि, 1 To take, to arrest. 2 To punish. 3 To restrain. With परि, To lay hold of, to seize. With प्रति, 1 To assent to, to receive as a precept or truth. 2 To embrace, to enfold, to comprehend or contain. 3 To subdue. 4 To accept. With वि, To quarrel, to fight. With सम्, To collect, to assemble.

ग्रह m. (-हः) 1 Taking, whether by seizure or acceptance. 2 An eclipse or seizure of the sun or moon, by RĀHU, &c. 3 A planet. 4 The place of a planet in the fixed zodiac. 5 A moveable point in the heavens. 6 A name of RĀHU, or the ascending node. 7 An imp, one of a particular class, beginning with PŪTANĀ, supposed especially to seize upon young children, producing convulsions. 8 Effort in battle. 9 Tenacity, perseverance. 10 Purpose, design. 11 Favor, patronage. E. ग्रह to take, &c. affix अप्.
ग्रहकल्लोल: ग्रहकल्लोल m. (-लः) A name of RĀHU, the personified ascending node. E. ग्रह a planet, and कल्लोल an enemy.
ग्रहगण: ग्रहगण m. (-णः) The planets taken collectively. E. ग्रह, and गण a number.
ग्रहण: ग्रहण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) A prisoner, captive, confined. n. (-णं) 1 Taking, seizure. 2 Receiving, acceptance. 3 Assent, agreement. 4 Respect. 5 The hand. 6 An eclipse. 7 Comprehension, the taking or receiving of instruction, or the acquirement of any science. 8 Sound. 9 An organ of sense. 10 In grammar, Exception. E. ग्रह to take, affix ल्युट्.
ग्रहणान्त: ग्रहणान्त n. (-न्तं) Close of study, acquirement of science, &c. E. ग्रहण taking, and अन्त end.
ग्रहणान्तिक: ग्रहणान्तिक n. (-कं) Termination of holy study. E. ग्रहण, and अन्तिक final.
ग्रहणि: ग्रहणि f. (-णिः) 1 Diarrhoea, dysentery. 2 The vessels diffusing vital warmth. 3 The small intestines, that part of the alimentary canal where the bile assists digestion. E. ग्रह to seize, अनि Uṇādi affix; also with ङीष् added ग्रहणी.
ग्रहणीरुज्: ग्रहणीरुज् f. (-रुक्) Diarrhoea, dysentery. E. ग्रहणी the same (as above), and रुज् sickness, disease.
ग्रहणीय: ग्रहणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taken, to be seized, accepted, &c. E. ग्रह, and अनीयर् aff.
ग्रहणीहर: ग्रहणीहर n. (-रं) Cloves. E. ग्रहणी diarrhoea, and हर what removes.
ग्रहनायक: ग्रहनायक m. (-कः) 1 The sun. 2 The planet Saturn. E. ग्रह a planet, and नायक a chief.
ग्रहनाश: ग्रहनाश m. (-शः) A plant, (Echites scholaris.) E. ग्रह taking, and नाश injury, producing pain in the bowels, &c. also ग्रहनाशन.
ग्रहनेमि: ग्रहनेमि m. (-मिः) The moon. E. ग्रह a planet, and नेमि the circumference of a wheel, from its shape.
ग्रहपति: ग्रहपति m. (-तिः) The sun. E. ग्रह a planet, and पति chief.
ग्रहपीडा: ग्रहपीडा f. (-डा) The influence of an unpropitious planet. E. ग्रह, and पीडा pain.
ग्रहपुष: ग्रहपुष m. (-षः) The sun. E. ग्रह, and पुष to cherish, affix क; cherishing the planets with his light.
ग्रहपूजा: ग्रहपूजा f. (-जा) Worship of the sun and the other planets. E. ग्रह, and पूजा worship.
ग्रहयाग: ग्रहयाग m. (-गः) Worship of or offering to the planets. E. ग्रह, and याग sacrifice; also ग्रहयज्ञ.
ग्रहयालु: ग्रहयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Taking, receiving. E. ग्रह to take, आलुच् affix, अय inserted; also गृहयालु.
ग्रहराज: ग्रहराज m. (-जः) 1 The sun. 2 The moon. 3 The planet Jupiter or its regent. E. ग्रह a planet, and राज a king, a chief.
ग्रहविप्र: ग्रहविप्र m. (-प्रः) An astrologer. E. ग्रह, and विप्र a Brahman.
ग्रहाधार: ग्रहाधार m. (-रः) The constellation DHRUVA or the polar star. E. ग्रह planet, and आधार asylum; the star remaining fixed amidst the planetary movements.
ग्रहाधीन: ग्रहाधीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Subject to planetary influence. E. ग्रह, and अधीन dependant.
ग्रहामय: ग्रहामय m. (-यः) Epilepsy, convulsions, demoniac possession which the complaint is supposed to be. E. ग्रह an imp, and आमय sickness.
ग्रहाशिन्: ग्रहाशिन् m. (-शी) A plant, (Echites scholaris:) see ग्रहनाश. E. ग्रह taking, and अश here meaning to hurt, affix इनि.
ग्रहीतव्य: ग्रहीतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be taken or accepted. 2 To be learned or acquired. E. ग्रह to take, तव्य affix, and ई inserted.
ग्रहीतृ: ग्रहीतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Taking, disposed to take. E. ग्रह to take, तृच् affix, and ई inserted.
ग्राम: ग्राम m. (-मः) 1 A village, a hamlet, an inhabited and unfortified place in the midst of fields and meadow land, where men of  the servile class mostly reside, and where agriculture thrives. 2 A scale in music. 3 (In composition.) A multitude. E. गम to go, affix घञ् and deriv. irr. or ग्रस to eat, Uṇādi affix मन् and आच् substituted for the radical final.
ग्रामकुक्कुट: ग्रामकुक्कुट m. (-टः) A tame or domestic cock. E. ग्राम, and कुक्कुट a cock.
ग्रामकूट: ग्रामकूट m. (-टः) A man of the fourth tribe, a Śūdra. E. ग्राम a village, and कूट a number, the crowd or population of the village.
ग्रामग: ग्रामग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes to a village. E. ग्राम, and गम to go, ड aff.
ग्रामगमिन्: ग्रामगमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going in or to a village. E. ग्राम, and गमिन् who goes.
ग्रामगृह्य: ग्रामगृह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) Being or remaining outside the village. E. ग्राम, and गृह्य to be taken out.
ग्रामघात: ग्रामघात m. (-तः) Plundering a village. E. ग्राम, and धात attacking.
ग्रामङ्गमिन्: ग्रामङ्गमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Who or what goes to a village. E. ग्राम in the 2d case, गमिन् what goes.
ग्रामज: ग्रामज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Village, rustic, village-born or produced. E. ग्राम, and ज born; also ग्रामजात, &c.
ग्रामणी: ग्रामणी mfn. (-णीः-णीः-णि) 1 Best, excellent. 2 Chief, pre-eminent, superintendent. 3 One who only thinks of enjoyment. m. (-णीः) A barber. f. (-णीः) 1 A whore, a harlot. 2 A female peasant or villager. 3 The indigo plant. E. ग्राम a village, नी to get or obtain, affix क्विप्.
ग्रामणीपुत्र: ग्रामणीपुत्र m. (-त्रः) The son of a whore, a bastard. E. ग्रामणी, and पुत्र a son; also read ग्रामणिपुत्र.
ग्रामतक्ष: ग्रामतक्ष m. (-क्षः) The village carpenter. E. ग्राम a village, and तक्ष carpenter.
ग्रामतस्: ग्रामतस् ind. From the village. E. ग्राम, and तसि aff.
ग्रामता: ग्रामता f. (-ता) A multitude of villages. E. ग्राम, and तल् affix of multitude; also ग्रामत्वं with त्व aff.
ग्रामदशेश: ग्रामदशेश m. (-शः) The head of ten villages. E. ग्राम, दश ten, and ईश chief; also ग्रामद शाधिपति, &c.
ग्रामभृत: ग्रामभृत m. (-तः) The village messenger or servant. E. ग्राम, and भृत supported.
ग्राममद्गुरिका: ग्राममद्गुरिका f. (-का) 1 A kind of fish, (Silurus singio, HAM.) 2 A riot, a fray, a village war, (ग्रामयुद्व.) E. ग्राम, and मद्गुर a fish, &c.
ग्राममुख: ग्राममुख m. (-खः) A market town, a fair, a market. E. ग्राम a village, and मुख chief.
ग्राममृग: ग्राममृग m. (-गः) A dog. E. ग्राम, and मृग a deer, the village deer.
ग्रामयाजक: ग्रामयाजक m. (-कः) The village priest, one who conducts the ceremonies for any or all classes, and is consequently considered as a degraded Brahman; it also applies to the attendant of an idol. E. ग्राम a village, यज to sacrifice, in the causal form, affix वुन्; also with णिनि affix ग्रामयाजिन्.
ग्रामलुण्टन: ग्रामलुण्टन n. (-नं) Plundering or pillaging a village. E. ग्राम, and लुण्टन robbing.
ग्रामवास: ग्रामवास m. (-सः) 1 A villager. 2 Living in a village. E. ग्राम, and वास abode; also ग्रामेवास.
ग्रामवासिन्: ग्रामवासिन् m. (-सी) A villager. E. ग्राम, and वासिन् who inhabits; also ग्रामेवासिन्.
ग्रामविशेष: ग्रामविशेष m. (-षः) Variety of the scales in music. E. ग्राम, and विशेष difference.
ग्रामशत: ग्रामशत n. (-तं) A hundred villages, a province. E. ग्राम, and शत a hundred.
ग्रामशतेश: ग्रामशतेश m. (-शः) The governor of a province. E. ग्राम, शत and ईश chief; also ग्रामशताधिपति, ग्रामशताध्यक्ष, &c.
ग्रामसङ्कर: ग्रामसङ्कर m. (-रः) The common sewer or drain of a village. E. ग्राम, and सङ्कर a narrow place.
ग्रामसङ्घ: ग्रामसङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) A village corporation, a municipality. E. ग्राम, and सङ्घ an assembly.
ग्रामस्थ: ग्रामस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Being or residing in a village, belonging to it, &c. m. (-स्थः) A village. E. ग्राम, and स्थ what stays.
ग्रामहासक: ग्रामहासक m. (-कः) A sister's husband. E. ग्राम a village, and हास who delights, from हस to laugh, &c. and ण्वुल् aff.
ग्रामाधान: ग्रामाधान n. (-नं) Hunting. E. ग्राम a village, and आधान what supports.
ग्रामाधिकृत: ग्रामाधिकृत m. (-तः) The head man or chief of a village. E. ग्राम, and अधिकृत set over.
ग्रामाधिपति: ग्रामाधिपति m. (-तिः) Chief or head of a village. E. ग्राम, and अधिपति chief.
ग्रामाध्यक्ष: ग्रामाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) Superintendent or chief of a village. E. ग्राम, and अध्यक्ष superior.
ग्रामान्त: ग्रामान्त n. (-न्तं) Space near a village. E. ग्राम, and अन्त a boundary.
ग्रामान्तीय: ग्रामान्तीय m. (-यं) Space near a village. E. ग्राम, and अन्त end, छ aff.
ग्रामिक: ग्रामिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Village, rude, rustic. 2 Chromatic. m. (कः) 1 The headman of a village. 2 A village. E. ग्राम, and ठक् aff.
ग्रामिन्: ग्रामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Village, villager. m. (-मी) The headman of a village. f. (-मिनी) The indigo plant. E. ग्राम a village, इनि and ङीष् affixes; also ग्रामीणा.
ग्रामीण: ग्रामीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 A villager, a rustic. 2 Produced in or peculiar to a village. 3 Vulgar, rude. 4 Chromatic. m. (-णः) 1 A dog. 2 A crow. f. (-णा) The indigo plant. E. ग्राम, and खञ् aff.
ग्रामीय: ग्रामीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Belonging to a village, produced in or derived from it. m. (-यः) A villager. E. ग्राम, and छ affix; also with कन् added ग्रामीयक.
ग्रामेय: ग्रामेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) A villager, rustic, village-born, &c. E. ग्राम, and ढक् affix; also with कन् added ग्रामेयक.
ग्रामेवास: ग्रामेवास m. (-सः) 1 A villager. 2 A village abode. E. ग्रामे seventh case, and वास abode.
ग्रामेवासिन्: ग्रामेवासिन् m. (-सी) A village. E. ग्रामे seventh case, वासिन् who dwells.
ग्रामेश: ग्रामेश m. (-शः) The headman of a village. E. ग्राम, and ईश a master.
ग्रामेश्वर: ग्रामेश्वर m. (-रः) The headman or ruler over a village. E. ग्राम, and ईश्वर a master.
ग्राम्य: ग्राम्य mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं) 1 Village-born, produced in or relating to a village. 2 Vulgar, rude, rustic. 3 Relating to a musical scale. m. (-म्यः) A hog, a tame or a village hog. n. (-म्यं) 1 Rustic or homely speech. 2 The Prākṛta and the other dialects of India, except the Sanscrit. E. ग्राम, and यत् aff.
ग्राम्यकर्कटी: ग्राम्यकर्क्कटी f. (-टी) A pumpkin gourd. E. ग्राम्य village, and कक्कट gourd.
ग्राम्यकर्क्कटी: ग्राम्यकर्क्कटी f. (-टी) A pumpkin gourd. E. ग्राम्य village, and कक्कट gourd.
ग्राम्यकन्द: ग्राम्यकन्द m. (-न्दः) A common species of Arum. E. ग्राम्य, and कन्द root.
ग्राम्यकुङ्कुम: ग्राम्यकुङ्कुम n. (-मं) A yellow dye, safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.) E. ग्राम्य, and कुङ्कुम saffron, village saffron.
ग्राम्यधर्म: ग्राम्यधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Copulation. E. ग्राम्य, and धर्म्म virtue, village virtue.
ग्राम्यधर्म्म: ग्राम्यधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Copulation. E. ग्राम्य, and धर्म्म virtue, village virtue.
ग्राम्यमद्गुरिका: ग्राम्यमद्गुरिका f. (-का) A kind of fish, (Silurus singio, HAM.) ग्राममद्गुरिका.
ग्राम्यमांस: ग्राम्यमांस n. (-सं) Meat of tame animals. E. ग्राम्य rural, and मांस fresh.
ग्राम्यमृग: ग्राम्यमृग m. (-गः) A dog. E. ग्राम्य, and मृग a deer, the village deer; also ग्राममृग.
ग्राम्यराशि: ग्राम्यराशि f. (-शिः) A name of several of the signs of the zodiac. E. ग्राम्य, and राशि a sign.
ग्राम्यशूकर: ग्राम्यशूकर m. (-रः) A village hog, a tame hog, a pig. E. ग्राम्य, and शूकर a hog.
ग्राम्याश्व: ग्राम्याश्व m. (-श्वः) An ass. E. ग्राम्य, and अश्व a horse, the village horse.
ग्रावन्: ग्रावन् mfn. (-वा-वा-व) Hard, solid. m. (-वा) 1 A stone or rock. 2 A mountain. 3 A cloud. E. ग्रह to seize, वनिप् aff.
ग्रास: ग्रास m. (-सः) A mouthful or a quantity equivalent to a mouthful, a lump of rice, &c. of the size of a peacock's egg. E. ग्रस to eat, affix घञ्.
ग्रासाच्छादन: ग्रासाच्छादन n. (-नं) Bare subsistence, food and clothing. E. ग्रास, and आच्छादन covering.
ग्राह: ग्राह m. (-हः) 1 Taking, either by seizure or acceptance. 2 A shark; according to some, the Gangetic alligator, (Lacerta Gangetica;) according to others, the water elephant, (the hippopotamus?) 3 Any large fish or marine animal. E. ग्रह to take, affix घञ् or ण.
ग्राहक: ग्राहक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) One who takes or seizes, one who accepts or receives. m. (-कः) 1 A hawk, a falcon. 2 A police officer, a constable, a bailiff. E. ग्रह to take, ण्वुल् aff.
ग्राहवत्: ग्राहवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Containing or abounding with alligators. E. ग्राह, and मतुप् aff.
ग्राहिन्: ग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) 1 Taking, seizing, accepting, who or what takes. 2 Astringent, binding, constipating. m. (-ही) 1 A sedative, a narcotic. 2 The elephant or wood apple: see कपित्थ. f. (-णी) A small kind of Javāsa, perhaps a species of Hedysarum. E. ग्रह to take, णिनि aff.
ग्राह्य: ग्राह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) 1 To be seized, to be taken, to be accepted. 2 To be accepted as a rule or law, to be acknowledged or assented to. 3 To be attached to or obeyed. 4 To be admitted in evidence, &c. 5 To be apprehended or arrested. E. ग्रह to take, ण्यत् aff.
ग्रीवा: ग्रीवा f. (-वा) 1 The neck. 2 The back part of the neck, the nape, the tendon of the Trapezium muscle. E. गॄ to swallow, वन् Uṇādi affix, ईट् inserted.
ग्रीविन्: ग्रीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Long-necked, handsome-necked. m. (-वी) A camel. E. ग्रीवा a neck, and इनि poss. aff.
ग्रीष्म: ग्रीष्म mfn. (-ष्मः-ष्मा-ष्मं) Hot, warm. m. (-ष्मः) 1 The hot season, comprehending two months, about June-July. 2 Heat, warmth. f. (-ष्मी) Jasmin. E. ग्रस to take, &c. मक् Uṇādi affix, and the deriv. irr.
ग्रीष्मज: ग्रीष्मज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Produced by heat. 2 Produced in the hot season. f. (-जा) A kind of fruit, (Annona reticulata.) E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and ज produced.
ग्रीष्मभव: ग्रीष्मभव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced by heat or in the hot season. f. (-वा) Double jasmin: see नवमल्ली. E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and भव being, flourishing.
ग्रीष्मसुन्दरक: ग्रीष्मसुन्दरक m. (-कः) A kind of potherb, (Chironia centauroides; it is also applied to Pharnaceum mollugo.) E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and सुन्दर handsome, affix कन्.
ग्रीष्महास: ग्रीष्महास n. (-सं) The flocculent seeds, down, &c. blown about in the air. E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, and हास a smile, considered, from their white colour, as the smiles of the season.
ग्रीष्मोद्भव: ग्रीष्मोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced by heat or in the hot season. f. (-वा) Double jasmin. E. ग्रीष्म, and उद्भब produced.
ग्रुच: ग्रुच (इर उ) इर ग्रुचु r. 1st cl. (ग्रोचति) To steal or rob.
ग्रैव: ग्रैव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Belonging to the neck, &c. n. (-वं) 1 A necklace, a close necklace or collar. 2 A chain worn round the neck of an elephant, &c. E. ग्रीवा the necklace, and अण् aff.
ग्रैवेय: ग्रैवेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging to the neck. n. (-यं) 1 A collar, a necklace. 2 A chain on the neck of an elephant or horse. E. ग्रीवा, and ढक् affix; also ग्रैवेयक.
ग्रैवेयक: ग्रैवेयक n. (-कं) A collar, an ornament for the neck. E. ग्रीवा, and ढकञ् affix: see ग्रै and ग्रैवेय.
ग्रैष्म: ग्रैष्म mfn. (-ष्मः-ष्मी-ष्मं) Belonging or relating to, or produced by heat or the hot season. f. (-ष्मी) Double jasmin. E. ग्रीष्म the hot season, &c. affix अण्.
ग्लपित: ग्लपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Distressed, pained. 2 Exhausted, overpowered. E. ग्लै to be weary, causal form, क्त aff.
ग्लस: ग्लस (उ) ग्लसु r. 1st cl. (ग्लसते) To eat: see ग्रस.
ग्लस्त: ग्लस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Eaten. E. ग्लस to eat, affix क्त.
ग्लह: ग्लह (उ) ग्लहु r. 1st and 10th cl. (ग्लहति-यति) To take, to receive or accept: see ग्रह.
ग्लह m. (-हः) Gaming, playing with dice. E. ग्लह to take, &c. affix अच्, or it is derived irregularly from ग्रह, with अप् aff.
ग्लान: ग्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wearied, languid, feeble, exhausted by fatigue, disease, &c. E. ग्लै to be feeble, and क्त aff.
ग्लानि: ग्लानि f. (-निः) Langour, lassitude, fatigue of body or depression of mind. E. ग्ला or ग्लै to be weary, Uṇādi affix नि.
ग्लायत्: ग्लायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Being exhausted, languid, faint, &c. E. ग्लै to be weary, शतृ aff.
ग्लास्नु: ग्लास्नु mfn. (-स्नुः-स्नुः-स्नु) Exhausted by disease or fatigue, wearied, languid. E. ग्लै to be weak, affix स्नु.
ग्लुच: ग्लुच (इर उ) इर ग्लुचु r. 1st cl. (ग्लोचति) 1 To steal, to rob. 2 To go: see ग्रुच.
ग्लुञ्च: ग्लुञ्च (इर उ) इर ग्लुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (ग्लुञ्चति) To go, to move.
ग्लेप: ग्लेप (ऋ) ग्लेपृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेपते) 1 To be poor or dependant. 2 To shake, to tremble. 3 To move.
ग्लेय: ग्लेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be made weary or exhausted, exhaustible, fatigable. E. ग्ला or ग्लै to be weary, affix यत्.
ग्लेव: ग्लेव (ऋ) ग्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेवते) To serve, to worship, to gratify by service or devotedness.
ग्लेष: ग्लेष (ऋ) ग्लेषृ r. 1st cl. (ग्लेषते) To inquire, to search, to investigate.
ग्लै: ग्लै r. 1st cl. (ग्लायति) 1 To be languid or weary, to be exhausted, faded, &c. 2 To yawn: this root is sometimes considered  to be ग्ला, making ग्लायति as above, and in the causal form ग्लपयति or ग्लापयति.
ग्लौतृ: ग्लौतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Wearied, exhausted. E. ग्लै to be weary, तृच् aff.
ग्लौ: ग्लौ m. (-ग्लौः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. ग्ला to be weary, Uṇādi affix डा. घ
